papers.title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路务实有效，但创新深度与证据链偏弱。
pros: 抓住推测解码接受率瓶颈，问题定义明确且贴近部署
后处理温度缩放几乎零开销，带来可复现的吞吐收益信号
cons: 方法主要是已知校准技术迁移，理论新意有限且对不同模型/场景的泛化与统计显著性论证不足

papers.title_zh: 推测性解码的草稿校准：通过匹配草稿和目标分布来加速 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过采用轻量级草稿模型来提出草稿令牌并允许目标模型并行验证新令牌以提高推理时间计算利用率，从而加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理。加速依赖于目标验证中草案代币的接受概率，该概率与目标分布 $p$ 和草案分布 $q$ 之间的差距 $\|p-q\|_1$ 直接相关。在本文中，我们研究推测解码的草案校准以提高推测解码的加速，其中我们采用事后方法来校准草案分布以缩小分布差距。我们观察到，尽管当前的社区开源草案模型可以正确学习顶级候选令牌，但与目标模型相比，它们通常缺乏信心，这表明存在一致的分布不匹配。为了减轻这种不匹配对模型草案接受率的影响，我们尝试了各种事后校准方法，包括标准温度缩放和令牌明智校准。我们的结果表明，应用于草稿分布的标准温度缩放将接受长度提高了大约 10%，而在不同的任务中几乎没有额外的成本。吞吐量分析进一步验证了服务效率的提高。对更通用的校准方法的分析揭示了进一步的潜在改进空间。

papers.title: LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.
papers.comment: 11 pages. Code and weights are available at the URL in the paper

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义扎实，工程价值高，但泛化仍待验证。

papers.title_zh: LEGOSpec：用于推测草案设计和培训的可组合且高效的框架
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码使用轻量级草稿加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 的生成。现有方法评估不同训练配置下的完整配方，但成分效果、相互作用和组合益处尚不明确。因此，我们提出了 LEGOSpec，一个用于投机草案设计和培训的可组合框架。 LEGOSpec 将草稿模型分解为共享统一训练基础设施的上下文、骨干、提案和目标组件。使用 LEGOSpec，我们系统地改变组件并在匹配的训练条件下评估选定的组合，以隔离它们的效果和相互作用。这些实验揭示了三个发现：（1）不同的工作负载有利于不同的主干，具体取决于上下文长度和内存预算，块内依赖建模对于长上下文尤其重要。 (2) 提案设计必须平​​衡接受度和延迟。 (3) 训练目标应匹配本地代币分布并优化整个区块的接受长度。这些发现指导了工作负载感知配置和 DFlux，这是一个平衡的通用草案，结合了配备卷积的 SWA-GQA 混合主干网、残差校正器和分层监督。在 Qwen 和 Gemma 模型中，DFlux 将常规基准测试的接受长度比最强基线提高了 13.7%，将长上下文工作负载提高了 34.7%。为了支持高效的训练，LEGOSpec 集成了元数据感知调度和异步执行，与 SpecForge 相比，训练吞吐量提高了 79%，离线监督准备速度提高了 3.11 美元\倍$。

papers.title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
papers.summary: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用且潜力大，但关键证据仍待更严验证。
pros: 将自适应量化注意力与精确局部块结合，兼顾效率与精度目标
声称训练复杂度降至线性级并可零微调替换预训练层，应用价值高
cons: 摘要缺少误差界、稳定性与跨任务消融细节，对“优于FlashAttention且接近全注意力”的普适性支撑不足

papers.title_zh: AVQ-Attention-2：具有精确局部块和线性成本训练的自适应矢量量化注意力
papers.summary_zh: 注意力成本为 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ 的令牌数量。矢量量化注意力通过聚类 $N$ 个键将其简化为 $\mathcal{O}(NM)$，而是关注 $M$ 码字，其自适应形式 AVQ-attention 将码本分辨率集中在查询注意力质量实际下降的地方。我们提出了 AVQ-Attention-2，这是一种更好的设计，它将其与精确的本地注意力相结合，并关注每个集群键的平均值而不是代码字。我们展示了三项改进：以可比较的成本始终提供更好的质量；训练现在也花费 $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ 而不是 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$；以及足够精确的近似值，使得该层可以放入预训练的变压器中而无需微调。在各种序列长度上，结果不仅与其他近似注意力竞争，而且与精确的密集注意力竞争，运行速度比 FlashAttention 快，质量几乎没有损失。

papers.title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs. LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87. In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. In pool mode, FragPack packs variable-length records into smaller shared-budget GPU pages read in place by a fused decode-attention kernel faster than FlashAttention-3 on BF16. Built with LMCache and vLLM, LoomKV makes compressed tiers act as 1.4x larger raw tiers on AgentX: across LMCache's LRU cliff, tier mode delivers 2.7-3.6x raw's goodput and 1.9-3.1x lower mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), shifts the cliff identically under other simulated replacement policies, and cuts repeated-prompt TTFT up to 1.7x via SSD-to-DRAM promotion. When tiers hold the working set, pool mode fits 1.31-1.34x as many GPU tokens, admitting 12 long requests with roughly raw's queue and goodput at 8. On an AI IDE trace where both tiers and the GPU pool are constrained, tier and pool modes raise goodput by 1.24x and 1.59x. Where raw capacity suffices, compression costs at most 2.2% throughput; tier mode is bit-exact with raw tiers, and pool mode matches FlashAttention-3's numerical accuracy.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高、证据较扎实，具备顶会竞争力。
pros: 同时覆盖外部层级与GPU池的无损KV压缩，问题定义完整且实用性强
在真实系统与多场景轨迹上报告显著goodput/TTFT收益，并强调低回退开销
cons: 摘要中对校准开销、跨模型泛化边界及极端负载稳定性的细节仍不足，潜在复现实证风险

papers.title_zh: LoomKV：从 GPU 内存到 SSD 的无损 KV 缓存压缩，用于 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务引擎将键/值 (KV) 缓存从 GPU 内存卸载到主机 DRAM 和 SSD，以便多轮请求和代理请求可以重用提示前缀。然后，容量在两个级别上限制服务：外部层在驱逐之前控制前缀重用，而 GPU KV 池限制并发长请求，有损压缩会改变 KV 值和输出。 LoomKV 在未修改的引擎上为外部层（层模式）和 GPU 池（池模式）带来无损 KV 压缩。 LoomKV 在 BF16 高字节（符号位和高 7 个指数位）上使用校准的每头两级 3 位代码，将 BF16 KV 存储在 9 个模型的原始大小的 0.71 处，将 FP8 KV 存储在 0.85-0.87 处。在层模式下，TileStream 写入精确长度的记录，并从加载路径读回长度，使层存储、逐出和预取保持不变，并将获取的记录直接解压缩到分散的 GPU 页面中。在池模式下，FragPack 将可变长度记录打包到更小的共享预算 GPU 页面中，由融合解码注意力内核就地读取，速度比 BF16 上的 FlashAttention-3 更快。 LoomKV 使用 LMCache 和 vLLM 构建，使压缩层在 AgentX 上充当 1.4 倍大的原始层：在 LMCache 的 LRU 悬崖上，层模式可提供 2.7-3.6 倍原始良好吞吐量和 1.9-3.1 倍较低的平均首次令牌时间 (TTFT)，在其他模拟替换策略下相同地移动悬崖，并将重复提示 TTFT 削减至 1.7 倍SSD 到 DRAM 的推广。当层保存工作集时，池模式适合 1.31-1.34 倍的 GPU 令牌，接受 12 个长请求，原始队列和吞吐量约为 8。在层和 GPU 池都受到约束的 AI IDE 跟踪中，层和池模式将吞吐量提高了 1.24 倍和 1.59 倍。在原始容量足够的情况下，压缩成本最多为吞吐量的 2.2%；层模式与原始层是位精确的，池模式与 FlashAttention-3 的数值精度相匹配。

papers.title: Scalable Placement for Disaggregated LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Fleets
papers.summary: Serving large language models (LLMs) at the edge is increasingly desirable for privacy-sensitive applications and scenarios that require data to remain on local devices. However, edge environments are constrained by limited computational resources and exhibit substantial device heterogeneity, making efficient LLM serving challenging. These limitations become particularly pronounced under bursty demand, where congestion and queue buildup can significantly increase response latency. Replicating the model into multiple pipeline instances can improve serving capacity and reduce congestion. Yet, deciding how devices should be grouped into replicas, assigning replicas to prefill or decode functions, and partitioning model layers across heterogeneous devices jointly creates a large combinatorial optimization problem. We present Spade, a scalable and runtime-efficient placement planner for disaggregated LLM serving with pipeline replication across heterogeneous edge clusters. Spade introduces a dominance-based pruning technique that discards inferior replica candidates and recursively eliminates larger candidates that contain them, dramatically shrinking the search space. It further combines a water-filling approach for layer partitioning with a bounded multidimensional knapsack formulation that optimizes placement under a congestion-aware objective. On a synthetic fleet of 30 devices spanning five hardware classes, Spade finds the optimal placement in 441ms. In contrast, a genetic-search baseline augmented with dynamic-programming partitioning requires approximately two hours and still produces solutions with a 19.7% worse congestion objective. When evaluated on fleets containing ten device types, Spade's pruning strategy eliminates 99.6% of candidate placements while yielding the same surviving candidate set as exhaustive enumeration.

quality.verdict: 问题重要且方法实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 面向异构边缘LLM部署的联合放置问题定义完整，实际价值高

papers.title_zh: 服务于异构边缘队列的分散法学硕士的可扩展安置
papers.summary_zh: 对于隐私敏感的应用程序和需要数据保留在本地设备上的场景来说，在边缘提供大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务越来越受欢迎。然而，边缘环境受到有限计算资源的限制，并且表现出巨大的设备异构性，使得高效的法学硕士服务面临挑战。这些限制在突发需求下变得尤其明显，其中拥塞和队列堆积会显着增加响应延迟。将模型复制到多个管道实例中可以提高服务能力并减少拥塞。然而，决定如何将设备分组为副本、将副本分配给预填充或解码功能以及跨异构设备划分模型层，共同创建了一个巨大的组合优化问题。我们推出了 Spade，一个可扩展且运行时高效的布局规划器，用于跨异构边缘集群的管道复制服务的分类 LLM 服务。 Spade 引入了一种基于优势的修剪技术，该技术丢弃较差的副本候选者，并递归地消除包含它们的较大候选者，从而极大地缩小搜索空间。它还将用于层分区的注水方法与有界多维背包公式相结合，以优化拥塞感知目标下的放置。在涵盖 5 个硬件类别的 30 台设备的综合队列中，Spade 在 441 毫秒内找到了最佳位置。相比之下，通过动态编程分区增强的基因搜索基线大约需要两个小时，但仍会产生拥塞目标较差 19.7% 的解决方案。当对包含十种设备类型的队列进行评估时，Spade 的修剪策略消除了 99.6% 的候选位置，同时产生与穷举枚举相同的幸存候选集。

papers.title: ModelLess: A Serverless System for Multi-Tier LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
papers.summary: LLM inference platforms sell online, asynchronous, batch and rollout products on GPUs provisioned per product, so a service's cards sit idle between bursts while other work waits. We present ModelLess, a serverless system for LLM inference. Users declare model services and the platform owns the instances. An idle service scales to zero: its instances go to sleep with their weights in host memory (release about 1 s, wake about 4 s for GLM-5.2 at TP8, against a cold start of over four minutes). Billing follows the time a service holds GPUs. The GPUs that sleeping instances free are lent to lower tiers. Cluster managers preempt low-priority tasks and treat eviction as all-or-nothing, but an LLM instance's eviction cost depends on which of its weights, execution state, KV cache and in-flight requests survive. ModelLess therefore gives each tier (online, job, flex) eviction semantics that state what it may lose when preempted, and runs a preemption protocol that closes admission before it releases memory, re-enqueues a request durably before it aborts it, and fails closed. Four components (entry, dispatcher, node agent, SGLang plugin) enforce it with sleep/wake, pause/resume of in-flight requests for flex, and a weight-copy path (follow/seal) for RL rollout. Replaying a week of traces from 1,100 H20 cards serving long-tail online models shows that about 38% of GPU-time (417 equivalent GPUs) could be lent under a coarse latency target with one fixed idle threshold. This is an idealized upper bound, and it holds only if recovery takes seconds: with a 240 s cold start under 8% remains even with per-service thresholds. On one node, a single four-hour run per policy shows that pausing yields 22% more borrower tokens per held GPU sample than abort-and-requeue, with the same median online latency. The job tier and follow/seal are not yet evaluated end to end.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、设计扎实，但评测完整性不足。
pros: 面向共享GPU多业务分层推理，问题设定贴近真实平台痛点
提出按层级定义可丢失状态的抢占语义与故障闭合协议，系统贡献较清晰

papers.title_zh: ModelLess：在共享 GPU 上进行多层 LLM 推理的无服务器系统
papers.summary_zh: LLM 推理平台在每个产品配置的 GPU 上销售在线、异步、批量和推出产品，因此服务的卡在其他工作等待时处于空闲状态。我们推出了 ModelLess，一个用于 LLM 推理的无服务器系统。用户声明模型服务，平台拥有实例。空闲服务缩放至零：其实例进入睡眠状态，其权重在主机内存中（释放约 1 秒，对于 TP8 的 GLM-5.2 唤醒约 4 秒，冷启动时间超过四分钟）。根据服务占用 GPU 的时间进行计费。休眠实例空闲的 GPU 被借给较低层。集群管理器会抢占低优先级任务，并将逐出视为全有或全无，但 LLM 实例的逐出成本取决于其权重、执行状态、KV 缓存和正在进行的请求中的哪一个能够幸存。因此，ModelLess 为每一层（在线、作业、弹性）提供逐出语义，说明抢占时可能会丢失什么，并运行抢占协议，在释放内存之前关闭准入，在中止请求之前将请求持久地重新排队，并失败关闭。四个组件（入口、调度程序、节点代理、SGLang 插件）通过睡眠/唤醒、暂停/恢复进行中的 Flex 请求以及用于 RL 推出的权重复制路径（跟随/密封）来强制执行。重播服务于长尾在线模型的 1,100 个 H20 卡的一周跟踪表明，在具有固定空闲阈值的粗略延迟目标下，可以借出大约 38% 的 GPU 时间（417 个等效 GPU）。这是一个理想化的上限，只有在恢复需要几秒钟的情况下才成立：240 秒的冷启动，即使使用每个服务阈值，仍保持在 8% 以下。在一个节点上，每个策略单次运行 4 小时表明，在相同的中值在线延迟的情况下，暂停所产生的每个 GPU 样本的借款人代币比中止并重新排队多 22%。工作级别和跟随/密封尚未进行端到端评估。

papers.title: Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing
papers.summary: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待验证。
pros: 将“网格探测”形式化为可原生执行的注意力，概念转换有启发性
训练免费、兼容冻结模型，兼顾长上下文精度、可扩展性与时延成本
cons: 摘要未充分说明对比基线公平性、统计显著性及不同模型规模下的稳定性，泛化与复现风险仍在

papers.title_zh: 因子化上下文注意力：从模拟到本机网格探测
papers.summary_zh: 模型一次性阅读一本书、一小时的视频或一张图像。随着上下文的增长，此传递速度会减慢，失去准确性，并在上下文窗口处停止。稀疏注意力是有效的，但保留了其他两个限制。网格探测是一种最近的免训练方法，它通过向冻结模型询问有关输入的短局部和跨步跨度的相同问题来恢复准确性并扩展范围，但每个问题都会重复整个计算，因为每个跨度都会再次编码。我们的见解是，网格探测是模拟注意力，一种通过提示从模型外部再现的注意力模式，因为每个探测仅限制问题可以看到输入的哪一部分。我们引入了因子化上下文注意力（FCA），这是一种免训练的块稀疏注意力，它本身运行与模型本身的注意力相同的模式。 FCA 将输入一次编码到 KV 缓存中，将所有跨度读取为一次批量转发中的屏蔽序列，并使用楼梯位置计划将每个跨度保持在训练的位置范围内。在长视频理解、长上下文文本推理和图像基础方面，FCA 的准确性和覆盖范围可与网格探测相媲美，而成本仅为网格探测的一小部分。它在长视频上比单遍获得约 10 分，在长小说上比单遍获得 9 到 14 分，在超过 1000 帧的视频和四倍于窗口长度的文本中找到针，并在仅需网格探测时间十分之一的时间内回答关于相同输入的后续问题。因此，本机注意力无需付出任何代价即可保留模拟注意力所获得的成果，所有这些都使用现有的冻结语言和视觉语言模型。

papers.title: Norn: Context-Length-Aware Optimization of Weight and KV Cache Placement for Offloaded LLM Inference
papers.summary: Offloading model weights and the key-value (KV) cache to host memory enables large language models (LLMs) to run on a single memory-constrained GPU. As the KV cache grows during decoding, GPU memory requirements and the costs of KV cache transfers and attention computation change. However, existing offloading methods generally use static computation assignments and placements of model weights and the KV cache, preventing them from adapting to these changes and degrading inference performance. We propose Norn, a context-length-aware offloaded LLM inference method. Based on offline profiling, Norn co-optimizes computation assignments and placements at the sublayer level, precomputing multiple execution plans and their switching points. During decoding, Norn switches plans as context length increases, overlapping computation and data transfers without knowing the output length in advance. For prefill, Norn employs operator-major chunked prefill to avoid repeated weight transfers and automatically selects the chunk size. Experiments with Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B on two single-GPU systems show up to a 16.8$\times$ speedup in end-to-end latency over Pipelined Sharding and a 4.2$\times$ speedup over its oracle variant with known input and output lengths.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 抓住离线权重/KV卸载在上下文增长下失配的关键瓶颈，问题定义准确
提出子层级联合放置与计算分配并随上下文切换计划，工程设计完整且可落地
cons: 评测范围偏窄（仅两模型两单卡平台），泛化性与稳定性证据不足，且对离线 profiling 成本与切换开销讨论有限

papers.title_zh: Norn：用于卸载 LLM 推理的权重和 KV 缓存放置的上下文长度感知优化
papers.summary_zh: 将模型权重和键值 (KV) 缓存卸载到主机内存，使大型语言模型 (LLM) 能够在单个内存受限的 GPU 上运行。随着解码过程中 KV 缓存的增长，GPU 内存需求以及 KV 缓存传输和注意力计算的成本也会发生变化。然而，现有的卸载方法通常使用静态计算分配以及模型权重和 KV 缓存的放置，导致它们无法适应这些变化并降低推理性能。我们提出 Norn，一种上下文长度感知卸载的 LLM 推理方法。基于离线分析，Norn 在子层级别共同优化计算分配和布局，预先计算多个执行计划及其切换点。在解码过程中，Norn 会随着上下文长度的增加而切换计划，从而在事先不知道输出长度的情况下重叠计算和数据传输。对于预填充，Norn 采用算子主分块预填充以避免重复权重转移并自动选择块大小。在两个单 GPU 系统上使用 Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 进行的实验表明，与 Pipelined Sharding 相比，端到端延迟最高可提升 16.8$\times$，而在输入和输出长度已知的情况下，其 Oracle 变体则可提升 4.2$\times$。

papers.title: Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused. To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. Pando employs noise-coupled pruning, which draws the target model's sampling noise before drafting and ranks candidate branches under that noise, so the tree retains the branches the target will actually sample. Noise coupling is lossless and requires no retraining or additional model pass, yet increases acceptance length by up to $8.4\%$ on Qwen3-8B. To optimize and evaluate Pando configurations across hardware, we normalize an operator-level roofline to AR decoding, reducing every platform to its ridge point. On a representative edge device, a 16-node Pando tree attains $5.3\times$ speedup and $4.2\times$ energy reduction over AR decoding: $25\%$ faster than DSpark's released chain, and $27\%$ faster and $72\%$ more energy-efficient than an EAGLE-3 tree. The best configurations remain memory-bound on every edge device we model, so added compute capacity does not reduce their latency.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法新颖且实用，但证据尚需更扎实。
pros: 提出在并行drafter上构建动态draft tree并用noise-coupled pruning，兼顾无损性与部署友好性
同时报告速度与能效收益，并给出跨硬件roofline归一化分析，工程价值较高
cons: 摘要中的提升主要来自特定模型与设备，缺少更广泛基线、公平对比和统计显著性细节

papers.title_zh: Pando：用于高效边缘推测解码的噪声耦合并行草图树
papers.summary_zh: 自回归 (AR) 解码每次前向传递都会发出一个令牌，每次都会重新加载完整模型，因此边缘设备上的 LLM 推理受内存限制，而计算单元则处于空闲状态。推测性解码通过在一次传递中验证多个起草的令牌来使空闲计算发挥作用。最先进的并行起草器（例如 DFlash 和 DSpark）在一次前向传递中提出一整块草案令牌，这使得起草计算高效。然而，它们部署的草稿链的长度受到它们所训练的块大小的限制，从而导致大部分用于验证的计算预算未被使用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Pando，它在并行绘图器之上构建动态绘图树，从而消除了这个上限。 Pando 采用噪声耦合剪枝，在起草之前绘制目标模型的采样噪声，并将候选分支排列在该噪声下，因此树保留了目标实际采样的分支。噪声耦合是无损的，不需要重新训练或额外的模型传递，但在 Qwen3-8B 上将接受长度增加了高达 $8.4\%$。为了跨硬件优化和评估 Pando 配置，我们将运营商级屋顶线标准化为 AR 解码，将每个平台减少到其山脊点。在代表性边缘设备上，16 节点 Pando 树比 AR 解码实现 $5.3\times$ 加速和 $4.2\times$ 能耗：比 DSpark 发布的链快 $25\%$，比 EAGLE-3 树快 $27\%$，节能 $72\%$。最佳配置在我们建模的每个边缘设备上仍然受到内存限制，因此增加的计算能力并不会减少其延迟。

papers.title: Mayfly: Lifecycle-Aware High-Bandwidth Flash for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets an LLM improve its agent system by proposing and evaluating candidate variants across tasks. A generation's sessions grow their KV caches together and release them as they finish, creating a burst followed by a decline. At high concurrency, even the KV of sessions ready to run exceeds the GPU's HBM. Offloading that KV to host DRAM or SSDs adds capacity but leaves ready sessions waiting for HBM space before execution. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) can serve the overflow in place, but excessive reads lengthen decode steps and repeated writes consume flash endurance. Our key insight is that where ready KV is read should follow the burst and its decline: from HBF in place while the burst overflows HBM, as much as each step's bandwidth allows, and from HBM again as the decline frees it. A switch between ready and parked decides only whether a block is read, so its flash copy stays valid, and a session's end, which the orchestrator announces, decides when its private KV dies. We present Mayfly, lifecycle-guided HBF management for RSI. Mayfly bounds per-step HBF reads during overflow and returns KV to HBM as sessions finish and free space. It retains a valid backing copy of each block evicted from HBM to avoid rewrites across state transitions, and forwards session-end signals to the controller to avoid copying dead KV during garbage collection. Experimental results show that, at 128 sessions per generation on four added HBF sites, Mayfly finishes 34% sooner than parking the same KV on HBF and 23% sooner than reading it from HBF whenever HBM is full; its gain over parking grows with concurrency, to 55% at 256 sessions on eight sites. Keeping one flash copy per block and trimming at announced session ends avoid write amplification.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用但证据仍偏摘要级。
pros: 抓住RSI负载生命周期特征，提出按阶段切换HBF/HBM读取，思路有新意且契合系统约束
同时关注时延与闪存耐久（限读、保留单副本、终止信号裁剪），工程完整性较强
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与统计稳健性信息（工作负载多样性、尾延迟、消融、公平基线与开销），因果支撑仍不足

papers.title_zh: Mayfly：生命周期感知高带宽闪存，用于递归自我改进
papers.summary_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）让法学硕士可以通过跨任务提出和评估候选变体来改进其代理系统。一代会话将其 KV 缓存一起增长，并在完成后释放它们，从而产生爆发，然后下降。在高并发的情况下，甚至准备运行的会话的KV也超过了GPU的HBM。将该 KV 卸载到主机 DRAM 或 SSD 会增加容量，但会导致就绪会话在执行前等待 HBM 空间。高带宽闪存 (HBF) 可以就地解决溢出问题，但过多的读取会延长解码步骤，并且重复写入会消耗闪存的耐用性。我们的主要见解是，读取就绪 KV 的位置应遵循突发及其下降：在突发溢出 HBM 时从原位的 HBF 读取，只要每个步骤的带宽允许，然后在下降释放它时再次从 HBM 读取。就绪和停放之间的切换仅决定是否读取块，因此其闪存副本保持有效，而编排器宣布的会话结束决定其私有 KV 何时终止。我们推出 Mayfly，针对 RSI 的生命周期引导 HBF 管理。 Mayfly 在溢出期间限制每步 HBF 读取，并在会话完成并释放空间时将 KV 返回到 HBM。它保留从 HBM 逐出的每个块的有效备份副本，以避免跨状态转换的重写，并将会话结束信号转发到控制器，以避免在垃圾收集期间复制死 KV。实验结果表明，在四个添加的 HBF 站点上，每代 128 个会话，当 HBM 已满时，Mayfly 比在 HBF 上停放相同的 KV 快 34%，比从 HBF 读取它快 23%；它在停车方面的优势随着并发性的增加而增长，在 8 个站点上的 256 个会话中，其优势达到 55%。每个块保留一个闪存副本并在宣布的会话结束时进行修剪，以避免写入放大。

papers.title: Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion
papers.summary: Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. SAMR debiases in-flight KV with offline-calibrated per-head affine maps in Pre-RoPE space, fuses the two estimates, and reserves true $t=0$ refreshes for tokens flagged by an attention-readout error proxy, all executed by tile-aligned, synchronization-free Triton kernels. On 48-second LongLive-1.3B videos, SAMR reduces DiT latency by 20.9% and principal FLOPs by 30.7% relative to dense KV updates, lowers downstream denoising steps, and improves final-quarter PSNR over token reuse by 1.61 dB (1.14 dB on held-out VidProM-16). The reconstruction also transfers to frozen Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B: zero-shot, it reduces reuse-induced step inflation ($2.47 \to 2.30$ steps/token) and improves late PSNR by $+0.33$ dB, and a one-time training-free calibration recovers the diagnostic score that zero-shot transfer lowers ($89.62 \to 91.10$).

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用，但泛化证据仍偏有限。
pros: 准确识别“省内存算力反噬”机制，并提出模型与内核协同优化思路
训练免费且含跨模型迁移结果，速度、FLOPs与后段画质指标提升较全面
cons: 当前证据主要来自少数模型与场景，离线校准与误差代理的稳健性和部署成本仍需更强验证
摘要未体现与更强基线及关键消融细节，因果归因与统计显著性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: 廉价的内存成本未来的计算：共同设计持久 KV 和 GPU 执行以实现高效的流视频扩散
papers.summary_zh: 块因果视频扩散以持久键值 (KV) 缓存为条件，逐块生成长视频。每个块去噪后，额外的无噪声（$t=0$）前向传递将其干净的 KV 写入缓存；一旦蒸馏和推测性提前退出使去噪变得便宜，这种干净的 KV 更新就会在运行时占据主导地位。重用过时的 KV 会缩短更新时间，但过时的内存会破坏后续块的调节并夸大其去噪步骤，因此保存的计算会重新出现在下游。我们提出了 SAMR（逐步感知内存重建），这是一种用于冻结因果视频 DiT 的免训练方法，它仅刷新部分缓存并重建其余部分，而无需 DiT 转发。我们的主要观察结果是，一旦旋转位置阶段被移除，运动对齐的历史 KV 和令牌在其退出步骤中持有的飞行中 KV 是对其干净 KV 的补充估计。 SAMR 在 Pre-RoPE 空间中使用离线校准的每头仿射图对飞行中的 KV 进行去偏，融合两个估计，并为由注意读出错误代理标记的令牌保留真正的 $t=0$ 刷新，所有这些都由平铺对齐、无同步的 Triton 内核执行。在 48 秒的 LongLive-1.3B 视频中，相对于密集 KV 更新，SAMR 将 DiT 延迟降低了 20.9%，主要 FLOP 降低了 30.7%，降低了下游去噪步骤，并将令牌重用的最后季度 PSNR 提高了 1.61 dB（在保留的 VidProM-16 上为 1.14 dB）。重建还转移到冻结的 Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B：零样本，它减少了重用引起的步长膨胀（2.47 美元到 2.30 美元步数/令牌），并将后期 PSNR 提高了 +0.33 美元 dB，一次性免训练校准恢复了零样本转移降低的诊断分数（89.62 美元到 91.10 美元）。

papers.title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agentic benchmarks, and by 9.6%, 14.3% and 28.9% on SPEED-Bench long-context prompts. On Qwen3.8-27B it leads DFlash2, DSpark and xPress by 7.6%, 10.6% and 5.0%, and by 7.4%, 5.8% and 6.0% on the same long-context prompts. The gains persist as serving load grows to concurrency 32.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但方法创新中等且证据待补强
pros: 抓住现有并行草稿器瓶颈，提出“弱基座+强修正”思路较务实
覆盖多模型与长上下文并报告高并发表现，系统落地性较强
cons: 核心技术多为已有组件重组，理论新颖性与机制解释有限
摘要缺少统计显著性、消融细节与质量-速度权衡证据

papers.title_zh: Wavefront：具有并行因果细化的低阶起草，用于推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过让廉价的起草者提出目标模型并行验证的标记来加速 LLM 推理。 DFlash 和 P-EAGLE 等并行区块起草者在一次前向传递中提出了整个区块，但它们失去了区块中代币之间的依赖关系； DSpark 通过按顺序运行的轻型校正头来恢复其中的一部分。通过测量 DSpark，我们发现该头会覆盖大多数插槽上的基本预测，因此通过目标的完整 lm_head 进行的昂贵的基本读出主要提供种子。因此，我们提出了Wavefront，它遵循一个简单的原则：缩小底座并加强校正头。 Wavefront 用学习的低阶基替换完整的 lm_head，在同一块内的整个起草的前缀上调节校正头，并通过一些并行雅可比传递来解析它。固定的传递预算使草稿步骤不受数据相关的控制流的影响，因此我们将其捕获为带有融合内核的 vLLM 中的单个 CUDA 图。在 Qwen3-8B 上，与 xPress、DSpark 和 DFlash 相比，Wavefront 在数学、代码、聊天和代理基准测试中的吞吐量平均提高了 2.6%、10.7% 和 23.6%，在 SPEED-Bench 长上下文提示中提高了 9.6%、14.3% 和 28.9%。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，它领先 DFlash2、DSpark 和 xPress 7.6%、10.6% 和 5.0%，在相同的长上下文提示上领先 7.4%、5.8% 和 6.0%。随着服务负载增长到并发数 32，这种收益会持续存在。

papers.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
papers.summary: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models, we find that \emph{order-sensitivity} is pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation and unreliable decision-making. These effects become more pronounced as the number of options grows and can compound across multi-step decisions. To address this problem, we systematically compare eight methods for mitigating order sensitivity in terms of robustness, predictive accuracy, and inference efficiency. Among these methods, we find that \emph{tree attention} is a surprisingly effective and efficient method. It achieves order invariance by processing options as parallel branches of a shared context. When used during training, it matches the baseline's average accuracy. Applied to the baseline without retraining, it also eliminates order sensitivity with only a 1.1-point drop in accuracy. Our findings demonstrate that order invariance can be enforced directly in decision models with little or no loss in predictive accuracy.

papers.title_zh: 降低决策模型中的阶次敏感性
papers.summary_zh: 决策模型正在成为大型人工智能系统的快速组件。然而，最近的决策模型（例如 Jev）会按顺序处理选项，从而根据选项的顺序产生不同的预测。在十个开源和闭源决策模型中，我们发现\emph{顺序敏感性}普遍存在，导致准确性大幅下降和决策不可靠。随着选项数量的增加，这些影响变得更加明显，并且可以在多步骤决策中复合。为了解决这个问题，我们在鲁棒性、预测准确性和推理效率方面系统地比较了八种减轻顺序敏感性的方法。在这些方法中，我们发现 \emph{tree Attention} 是一种令人惊讶的有效且高效的方法。它通过将选项处理为共享上下文的并行分支来实现顺序不变性。在训练期间使用时，它与基线的平均准确度相匹配。应用于基线而无需重新训练，它还消除了顺序敏感性，准确度仅下降了 1.1 点。我们的研究结果表明，顺序不变性可以直接在决策模型中强制执行，而预测准确性几乎没有损失。

papers.title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.

papers.title_zh: 回顾过去，展望未来：并行推测解码的纠正前缀注意
papers.summary_zh: 并行推测解码器一次提出整个令牌块，但早期的不一致可能会导致目标拒绝其剩余后缀。我们引入了纠正性前缀注意（CPA），它将前缀感知选择与自回归监督相结合，以改进这些并行草案。 CPA 让每位候选人参与该区块内的早期选择。固定候选候选名单允许在选择之前计算所有成对交互，从而减少顺序查找表、积累和轻量级评分，而不是重复的神经评估。辅助自回归损失在干净的前缀上训练共享骨干网，而无需添加推理过程。在 Ascend NPU 上以 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 为目标的八个数学、代码和对话基准测试中，CPA 在每轮验证中承诺的代币比 DSpark 多 13--15%，比 DFlash 多 25--26%。在贪婪解码下，其平均加速达到 $3.35\times$ 和 $3.37\times$，在采样下两个目标的平均加速达到 $2.86\times$。消融支持这两个组件，而容量扫描表明，仅靠更高的接受度并不能保证更快的解码。这些结果激励用因果信息纠正并行提议，同时保持顺序计算的成本低廉。

papers.title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, median paired publication speedups over full-history re-prefill average $68.98\times$ across five runs for 32 active sessions with 8K tokens each. Serving benchmarks show approximately 4.8% decoding overhead relative to native cached decoding. Compared with retained-boundary replay, compact retention gives a $3.42\times$ reduction in additional session storage at 8K, with similar measured publication-plus-decoding cost. LiveLora allows persistent LLM agents to adopt new adapter versions without replaying their full interaction histories.

papers.title_zh: LiveLoRA：LLM 代理跨 LoRA 更新的精确 KV 缓存迁移
papers.summary_zh: 更新 LLM 适配器不需要重播每个活动会话的完整交互历史记录。然而，重用在早期版本下计算的键值 (KV) 缓存条目会混合模型版本，而随着历史记录和会话队列的增长，完整历史记录重新预填充的成本也越来越高。我们推出了 LiveLora，这是一种模型运行时协同设计，用于精确的最终块 KV 缓存迁移。冻结的较低解码器块和固定的 K/V 适配器下投影保留了每个令牌的基础投影和跨适配器版本的低等级坐标。运行时重建候选 K/V，通过最终块重新评估最新令牌，并将适配器、缓存和下一个令牌日志一起提交。我们在所述模型假设下以精确算术证明了与完整历史重新预填充的连续等效性。在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，在 32 个活跃会话（每个会话有 8K 代币）的 5 次运行中，配对发布速度的中位数比完整历史记录重新预填充的平均速度为 68.98 美元\次$。服务基准测试显示，相对于本机缓存解码，解码开销大约为 4.8%。与保留边界重放相比，紧凑保留可将 8K 的额外会话存储减少 3.42 倍，同时测量的发布加解码成本也类似。 LiveLora 允许持久的 LLM 代理采用新的适配器版本，而无需重播其完整的交互历史记录。

papers.title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
papers.summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

papers.title_zh: 测试量化 KV-Cache 维护：编码布局和历史恢复
papers.summary_zh: 尽管编码计数相同，但重复行然后选择原始数据仍会保留布局相关的漂移。我们测量现有检查何时无法在固定量化 KV 缓存实现中建立保存契约。在十六个周期的四位 HQQ 零轴中，相对于相同形状重新编码，中值配对相对 L2 增加对于 Qwen3-1.7B 为 7.22 个百分点，对于 SmolLM3-3B 为 11.59 个百分点。匹配的编码状态涵盖每个模型在 1 次和 16 次循环时的 16 个共享问题。第一轴与形状保持控制相匹配；惰性重新排序保留初始状态。在一个已知输入上，固定更新计数保留差异；保留组成员会将其删除。我们的前缀视图扩展通过了当前前缀检查，但在剩余容量为 4 和 128 的情况下更改了六种模型/编解码器设置中的历史记录和下一个 logits。公共查找达到了此边界，包括四个预先提交的项目新 GPU 输入之一；固定查询交换隔离了条件旧历史效应。检查点/密集回滚是准确的。显式延迟查找客户端承认在一​​个已知上下文中本机 AR 排除了受支持的 129 个令牌路径。失败的任务危害扩展排除了群体失败率或一般答案退化的说法。本机 MLX-LM 装置会暴露过时的调用者缓存；同步恢复了测试的就地合约，并保留了本机计算。在拒绝测试中，过时的调用者会更改 logits，但不会更改贪婪标记。

papers.title: CGSpec: Consistency-Guided Speculative Decoding with Overlap-Aware Verification Scheduling for Edge-Cloud Inference
papers.summary: Collaborative speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by enabling edge clients to draft tokens locally and a shared cloud model to verify them. However, draft target disagreement wastes communication and verification resources, while heterogeneous client return times complicate shared verifier scheduling. We propose CGSpec, a consistency guided framework for multi client edge-cloud speculative decoding. CGSpec uses draft target distribution divergence to adapt the speculative budget and introduces a nomination and competition mechanism to construct candidate trees through global growth control and local token selection. An overlap-aware scheduler further estimates remaining verification work and client return times to prioritize requests and improve verifier utilization. We evaluate CGSpec using four model pairs and three datasets under heterogeneous network conditions. Across 24 configurations with 8 and 16 clients, CGSpec achieves the highest mean system and client throughput among the evaluated methods. Compared with current SOTA methods, it improves system throughput by 12.2\% and 10.2\%, and mean client throughput by 14.0\% and 33.0\%, respectively.

papers.title_zh: CGSpec：用于边缘云推理的具有重叠感知验证调度的一致性引导推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 协作推测解码通过使边缘客户端能够在本地起草令牌并使用共享云模型来验证它们来加速大型语言模型推理。然而，草案目标不一致会浪费通信和验证资源，而异构客户端返回时间使共享验证者调度变得复杂。我们提出了 CGSpec，这是一种用于多客户端边缘云推测解码的一致性引导框架。 CGSpec 使用草案目标分布差异来适应投机预算，并引入提名和竞争机制，通过全局增长控制和本地代币选择来构建候选树。重叠感知调度程序进一步估计剩余验证工作和客户端返回时间，以对请求进行优先级排序并提高验证程序利用率。我们在异构网络条件下使用四个模型对和三个数据集来评估 CGSpec。在具有 8 和 16 个客户端的 24 种配置中，CGSpec 在评估的方法中实现了最高的平均系统和客户端吞吐量。与现有的SOTA方法相比，系统吞吐量分别提高了12.2%和10.2%，平均客户端吞吐量分别提高了14.0%和33.0%。

papers.title: ANOR: Scaling Sparse Attention with a GPU-PNM Computing Hierarchy
papers.summary: Serving large language models with long contexts requires keeping the key-value (KV) cache of every request, which can exceed GPU memory capacity. Sparse attention reads only a small, query-dependent subset of this cache at each decoding step, yet must retain the full cache because later steps may select other entries. Processing-near-memory (PNM) devices attached through Compute Express Link (CXL) can hold the full cache and compute attention where it resides. Prior GPU-PNM systems for sparse attention are PNM-centric, processing most of the attention on the PNM. As existing CXL-PNM devices provide far less memory bandwidth than GPU HBM, this PNM-centric execution makes the PNM the bottleneck and leaves the GPU idle waiting for attention results. We present ANOR, a GPU-PNM joint acceleration system that exploits the selection locality of sparse attention by computing most of the attention on the GPU from a cache of recently selected entries and processing only the misses on the PNM. As the PNM processes cache misses directly, GPU cache updates can be decoupled from current-step execution. We develop a bounded cache-update policy that limits updates to the point where the hit ratio of later steps saturates, reducing GPU-facing link traffic. We add a small on-chip Early Streaming Buffer (ESB) that captures KV data during PNM attention and streams it to the GPU, avoiding most redundant DRAM reads despite the bandwidth mismatch between PNM memory and the GPU-facing link. We also propose an adaptive cache-factor mechanism that adjusts GPU cache size to the serving load, balancing hit ratio and batch size. Across two models and three long-context agentic workloads, ANOR improves decode throughput by 2.3x over HiSparse and 2.0x over a PNM baseline on average. These results show that PNM is most effective not as the primary attention engine but as a computing tier of the GPU memory hierarchy.

papers.title_zh: ANOR：使用 GPU-PNM 计算层次结构扩展稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 为具有长上下文的大型语言模型提供服务需要保留每个请求的键值 (KV) 缓存，这可能会超出 GPU 内存容量。稀疏注意力在每个解码步骤中仅读取该缓存的一个小的、依赖于查询的子集，但必须保留完整的缓存，因为后面的步骤可能会选择其他条目。通过 Compute Express Link (CXL) 连接的处理近内存 (PNM) 设备可以在其所在位置保存完整的缓存和计算注意力。先前用于稀疏注意力的 GPU-PNM 系统是以 PNM 为中心的，在 PNM 上处理大部分注意力。由于现有的 CXL-PNM 设备提供的内存带宽远低于 GPU HBM，这种以 PNM 为中心的执行使 PNM 成为瓶颈，并使 GPU 空闲等待注意力结果。我们提出了 ANOR，一种 GPU-PNM 联合加速系统，它通过从最近选择的条目的缓存中计算 GPU 上的大部分注意力并仅处理 PNM 上的未命中，来利用稀疏注意力的选择局部性。由于 PNM 直接处理缓存未命中，GPU 缓存更新可以与当前步骤执行解耦。我们开发了一种有界缓存更新策略，将更新限制到后续步骤的命中率饱和的程度，从而减少面向 GPU 的链接流量。我们添加了一个小型片上早期流缓冲器 (ESB)，它在 PNM 关注期间捕获 KV 数据并将其流式传输到 GPU，从而避免大多数冗余 DRAM 读取，尽管 PNM 内存和面向 GPU 的链路之间的带宽不匹配。我们还提出了一种自适应缓存因子机制，可以根据服务负载调整 GPU 缓存大小，平衡命中率和批量大小。在两个模型和三个长上下文代理工作负载中，ANOR 的解码吞吐量平均比 HiSparse 提高了 2.3 倍，比 PNM 基线提高了 2.0 倍。这些结果表明，PNM 最有效的不是作为主要注意力引擎，而是作为 GPU 内存层次结构的计算层。

papers.title: Time Series Foundation Models on the Edge
papers.summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast zero-shot with accuracy exceeding that of task-specific models, and the smaller ones fit on edge devices. Operational deployments must refresh their forecast as new observations arrive, and privacy and latency requirements often force this refresh onto resource-constrained edge devices. To serve as a forecasting system there, a TSFM must refresh quickly, keep latency and peak memory bounded as the stream grows, and retain its accuracy as the observed history accumulates. Refreshing incrementally without altering the forecast requires temporal causality: non-causal models recompute at every update, causal attention admits a KV cache that grows linearly, and causal recurrent models update a fixed-size state in constant time and memory. We make these states persist across refreshes for every causal architecture and verify equivalence to full recomputation. We evaluate nine TSFM configurations on univariate forecasting against all three requirements, measuring accuracy as a function of context length, single-refresh latency, and latency and memory on streams of up to one million time steps on a server-grade GPU and three edge devices. No model gains on average accuracy beyond its trained context and most lose it well before the full history is reached, while KV caches leave latency and memory growing linearly with the retained history. TiRex-2 is the only one of the nine configurations meeting all three requirements: it refreshes in 14 ms on the GPU and 120 ms on a Raspberry Pi 5, keeps latency, energy and peak memory constant over a million steps, and retains its accuracy on the untruncated history.

papers.title_zh: 边缘的时间序列基础模型
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 预测零样本的精度超过特定任务模型，并且较小的模型适合边缘设备。随着新观察的到来，运营部署必须刷新其预测，而隐私和延迟要求通常迫使资源受限的边缘设备进行这种刷新。为了充当那里的预测系统，TSFM 必须快速刷新，随着流的增长限制延迟和峰值内存，并随着观察到的历史记录的积累保持其准确性。在不改变预测的情况下增量刷新需要时间因果关系：非因果模型在每次更新时重新计算，因果注意力允许线性增长的 KV 缓存，因果循环模型在恒定的时间和内存中更新固定大小的状态。我们使这些状态在每个因果架构的刷新过程中持续存在，并验证与完全重新计算的等效性。我们根据所有三个要求评估了单变量预测的九个 TSFM 配置，测量了作为上下文长度、单次刷新延迟以及服务器级 GPU 和三个边缘设备上高达一百万个时间步的流上的延迟和内存的函数的准确性。没有任何模型能够获得超出其训练上下文的平均准确度，并且大多数模型在达到完整历史记录之前就失去了平均准确度，而 KV 缓存使延迟和内存随着保留的历史记录线性增长。 TiRex-2 是九种配置中唯一满足所有三个要求的一种：它在 GPU 上的刷新时间为 14 毫秒，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上的刷新时间为 120 毫秒，在超过一百万步时保持延迟、能量和峰值内存恒定，并在未截断的历史记录中保持其准确性。

papers.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
papers.summary: Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. We present PackLoop, built on one principle: speculate only inside rows that are read anyway. Deep loops accumulate positions and advance them as a block in one row, context-copy proposals join the row that the first loop already reads, and a closed-form admission rule, the economic order quantity of inventory theory, sets how long to accumulate from a cost model calibrated once per engine. PackLoop is exact: in FP32 its output is token-for-token identical to autoregressive decoding, also under sampling and early exit. Across 164 load points spanning three GPUs, four Ouro models, six benchmarks, and contexts up to 32K tokens, one PackLoop configuration is faster than the best existing schedule, chosen per point, at 161 points (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x) and never significantly slower. Its lead grows with concurrency and context length, the regime in which existing self-speculation gains least.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法实用且在高并发下价值突出。
pros: 将并发瓶颈从“是否投机”转到“行级布局”，提出清晰且有新意的视角
实验覆盖面广（多GPU/模型/负载/长上下文），且在目标场景下增益稳定
cons: 对跨引擎泛化与校准成本依赖较强，且“精确性”主要在FP32声明，混合精度与极端系统扰动下的稳健性仍需更多证据

papers.title_zh: PackLoop：并发下循环语言模型的行打包自推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型对每个令牌重用一个权重块 T 次，用参数换取测试时间深度，但自回归解码则为每个令牌支付 T 次顺序传递。自推测解码器对于单个请求可以恢复 2-10 倍，但随着请求共享 GPU，它们的增益会逐渐减弱，而当前的做法是随着负载的增长而推测得更少。我们表明，在负载下失败的是推测性工作的布局，而不是推测。在并发解码中，成本单位是行，一个请求在一个循环中前进，该请求读取该循环的键值 (KV) 缓存一次；一行内的额外位置几乎是免费的。诸如波前之类的流水线调度将每个推测位置放置在不同的循环上，因此位于其自己的一行中，因此每个令牌仍然被读取 T 次。我们提出 PackLoop，它建立在一个原则之上：仅推测无论如何都会读取的内部行。深度循环累积头寸并将其作为一行块推进，上下文复制提案加入第一个循环已读取的行，闭式准入规则（库存理论的经济订单数量）设置从每个引擎校准一次的成本模型累积的时间。 PackLoop 是精确的：在 FP32 中，它的输出逐个令牌与自回归解码相同，也在采样和提前退出下。在跨越 3 个 GPU、4 个 Ouro 模型、6 个基准测试和高达 32K 代币的上下文的 164 个负载点中，一个 PackLoop 配置比按点选择的 161 个点（中值 1.25 倍，最高 1.76 倍）的最佳现有调度更快，并且从未显着变慢。它的领先优势随着并发性和上下文长度的增加而增加，在这种情况下，现有的自我推测收益最少。

papers.title: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
papers.summary: A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy streams are worse (7% slower prefill). On five 7B-32B models, repeated runs show no significant accuracy difference from BF16 KV. In Qwen2-family models, whose reasoning variants collapse under FP8 KV, layer 0's key mean is almost entirely the key-projection bias identified by prior work, seen through RoPE and computable from the weights alone; keeping that layer in BF16 restores FP8 KV and, with K mean removal, 4-bit KV.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程洞察扎实，性能收益显著，具备顶会竞争力。
pros: 准确定位4-bit KV在Hopper上的瓶颈并给出体系结构匹配的内核设计，技术贡献具体且有解释力
实验覆盖微基准、端到端吞吐与SLO场景，并报告跨模型加速与容量收益，应用价值高
cons: 结论较依赖Hopper与特定栈（vLLM/FlashInfer），对其他GPU代际与实现的泛化性、复现细节及精度边界仍需更充分验证

papers.title_zh: Hopper GPU 上的快速 4 位 KV 缓存解码：为什么现有内核速度慢以及如何修复它们
papers.summary_zh: 4 位 KV 缓存可读取 FP8 的大约一半字节，但 Hopper GPU 没有 FP4 硬件，并且内存带宽的每字节指令发出能力很小，因此必须在软件中对 4 位值进行解码。在 H200 上，vLLM 的 NVFP4 KV 路径（FlashInfer 的解码）达到内存带宽的 10-20%，并且比 FP8 慢 1.7 倍。 NVBit 指令计数显示两个原因：vLLM 4 位路径（FlashInfer NVFP4、Triton UltraQuant）背后的内核每字节执行 2-6 倍 Hopper 的问题预算，并串行化加载、解码和矩阵乘法。我们的 Hopper 原生解码内核将 TMA 生成器扭曲与两个计算扭曲组重叠，在写入时布置缓存，以便解码值从寄存器馈送到张量核心，并交换矩阵操作数，以便小型查询组不需要填充。在 H200 上，它在第 32-128 个批次和所有 11 个形状中达到峰值带宽的 67-75%，比 XQA 和 FlashAttention-4 提出的原生 FP8 的速度快 1.12-1.49 倍。在 vLLM 内部，采用准确度配方（K 均值去除和旋转、4 个 BF16 接收器令牌、BF16 第 0 层），在第 8 批及以上批处理时，Llama-3.1-8B 上的每步解码速度比 vLLM 的 FlashInfer FP8 路径快 1.12-1.64 倍（比 FlashAttention-4 的 FP8 快 1.04-1.24 倍），在第 1 批处理时处于水平状态，并保持1.63 倍的代币数量。在类似推理的请求流下的一台 H200 上，99% 的请求满足延迟目标的最高比率是 Llama-3.1-8B 上的 1.23-1.32 倍 FP8 和 Qwen2.5-72B 上的 1.67-2.20 倍，因为缓存已成为限制；预填充量大的流更差（预填充速度慢 7%）。在五个 7B-32B 模型上，重复运行表明与 BF16 KV 的精度没有显着差异。在 Qwen2 系列模型中，其推理变体在 FP8 KV 下崩溃，第 0 层的关键均值几乎完全是先前工作确定的关键投影偏差，通过 RoPE 查看并可仅根据权重进行计算；将该层保留在 BF16 中可恢复 FP8 KV，并通过 K 均值去除恢复 4 位 KV。

papers.title: Measuring GPU Memory Traffic on the NVIDIA GB10 Without C2C Telemetry
papers.summary: The NVIDIA GB10, used in the DGX Spark and in desktop AI systems from several vendors, joins an Arm CPU die and a Blackwell GPU die with NVLink C2C. The GPU has no local memory, so every GPU access that misses in its L2 cache crosses C2C to the LPDDR5X attached to the CPU die. Yet the software on the systems we tested exposes no counter for this traffic. We show that five L2 sector counters of the GPU, sampled every 10 ms through NVIDIA's CUPTI sampling interface by a process that does not attach to the workload, measure GPU memory traffic live and separate copy engine traffic from the read misses and writes of GPU kernels. For large streaming transfers of known size, the counters agree within 0.28% on an Acer GN100 and within 0.005% on a DGX Spark, track the volume moved regardless of how it is split into copies, and exclude data reused in L2. The GPU's SMMU counter, a natural alternative, counts address translations rather than bytes. Applied to an unmodified server, the method shows Mistral 7B decode reading 13.47 GiB per token, the weights it uses plus its key value (KV) cache, at 83% of the memory bandwidth NVIDIA specifies. We release the method as an open source tool.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但方法新颖性中等偏上。
pros: 在缺失官方C2C遥测下提出可在线复现实用测量方案
验证充分且误差极低，并展示对真实LLM推理瓶颈的解释力
cons: 贡献以计数器重构与实证为主，理论与跨架构泛化边界仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: 在不使用 C2C 遥测的情况下测量 NVIDIA GB10 上的 GPU 内存流量
papers.summary_zh: NVIDIA GB10 用于 DGX Spark 和多家供应商的桌面 AI 系统，将 Arm CPU 芯片和 Blackwell GPU 芯片与 NVLink C2C 结合在一起。 GPU 没有本地内存，因此 L2 缓存中丢失的每个 GPU 访问都会通过 C2C 到达连接到 CPU 芯片的 LPDDR5X。然而，我们测试的系统上的软件没有公开针对此流量的计数器。我们展示了 GPU 的 5 个 L2 扇区计数器，通过 NVIDIA 的 CUPTI 采样接口，通过不附加到工作负载的进程每 10 毫秒采样一次，实时测量 GPU 内存流量，并将复制引擎流量与 GPU 内核的读取未命中和写入分开。对于已知大小的大型流传输，计数器在 Acer GN100 上的误差在 0.28% 以内，在 DGX Spark 上的误差在 0.005% 以内，跟踪移动的卷，无论它如何分割成副本，并排除在 L2 中重用的数据。 GPU 的 SMMU 计数器是一个自然的替代方案，它计算地址转换而不是字节。该方法应用于未经修改的服务器，显示 Mistral 7B 解码每个令牌读取 13.47 GiB、其使用的权重加上其键值 (KV) 缓存，为 NVIDIA 指定的内存带宽的 83%。我们将该方法作为开源工具发布。

papers.title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
papers.summary: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch invariant kernels all seven exact features, speculative decoding included, reproduce the reference text on every request, while the FP8 KV cache still flips 3.91% (3.28 to 4.53) of graded outcomes. A gate that compares against a single replica pair rejected an unchanged configuration, so we recommend certifying a serving change under batch invariant kernels, where the floor is zero, or against a scheduling floor measured from at least three replicas.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433980

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，证据扎实但外推仍有限。
pros: 提出“调度噪声下限”作为评测基线，纠正仅看总体准确率的盲点
实验设计较完整：多配置、多副本、置信区间与对照地板清晰
cons: 仅覆盖单一4B模型与vLLM场景，跨模型/框架与更大规模负载的结论外推性不足

papers.title_zh: 纸上谈兵：哪个法学硕士服务捷径会翻转评分答案，以重新排序相同请求的噪音为衡量标准
papers.summary_zh: 在检查基准准确性未改变后，团队启用前缀缓存、分块预填充和推测解码等服务功能，因为引擎将它们记录为准确的。准确性是一个聚合，因此一个功能可以在翻转哪些请求得到正确响应的同时保持它。我们在 vLLM 中的 9 个单一功能配置和 5 个参考配置副本下提供一个 4B 指令模型，在每次运行中对来自 5 个基准的 3,380 个请求进行评分，并将每个候选与重新启动层（新进程）和调度层（不同顺序的相同请求）进行比较。使用默认内核，每个配置都将准确性保持在一个点以内，七个精确功能将请求的分级结果翻转为 1.47%（95% CI 1.13 至 1.85）至 1.78%（1.39 至 2.20），没有一个高于 1.72% 的调度下限，而 FP8 KV 缓存翻转 3.36%（2.80 至 3.96），与 FP8 一样多重量。借助批量不变内核，所有七个精确功能（包括推测解码）都会在每个请求上重现参考文本，而 FP8 KV 缓存仍会翻转 3.91%（3.28 至 4.53）的分级结果。与单个副本对进行比较的门拒绝未更改的配置，因此我们建议在批处理不变内核（下限为零）下验证服务更改，或者根据从至少三个副本测量的调度下限进行验证。

papers.title: Gossamer: A Utility-Driven Architecture for Constant-Budget KV Cache Compression in Reasoning LLMs
papers.summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to complex reasoning tasks, yet their inference efficiency is fundamentally constrained by the rapid growth of the KV cache. As reasoning contexts extend to hundreds of thousands of tokens, the key-value (KV) cache becomes the dominant contributor to both memory footprint and bandwidth demand, tightly coupling computation with memory utilization and thereby limiting scalability. Existing compression methods, such as quantization and eviction, alleviate capacity pressure but remain purely algorithmic, often introducing additional passes and compute overhead that reduce system efficiency. This paper presents Gossamer, a KV cache compression architecture for reasoning LLMs that bridges the algorithm--system--hardware gap. Gossamer introduces a unified utility-based action framework that dynamically selects compression operations, quantization, merging, or eviction, under a constant KV cache budget. Through cross-domain co-design, we fuse cosine-similarity estimation directly into the attention computation, exploiting idle compute cycles to perform similarity evaluation without latency or bandwidth cost. We call this mechanism Free-Lunch Utilization. This enables real-time, fine-grained KV management with near-constant memory usage and negligible overhead. Under tight memory constraints, Gossamer sustains reasoning quality comparable to uncompressed inference while improving end-to-end throughput by up to 16.7$\times$ over uncompressed baselines, 5.5$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ over the quantization-based Oaken and Ecco, and 1.8$\times$ over the eviction-based R-KV.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、思路新颖，但实证可信度待验证。
pros: 面向长推理场景的常预算KV压缩，目标明确且价值高
提出算法-系统-硬件协同与“Free-Lunch”融合机制，工程创新度较强
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与开销分解，16.7×增益的可复现性和普适性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: Gossamer：推理 LLM 中用于恒定预算 KV 缓存压缩的实用程序驱动架构
papers.summary_zh: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于复杂的推理任务，但其推理效率从根本上受到KV缓存快速增长的限制。随着推理上下文扩展到数十万个令牌，键值 (KV) 缓存成为内存占用和带宽需求的主要贡献者，将计算与内存利用率紧密耦合，从而限制了可扩展性。现有的压缩方法（例如量化和驱逐）可以减轻容量压力，但仍然纯粹是算法性的，通常会引入额外的通道和计算开销，从而降低系统效率。本文提出了 Gossamer，一种用于推理 LLM 的 KV 缓存压缩架构，它弥补了算法-系统-硬件之间的差距。 Gossamer 引入了一个基于实用程序的统一操作框架，可以在恒定的 KV 缓存预算下动态选择压缩操作、量化、合并或逐出。通过跨域协同设计，我们将余弦相似度估计直接融合到注意力计算中，利用空闲计算周期来执行相似度评估，而无需延迟或带宽成本。我们将这种机制称为“免费午餐利用”。这可以实现实时、细粒度的 KV 管理，并且内存使用量接近恒定，开销可以忽略不计。在严格的内存限制下，Gossamer 保持了与未压缩推理相当的推理质量，同时与未压缩基线相比，端到端吞吐量提高了 16.7$\times$，比基于量化的 Oaken 和 Ecco 提高了 5.5$\times$ 和 4.9$\times$，比基于驱逐的 R-KV 提高了 1.8$\times$。

papers.title: FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective
papers.summary: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. Experiments on three widely used VLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that FP-Prune outperforms baseline methods in both accuracy and inference efficiency. Further analysis shows that the surrogate objective closely aligns with model performance. Our work provides theoretical grounding and an effective method for visual token pruning.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 视角新颖且实用，但理论与泛化证据仍需加强。
pros: 以信息增益重述视觉token剪枝，问题定义更本质
提出免训练方法并在多模型多数据集报告精度与效率双提升
cons: 理论代理关系的成立条件与误差界在摘要中不充分，严格性存疑
缺少对极端压缩率、长尾场景和跨架构泛化稳定性的证据

papers.title_zh: FP-Prune：从信息增益的角度重新思考视觉标记修剪
papers.summary_zh: 视觉标记剪枝可以降低视觉语言模型的推理成本，但其有效性取决于在有限的标记预算下保留互补的视觉信息。一个核心挑战是量化候选标记在保留集之外贡献的附加信息，这是基于注意力或相似性的传统评分难以直接捕获的贡献。在这项工作中，我们从信息增益的角度重新审视视觉令牌剪枝，并使用互信息来表征候选令牌的增量价值。我们进一步从理论上确立框架势能作为互信息的有效替代品。基于这一观察，我们提出了 FP-Prune，一种免训练的视觉标记修剪方法，它迭代地删除信息增益低的标记，以保留尽可能多的互补视觉信息。在三个广泛使用的 VLM 和八个数据集上进行的实验表明，FP-Prune 在准确性和推理效率方面均优于基线方法。进一步的分析表明，替代目标与模型性能密切相关。我们的工作为视觉标记修剪提供了理论基础和有效方法。

papers.title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
papers.summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义前沿，效果亮眼，但证据仍偏摘要层面。
pros: 将知识管理与实验决策闭环结合，定位了serving调优中的真实痛点
给出多维对比与跨任务结果，显示出较好的样本效率和可迁移性
cons: 当前仅凭摘要难判断统计检验、消融完整性与真实系统开销，外部有效性仍有风险

papers.title_zh: NoeVera：知识可以指导实验并且实验可以提炼知识吗？
papers.summary_zh: 随着对大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务的需求不断增长，优化 LLM 服务系统变得越来越复杂，并且瓶颈不再是预测给定配置的执行方式。更困难的问题是决定调查什么：哪些机制对工作负载很重要，哪些配置值得测试，以及决策仍然需要哪些证据。在这项工作中，我们提出了 NoeVera，一种代理第二大脑，它超越了一次性检索，将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果转变为持久的、保留来源的知识库，具有三个层面：源证据、可重用合成和代理记忆。决策感知检索会组装紧凑的证据包，特定角色的代理对它们进行推理，并在需要定量支持时调用模拟器（Vidur 或 GAUSS），并且每个发现都会作为范围证据记录写回，因此知识指导实验并通过实验完善知识。在四种服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera 在 6-7 次模拟器调用的中位数中与最佳值相差 5% 以内，而使用相同工具的贝叶斯优化为 9 次，无知识代理为 15 次；在 A100 GPU 上，其代表性配置可提供约 1.30 倍的 vLLM 默认吞吐量，并满足每种场景的延迟目标。当重复使用时，保留来源的证据记录仅对 8% 的适用性陷阱进行过度概括，而通用代理内存的这一比例为 28%。在 72 任务基准的保留 48 任务拆分中，NoeVera 的得分比同等装备的代理高出 29%，比单调用检索对应的代理高出 36%（0.80 比 0.80）。0.62 和 0.59），即使基线收到 NoeVera 自己的提示，其证据进化优势的统计显着部分仍然存在。

papers.title: One Million Tokens in 20GB: Calibration-Free 2-Bit SRFT KV-Cache Compression for Looped MoE Inference on Apple Silicon
papers.summary: Long-context inference on unified-memory edge machines is governed by KV-cache capacity and memory bandwidth. On a 32 GB Apple M6 Mac mini (26.8 GB Metal working set, 150 GB/s DRAM), the 26.4B looped Mixture-of-Experts model Inkling-2-Mini (48 logical visits, 1M native context) exhausts memory by 64K tokens in stock oMLX (and by 512K even after fixing its 40 sliding-window visits to bounded ring buffers). We show that three structural properties of modern hybrid NoPE architectures -- bounded sliding windows, a 1,024-token banded relative bias whose tail is identically zero, and unit-RMS value normalization -- combine with an orthonormal Subsampled Randomized Fourier Transform (SRFT) to enable calibration-free, scale-free 2.000-bit Value and 2.125-bit Key Lloyd-Max compression (2.0625 effective bits/coordinate, $7.76\times$ smaller than bf16) on the 8 global visits' far prefix $[0, N-1024)$, merged with the exact bf16 local window and learned sink via online log-sum-exp. A custom GQA-packed Metal decode kernel with a 256-entry half4 LUT and Block-8 lazy exp2 rescaling reaches 73.4 GB/s and runs Inkling-2-Mini at 17.09 tok/s at 256K ($3.36\times$ faster than bf16), 13.81 tok/s at 512K, and 9.52 tok/s at 1,048,576 tokens in 19.49 GiB peak memory (4.37 GiB KV). Across $4\times 4096$ WikiText-2 windows, 3.06-bit SRFT is lossless ($Δ$PPL $= -0.007$), 2.56-bit K3/V2 adds $+0.024$, and 2.06-bit adds $+0.130$ while achieving 100% (3/3) exact 7-digit passkey retrieval at 8K, 16K, and 32K.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程突破明显，但通用性与验证仍不足。
pros: 将结构先验与SRFT结合实现超低比特KV压缩，技术组合有新意
在Apple Silicon上给出完整吞吐/内存实测，长上下文收益显著
cons: 评测覆盖面较窄，主要集中单模型单硬件，外推性存疑
“calibration-free”与精度保持的证据仍偏有限，任务与基线不够全面

papers.title_zh: 20GB 中的 100 万个代币：无需校准的 2 位 SRFT KV 缓存压缩，用于 Apple Silicon 上的循环 MoE 推理
papers.summary_zh: 统一内存边缘机器上的长上下文推理由 KV 缓存容量和内存带宽控制。在 32 GB Apple M6 Mac mini（26.8 GB Metal 工作集，150 GB/s DRAM）上，26.4B 循环 Mixture-of-Experts 模型 Inkling-2-Mini（48 次逻辑访问，1M 本机上下文）消耗了库存 oMLX 中 64K 令牌的内存（即使在修复了对有界环形缓冲区的 40 次滑动窗口访问后，也消耗了 512K）。我们展示了现代混合 NoPE 架构的三个结构特性——有界滑动窗口、尾部相同为零的 1,024 个令牌带状相对偏差以及单位 RMS 值归一化——与正交二次采样随机傅里叶变换 (SRFT) 相结合，以实现无校准、无标度的 2.000 位值和 2.125 位密钥 Lloyd-Max 压缩（2.0625 有效位/坐标， $7.76\times$ 小于 bf16) 在 8 次全局访问的远前缀 $[0, N-1024)$ 上，与精确的 bf16 本地窗口合并并通过在线 log-sum-exp 学习接收器。具有 256 项 half4 LUT 和 Block-8 惰性 exp2 重新缩放的定制 GQA 封装 Metal 解码内核达到 73.4 GB/s，并以 256K 时的 17.09 tok/s 运行 Inkling-2-Mini（比 bf16 快 3.36 美元\倍）、512K 时的 13.81 tok/s 和 9.52 tok/s 19.49 GiB 峰值内存 (4.37 GiB KV) 中有 1,048,576 个令牌。在 $4\times 4096$ WikiText-2 窗口中，3.06 位 SRFT 是无损的 ($Δ$PPL $= -0.007$)，2.56 位 K3/V2 增加 $+0.024$，2.06 位增加 $+0.130$，同时在 8K 下实现 100% (3/3) 精确的 7 位密钥检索， 16K、32K。

papers.title: RES: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models with Rolling Entropy Sampling
papers.summary: A diffusion language sampler makes two choices for every position in its denoising window: where the next token comes from, and when the position is committed to the KV cache. Using the entropy-bound sampler in DiffusionGemma, we study two extremes of the second choice. Committing each token as soon as it is accepted removes the chance to revise it, which hurts when the entropy bound is relaxed to trade accuracy for speed. When accepted tokens are frozen, macro accuracy falls from 73% to 20% as the bound is relaxed, while the unfrozen sampler stays near 70%. Committing a whole block at once wastes computation, since tokens converge in a largely left-to-right order and more than half of the window holds already-final tokens by twenty denoising steps. These findings motivate the Rolling Entropy Sampler (RES), which commits a contiguous accepted prefix once it reaches a minimum length and keeps positions farther ahead open to revision. Unlike earlier rolling samplers, RES runs on uniform diffusion, where accepted tokens can still change, and it needs no training. Across seven benchmarks, RES increases tokens per forward pass from 19.3 to 25.5, while macro accuracy goes from 80.7% to 78.8%, and it extends the speed-quality Pareto frontier beyond what tuning the entropy bound alone reaches.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路务实有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 准确定位扩散语言采样中的提交时机瓶颈，并给出机制化改进
在七个基准上展示了清晰的速度-质量权衡提升，工程落地价值较高
cons: 摘要缺少统计显著性、方差与计算成本细节，泛化与稳健性证据仍不足

papers.title_zh: RES：通过滚动熵采样加速扩散语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 扩散语言采样器对其去噪窗口中的每个位置做出两种选择：下一个标记来自哪里，以及该位置何时提交到 KV 缓存。使用 DiffusionGemma 中的熵约束采样器，我们研究了第二个选择的两个极端。一旦每个令牌被接受就立即提交，这就消除了修改它的机会，当放宽熵界限以牺牲准确性来换取速度时，这会带来伤害。当接受的令牌被冻结时，随着界限的放宽，宏观准确度从 73% 下降到 20%，而未冻结的采样器保持在 70% 附近。一次提交整个块​​会浪费计算，因为令牌主要以从左到右的顺序收敛，并且超过一半的窗口通过二十个降噪步骤保存了已经最终的令牌。这些发现激发了滚动熵采样器（RES），一旦达到最小长度，它就会提交一个连续的可接受的前缀，并保持更远的位置可供修改。与早期的滚动采样器不同，RES 在均匀扩散上运行，接受的标记仍然可以改变，并且不需要训练。在七个基准测试中，RES 将每次前向传递的代币从 19.3 增加到 25.5，而宏观准确率从 80.7% 增加到 78.8%，并且它扩展了速度质量帕累托边界，超出了单独调整熵界限所能达到的范围。

papers.title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
papers.summary: The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch). The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps. \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 统一框架有价值，但证据广度与统计力度仍不足。
pros: 将H2O与StreamingLLM统一为单一幂律族，观点简洁且可解释性强
一次校准跨域迁移并在多数据集PPL稳定胜出，工程落地潜力高
cons: 验证规模偏小（模型与任务覆盖有限），QA显著性不足且改进幅度仍需更大模型与长上下文实验支撑

papers.title_zh: NoHairCache：使用一个幂律指数校准一次 KV 缓存驱逐
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存驱逐中的衰减指数 $α$ 是模型的固有属性：在单个语料库上校准一次，它可以直接跨域传输。基于注意力的累积（H2O）和基于新近度的滑动窗口（StreamingLLM）是两个主要的驱逐框架，通常被视为无关，但我们表明它们是单个幂律族的两个端点：通过将每个标记评分为 $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$，其中 $A_i$ 是累积注意力，$α$ 控制年龄惩罚，H2O 和 StreamingLLM 对应于 $α=0$和 $α\to\infty$（使用 StreamingLLM 额外硬编码一个注意力池补丁）。 \citet{fang2026nohair} 的无毛机制限制了 $α$ 的允许范围，并且测量的指数一致：在 WikiText 上校准一次，对于代表性模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）会产生 $[0.556, 0.822]$。每个模型的范围在五个模型 (410M--1.5B) 中是一致的，并且独立地匹配困惑度扫描的最佳区域。 \textsc{NoHairCache} 在三个数据集（WikiText、PG19 和 arXiv）中实现了最低的困惑度，无需针对每个数据集进行调整，其性能优于 H2O 和 StreamingLLM（所有三个数据集上的 $p < 0.05$，在预算 $512$ 的情况下，PPL 比 StreamingLLM 获得 $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL 收益）。在下游四向多项选择 QA 上，它在所有九个（任务、预算）单元中匹配或优于 StreamingLLM，在 NarrativeQA 上保留了 98.2\%$ 的全缓存准确率，保留率为 25\%$，而 StreamingLLM 的保留率为 91.1\%$；每个单元的 McNemar 测试并不重要，因此 QA 仅用于佐证。我们在发布后发布校准脚本和即用记分器。

papers.title: Consumer-Time Validity in Stateful AI Runtimes: Verifying Recovered State and Deferred Authority
papers.summary: Stateful LLM serving engines and agent runtimes reuse execution state and deferred permissions across components and sessions. A cancellation, rollback, or approval is recorded by one component and relied on by another, and recording it does not make the later use valid: a downstream consumer may read state or dispatch an action whose identity, production status, allocation, or target revision has since changed. We call the missing check consumer-time validity and separate two forms. State validity governs what a consumer reads. On vLLM with LMCache, an interrupted KV load leaves unwritten blocks indexed, and a host-only counter rewind desynchronizes the GPU position, so a second tenant generates a schema-valid tool call naming the wrong tenant in 10/10 native-fault runs; the call is recorded and not executed. Authority freshness governs what a consumer executes: on a multi-session approval runtime, an unrevoked deferred grant overwrote a newer revision in one admitted live execution. Output equality cannot test state validity: a fault-free run diverges at token 30 through BF16 batching alone while attended-KV digests match. We therefore specify consumer-bound recovery contracts that, for state recovery, jointly require exclusion, retention, and task completion, and an admissible-witness standard realized as a GPU-free offline trace verifier over scheduler metadata and persisted tool artifacts. On recorded traces the verifier agrees with the reference verdicts in 42/42 frozen GPU-matrix scenarios. An allocation-aware repair satisfies 7/7 triggered vLLM fault predicates on a pinned scheduler-case matrix, where upstream PR 61769 satisfies 2/7, and revision-bound dispatch blocks all 160 deterministic conflicting overwrites in a separate dispatcher cohort. Recovery must be checked where state and authority are consumed, with evidence bound to the consuming request.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义新颖且实证扎实，但表述偏密集
pros: 提出“consumer-time validity”并区分状态有效性与权限新鲜性，概念边界清晰且有普适潜力
包含可复现实证与对照：故障注入、42/42一致性验证、7/7修复覆盖及160例冲突拦截
cons: 摘要信息密度过高且术语偏重，跨系统外推性与真实线上开销仍需在正文中更充分量化

papers.title_zh: 有状态 AI 运行时中的消费者时间有效性：验证恢复的状态和延迟的权限
papers.summary_zh: 有状态 LLM 服务引擎和代理运行时跨组件和会话重用执行状态和延迟权限。取消、回滚或批准由一个组件记录并由另一个组件依赖，记录它并不会使以后的使用有效：下游消费者可能会读取状态或调度其身份、生产状态、分配或目标修订已更改的操作。我们将缺失的检查称为消费者时间有效性并分开两种形式。状态有效性控制消费者阅读的内容。在具有 LMCache 的 vLLM 上，中断的 KV 负载会留下索引的未写入块，并且仅主机计数器回滚会使 GPU 位置不同步，因此第二个租户生成模式有效的工具调用，在 10/10 本机故障运行中命名错误的租户；调用被记录但不被执行。权威新鲜度控制消费者执行的内容：在多会话批准运行时，未撤销的延期授权覆盖了一次承认的实时执行中的较新修订。输出相等性无法测试状态有效性：无故障运行在令牌 30 处仅通过 BF16 批处理发散，同时有人值守的 KV 摘要匹配。因此，我们指定了消费者绑定的恢复合约，对于状态恢复，共同要求排除、保留和任务完成，以及作为调度程序元数据和持久工具工件上的无 GPU 离线跟踪验证器实现的可接受见证标准。根据记录的痕迹，验证者同意 42/42 冻结 GPU 矩阵场景中的参考结论。分配感知修复满足固定调度程序案例矩阵上的 7/7 触发 vLLM 故障谓词，其中上游 PR 61769 满足 2/7，并且修订绑定调度会阻止单独调度程序队列中的所有 160 个确定性冲突覆盖。必须在消耗状态和权限的情况下检查恢复情况，并提供与消耗请求相关的证据。

papers.title: Analytical Modeling and Optimal GPU Provisioning for Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.summary: We present OSplit, an exact analytical method that enables efficient partitioning of a GPU L1 domain into prefill and decode workers, including sharding for classical and advanced GPUs. OSplit takes into consideration model parameters, enabling any inference model to be partitioned into prefill and decode workers with a goal of producing the maximum throughput possible. OSplit is based on a capacity model that takes as inputs the model, the loading scheme (batch size, max sequence length), and models an inference serving framework (vLLM) and computes the efficiency of each GPU. For this, we model H100 and GB300 GPUs, and model a scale-up domain, along with FlashAttention-based kernels. OSplit first computes an optimal collective generation policy, which gives inputs to the capacity model that enables optimal split of prefill and decode GPUs. We evaluate our scheme over H100 (NVL8) and GB300 (NVL72) using vLLM inference serving and show throughput, predicted and measured latency, showing near-perfect theoretical-to-measured values over leading LLMs (Llama and Qwen)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果亮眼，但创新与证据仍待强化。
pros: 聚焦解耦式LLM推理中的GPU切分优化，工程与系统价值明确
声称解析模型与实测高度吻合，若成立将具备较强可落地性
cons: “exact/optimal/near-perfect”等表述较强，但摘要未给出关键假设、误差边界与失败案例
方法对vLLM、特定GPU代际与FlashAttention内核依赖较重，通用性与外部可迁移性存疑

papers.title_zh: 用于分类 LLM 推理的分析建模和最佳 GPU 配置
papers.summary_zh: 我们提出了 OSplit，这是一种精确的分析方法，可以将 GPU L1 域有效地划分为预填充和解码工作线程，包括经典和高级 GPU 的分片。 OSplit 考虑了模型参数，使任何推理模型都可以分为预填充和解码工作器，目标是产生尽可能大的吞吐量。 OSplit 基于容量模型，该模型将模型、加载方案（批量大小、最大序列长度）作为输入，并对推理服务框架 (vLLM) 进行建模并计算每个 GPU 的效率。为此，我们对 H100 和 GB300 GPU 进行建模，并对扩展域以及基于 FlashAttention 的内核进行建模。 OSplit 首先计算最佳集体生成策略，该策略为容量模型提供输入，从而实现预填充和解码 GPU 的最佳分割。我们使用 vLLM 推理服务在 H100 (NVL8) 和 GB300 (NVL72) 上评估我们的方案，并显示吞吐量、预测和测量的延迟，与领先的 LLM（Llama 和 Qwen）相比，显示出近乎完美的理论测量值

papers.title: HiPerfCC-KVCache: Accelerating Confidential LLM Serving with Hierarchical KV Caching
papers.summary: Hierarchical key-value (KV) caching reduces repeated prefill computation in large language model serving by retaining reusable state beyond GPU memory. Under GPU confidential computing (CC), however, protected transfers can erase this benefit. We show that bulk KV copies hold driver locks during prolonged CPU-side processing, stalling independent serving operations despite separate threads and streams. Our characterization on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs shows how lock scope, copy granularity, and allocation ownership affect foreground progress and transfer parallelism. Guided by these findings, we present HiPerfCC-KVCache, which manages resource lifetimes, prioritizes ready token readback between bounded backup submissions, and parallelizes KV restores through auxiliary contexts with shared GPU staging. Implemented in SGLang, HiPerfCC-KVCache uses existing protected transfer interfaces without hardware or driver changes. Across three models and three workloads on H200, HiPerfCC-KVCache achieves a geometric-mean output-token throughput speedup of $1.74\times$ (up to $2.72\times$) over the staged KV-transfer HiCache-Workers baseline at the highest tested loads. Mean time to first token decreases by 36% on average and up to 59%. The benefits generalize to RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, with a geometric-mean throughput speedup of $1.28\times$ (up to $2.20\times$) over the same baseline. A capacity analysis further models and explains variation in gains and remaining gaps to CC-off serving.

papers.title_zh: HiPerfCC-KVCache：通过分层 KV 缓存加速机密 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 分层键值 (KV) 缓存通过保留 GPU 内存之外的可重用状态，减少了大型语言模型服务中的重复预填充计算。然而，在 GPU 机密计算 (CC) 下，受保护的传输可能会消除这一优势。我们表明，批量 KV 副本在长时间的 CPU 端处理过程中会持有驱动程序锁，尽管有单独的线程和流，但仍会停止独立的服务操作。我们对 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 的表征显示了锁定范围、复制粒度和分配所有权如何影响前台进度和传输并行性。在这些发现的指导下，我们提出了 HiPerfCC-KVCache，它管理资源生命周期，优先考虑有界备份提交之间的就绪令牌读回，并通过共享 GPU 分段的辅助上下文并行化 KV 恢复。 HiPerfCC-KVCache 在 SGLang 中实现，使用现有的受保护传输接口，无需更改硬件或驱动程序。在 H200 上的三个模型和三个工作负载中，HiPerfCC-KVCache 在最高测试负载下比分阶段 KV 传输 HiCache-Workers 基线实现了几何平均输出令牌吞吐量加速 $1.74\times$（高达 $2.72\times$）。首次令牌的平均时间平均减少 36%，最高可达 59%。这些优势也适用于 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell，在相同基线上几何平均吞吐量加速为 $1.28\times$（高达 $2.20\times$）。容量分析进一步建模并解释增益的变化以及与 CC-off 服务的剩余差距。

papers.title: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
papers.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. This makes a benchmark result conditional on how the workflow is executed. We introduce MASSys, a benchmark for measuring this dependence in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems. MASSys executes the same candidate-task pairs across serving substrates and load regimes, using five workload families spanning software repair, research synthesis, financial analysis, interactive control, and diagram generation. It records task quality alongside delivery, latency, cost, resource pressure, and failure evidence. In a controlled motivation diagnostic, the Star workflow falls from first to fourth in mean-latency rank under KV-cache pressure, while Chain rises from fourth to first. The substrate sweeps further show that increasing load creates long runtime tails and timeout pressure. In several task families, quality among evaluated outputs changes less than effective quality over submitted jobs: the system delivers fewer usable results even when the surviving outputs remain competitive. Tool and runtime traces reveal that these outcomes involve both model serving and non-model execution. Together, the results motivate evaluating MAS designs over explicit operating conditions and reporting which tasks are delivered, how well they are solved, and where execution breaks down.
