papers.title_zh: 评估基底很重要：对多代理服务基底进行基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 多智能体系统 (MAS) 通常协调异构模型和工具来解决复杂的任务，从而对可靠评估的需求不断增长。然而，在一种服务环境中速度最快的多代理工作流在另一种服务环境中可能会失去优势，即使其模型、提示和任务保持不变。这使得基准测试结果取决于工作流程的执行方式。我们引入了 MASSys，它是衡量多智能体大语言模型 (LLM) 系统中这种依赖性的基准。 MASSys 使用涵盖软件修复、研究综合、财务分析、交互式控制和图表生成的五个工作负载系列，跨服务基底和负载状态执行相同的候选任务对。它记录任务质量以及交付、延迟、成本、资源压力和失败证据。在受控动机诊断中，Star 工作流程在 KV 缓存压力下的平均延迟排名从第一下降到第四，而 Chain 从第四上升到第一。基板扫描进一步表明，增加负载会产生较长的运行时间尾部和超时压力。在几个任务系列中，评估输出的质量变化小于提交作业的有效质量变化：即使剩余输出仍然具有竞争力，系统提供的可用结果也更少。工具和运行时跟踪表明，这些结果涉及模型服务和非模型执行。总之，结果激励在明确的操作条件下评估 MAS 设计，并报告交付了哪些任务、解决任务的情况以及执行失败的位置。

papers.title: UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection
papers.summary: Industrial anomaly inspection requires not only accurate anomaly discrimination but also trustworthy explanations for operators, while satisfying the strict latency constraints of online inspection. Existing methods, however, typically apply a fixed computational path to all samples, making it difficult to strike a good balance among detection accuracy, inference efficiency, and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose UACR, an uncertainty-aware collaborative routing framework for explainable industrial anomaly inspection. UACR aims to deliver reliable anomaly decisions together with operator-facing explanations under the online inspection budget, while adaptively allocating computation so that ambiguous cases receive deeper scrutiny. The framework consists of two stages. Stage I, Offline Training and Routing Hyperparameter Search, learns the anomaly inspection modules and calibrates the uncertainty estimator that drives routing. Stage II, Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Routing, collaboratively dispatches each input across inspection paths according to its estimated uncertainty. Experimental results on multiple public datasets show that UACR achieves over 5.16% improvement in accuracy compared to the baseline method, while reducing latency by over 31.5%. It also enhances the interpretability of industrial detection by over 15%.

papers.title_zh: UACR：用于可解释工业异常检查的不确定性协作路由
papers.summary_zh: 工业异常检测不仅需要准确的异常判别，还需要为操作人员提供可信的解释，同时满足在线检测严格的延迟约束。然而，现有方法通常对所有样本应用固定的计算路径，难以在检测精度、推理效率和可解释性之间取得良好的平衡。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 UACR，一种用于可解释的工业异常检查的不确定性感知协作路由框架。 UACR 的目标是在在线检查预算下提供可靠的异常决策以及面向操作员的解释，同时自适应地分配计算，以便模糊的情况得到更深入的审查。该框架由两个阶段组成。第一阶段，离线训练和路由超参数搜索，学习异常检查模块并校准驱动路由的不确定性估计器。第二阶段，不确定性感知自适应路由，根据估计的不确定性跨检查路径协作调度每个输入。在多个公共数据集上的实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，UACR 的准确率提高了 5.16% 以上，同时延迟降低了 31.5% 以上。它还将工业检测的可解释性提高了 15% 以上。

papers.title: IndexerStage: Staging Indexer-K across Memory Tiers for Sparse-Attention LLM Serving
papers.summary: Long-context sparse-attention serving can remain limited by graphics processing unit (GPU) memory after attention data is offloaded. DeepSeek Sparse Attention retains Indexer-K state to select the tokens that attention will read. Its indexer scans this growing state in full at every layer and decode step. A full scan requires the current layer's state, however, not simultaneous residency of every layer. We present IndexerStage, a serving runtime that externalizes Indexer-K state while preserving native GPU score, top-k, and attention kernels. It stages completed pages through shared execution buffers and preserves new entries locally. Joint memory-and-transfer admission checks storage and each layer's transfer demand before accepting a growing batch. The backing tier gathers pages; the model-serving GPU controls transfer timing and byte budgets. We implement IndexerStage in SGLang on 16 model-serving and 16 backing H800 GPUs. Across 16K--64K inputs, local streaming storage occupies 0.65--0.70 GiB per model-serving GPU. Relative to host-memory-backed HiSparse, batch size increases by 12.28--23.08% and decode throughput in tokens per second (TPS) reaches 1.08--1.14x. At 64K with the latent-KV backing path fixed, the larger batch achieves 1.10x decode TPS; enabling streaming at batch size 24 adds 2.42% to time per output token. Mixed-length dynamic serving increases mean generating batch size by 12.07% and delivers 1.31x decode TPS.

papers.title_zh: IndexerStage：跨内存层暂存 Indexer-K 以实现稀疏注意力 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 在卸载注意力数据后，长上下文稀疏注意力服务仍会受到图形处理单元 (GPU) 内存的限制。 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 保留 Indexer-K 状态来选择 Attention 将读取的标记。它的索引器在每一层和解码步骤中全面扫描这种增长状态。然而，完整扫描需要当前层的状态，而不是每个层同时驻留。我们推出了 IndexerStage，这是一个服务运行时，它可以外部化 Indexer-K 状态，同时保留本机 GPU 分数、top-k 和注意力内核。它通过共享执行缓冲区暂存已完成的页面，并在本地保留新条目。联合内存和传输准入在接受不断增长的批次之前检查存储和每层的传输需求。支持层收集页面；模型服务 GPU 控制传输时间和字节预算。我们在 16 个模型服务和 16 个支持 H800 GPU 上以 SGLang 实现 IndexerStage。在 16K--64K 输入中，每个模型服务 GPU 的本地流存储占用 0.65--0.70 GiB。相对于主机内存支持的 HiSparse，批量大小增加了 12.28--23.08%，解码吞吐量（TPS）达到 1.08--1.14 倍。在固定潜在 KV 后备路径的 64K 下，较大的批次可实现 1.10 倍的解码 TPS；启用批量大小为 24 的流式传输会使每个输出令牌的时间增加 2.42%。混合长度动态服务将平均生成批量大小增加了 12.07%，并提供 1.31 倍的解码 TPS。

papers.title: Selective ROM Weight Storage for Responsive LLM Control on Edge Robots
papers.summary: Edge robots increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for complex tasks, demanding efficient inference alongside timely control. Limited memory capacity constrains model deployment, while repeated weight transfers during decoding compete with activations and KV cache for external bandwidth. Sequential generation of robot actions further delays decisions and periodic control on shared hardware. We present a hybrid memory architecture with heterogeneous scheduling to address these bottlenecks jointly. Banked ROM stores selected fixed weights and supplies a standard compute array through a dedicated datapath. LPDDR retains the remaining weights and mutable state, preserving model flexibility. Coordinated operand delivery and preemption at output slice boundaries accelerate inference while limiting interference with periodic control. A structured decision interface scores candidate phases in a single forward pass, avoiding sequential token generation for routine choices. Together, these mechanisms improve memory service, compute access, and decision execution for edge robotic workloads. Experiments with Qwen3-8B achieve a peak decode speedup of 1.56$\times$ and reduce P99 task response time by a factor of approximately 227.27$\times$, while completing 100.00\% of the tested grasping and transport tasks.

papers.title_zh: 用于边缘机器人上响应式 LLM 控制的选择性 ROM 权重存储
papers.summary_zh: 边缘机器人越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLM）来执行复杂任务，要求高效推理和及时控制。有限的内存容量限制了模型部署，而解码期间的重复权重传输与激活和 KV 缓存竞争外部带宽。机器人动作的顺序生成进一步延迟了对共享硬件的决策和周期性控制。我们提出了一种具有异构调度的混合内存架构来共同解决这些瓶颈。 Banked ROM 存储选定的固定权重，并通过专用数据路径提供标准计算阵列。 LPDDR 保留剩余的权重和可变状态，从而保留模型的灵活性。输出切片边界处的协调操作数传送和抢占可加速推理，同时限制对周期性控制的干扰。结构化决策接口在单次前向传递中对候选阶段进行评分，避免了例行选择的连续标记生成。这些机制共同改善了边缘机器人工作负载的内存服务、计算访问和决策执行。 Qwen3-8B 的实验实现了 1.56$\times$ 的峰值解码加速，并将 P99 任务响应时间减少了约 227.27$\times$，同时完成了 100.00\% 的测试抓取和运输任务。

papers.title: CCAMoE: Cache-Conditioned Adaptive Inference for Offloaded MoE
papers.summary: Expert offloading enables Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on memory-constrained GPUs, but expert transfers and CPU execution limit decoding performance. Speculative decoding can mitigate these costs, yet separate draft weights consume scarce GPU memory and longer drafts increase verification demand. In this paper, we present CCAMoE, a unified runtime that coordinates adaptive speculative decoding with concurrent expert-cache updates. Its design has three key features: 1) Cache-only drafting, which reuses resident target experts to generate proposals and routing hints without separate draft weights; 2) Draft-guided cache updates, which anticipate expert demand and overlap transfers with computation to support subsequent drafting and verification; and 3) Cost-aware draft-length control, which balances expected acceptance against execution cost. Together, these mechanisms coordinate proposal generation and cache preparation through a shared evolving cache, improving proposal quality while reducing verification cost. Across various MoE models, GPU platforms, and workloads, CCAMoE consistently achieves the lowest decoding latency, with up to 2.33$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title_zh: CCAMoE：用于卸载 MoE 的缓存条件自适应推理
papers.summary_zh: 专家卸载可在内存受限的 GPU 上实现专家混合 (MoE) 推理，但专家传输和 CPU 执行会限制解码性能。推测性解码可以减轻这些成本，但单独的草稿权重会消耗稀缺的 GPU 内存，而较长的草稿会增加验证需求。在本文中，我们提出了 CCAMoE，这是一个统一的运行时，可协调自适应推测解码与并发专家缓存更新。其设计具有三个关键特征：1）仅缓存起草，重用常驻目标专家来生成提案和路由提示，无需单独的草案权重； 2）草稿引导的缓存更新，预测专家需求并与计算重叠传输以支持后续的草稿和验证； 3) 具有成本意识的草稿长度控制，平衡预期验收与执行成本。这些机制共同通过共享演进缓存协调提案生成和缓存准备，提高提案质量，同时降低验证成本。在各种 MoE 模型、GPU 平台和工作负载中，CCAMoE 始终实现最低的解码延迟，与最先进的基准相比，速度提升高达 2.33$\times$。

papers.title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

papers.title_zh: DisSparse：针对长上下文 LLM 服务的流水线 Top-$p$ 稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文 LLM 推理受到键值 (KV) 缓存内存需求的瓶颈，其大小与上下文长度呈线性关系。动态稀疏注意力通过仅获取和关注令牌的关键子集来减少这一瓶颈。动态稀疏注意力研究和部署中的主要原语是固定预算 top-$k$ 选择，这种选择受到青睐，因为其确定性块计数与 vLLM 等系统所依赖的静态内存分配一致。无论注意力质量如何在头、层和解码步骤之间分布，Top-$k$ 使用固定预算，导致注意力峰值的头上浪费带宽，或者注意力分散的头上丢失上下文。 Top-$p$（核）选择自然地适应了这种变化，但由于两个系统级挑战，在生产服务系统中的采用有限：破坏确定性块分配的可变块计数和超出注意力本身成本的计算昂贵的选择内核。我们提出了 DisSparse，一个将 top-$p$ 稀疏注意力端到端集成到 vLLM 中的服务系统。 DisSparse 将块选择与调度程序的关键路径解耦，通过双流管道将选择延迟隐藏在层计算后面，并引入基于单通道直方图的 top-$p$ 内核。我们进一步观察块内稀疏性，即由于在固定大小的 KV 缓存块中混合高重要性和低重要性令牌而导致的选择预算膨胀，并通过累积的预填充注意力分数引导的令牌重定位内核来解决该问题。在多个模型的长上下文和中上下文基准测试中，DisSparse 在稀疏性分析（块选择）方面比最先进的 top-$p$ 方法实现了 1.17 倍到 1.80 倍的加速，并且精度损失可以忽略不计，并且在相同的内存预算下支持比密集 vLLM 大 8 倍的最大批量大小。

papers.title: Shoonya: Zero-Socket In-Process Small Language Models for Graph Databases with Schema-Epoch KV Caching, Live Catalog Logit Masking, and Verifier-Advantage Distillation
papers.summary: Coupling a property-graph database to an external language-model server imposes a three-part socket tax: serialization overhead dwarfing microsecond graph reads, repeated prefill of verbose schemas, and blind decoding divorced from the live catalog and multi-version concurrency control (MVCC) engine. We present Shoonya, from-scratch commercially clean (0.0% non-commercial or share-alike data) tri-modal (Python, Rust, OpenCypher) small language models (16.8M to 1.07B parameters) co-designed with shoonya-infer, a zero-dependency pure-Rust runtime embedded inside the samyama-graph-enterprise address space. Direct GraphStore references unlock three database-native primitives: (1) an epoch-invalidated SchemaPrefixCache over a copy-on-write PagedKvArena accelerating warm CPU time-to-first-token by 4.91x--13.68x with O(1) DDL invalidation; (2) a 36 us columnar catalog and source-span logit mask enforcing valid ontology identifiers and verbatim spans; and (3) a sub-65 us read-only MVCC gate serving Tier-0 queries inside 389.8 MiB INT8 RSS (59.8--67.9 tok/s) with 0.0% hallucination leak. Rank-factorized tied embeddings (-74.5% vocabulary weights), atomic indentation tokens (0/421 indentation errors), 4:1 grouped-query attention with 2:1 cross-layer KV sharing (-93.75% INT8 KV memory), Warmup-Stable-Decay training, KnOTS SVD merging, Step-GRPO, and Rust Jacobi SVD governance keep 100% of layers heavy-tailed ($α\in [1.88, 2.20]$). Finally, we synthesize nine lessons across v0.1--v1.0, resolving a Reverse-Token-Density Distillation Trap via teacher scaling and zero-VRAM Verifier-Advantage-Gated Knowledge Distillation (AdvKD), recovering +13.61 MBPP points (33.07%) while reaching 100% validity on enrichment, grounded extraction, and tool planning.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Open weights (Apache-2.0), shard provenance manifests, and Rust Jacobi SVD spectral certificates: https://huggingface.co/VaidhyaMegha/Shoonya

papers.title_zh: Shoonya：用于图数据库的零套接字进程内小语言模型，具有 Schema-Epoch KV 缓存、实时目录 Logit 屏蔽和 Verifier-Advantage Distillation
papers.summary_zh: 将属性图数据库耦合到外部语言模型服务器会产生三部分套接字税：使微秒图读取相形见绌的序列化开销、详细模式的重复预填充以及脱离实时目录和多版本并发控制 (MVCC) 引擎的盲解码。我们推出了 Shoonya，它是与 shoonya-infer 共同设计的 Shoonya，它是一种从头开始的商业清洁（0.0% 非商业或共享数据）三模式（Python、Rust、OpenCypher）小型语言模型（16.8M 到 1.07B 参数），shoonya-infer 是嵌入在 samyama-graph-enterprise 地址空间内的零依赖纯 Rust 运行时。直接 GraphStore 引用解锁了三个数据库本机原语：(1) 在写时复制 PagedKvArena 上的纪元失效 SchemaPrefixCache，通过 O(1) DDL 失效将热 CPU 首次令牌时间加速 4.91x--13.68x； (2) 36 us 柱状目录和源跨度 logit 掩码，强制执行有效的本体标识符和逐字跨度； (3) 低于 65 us 的只读 MVCC 门，在 389.8 MiB INT8 RSS (59.8--67.9 tok/s) 内提供第 0 层查询服务，幻觉泄漏率为 0.0%。排名因子绑定嵌入（-74.5% 词汇权重）、原子缩进标记（0/421 缩进错误）、4:1 分组查询注意力和 2:1 跨层 KV 共享（-93.75% INT8 KV 内存）、Warmup-Stable-Decay 训练、KnOTS SVD 合并、Step-GRPO 和 Rust Jacobi SVD 治理保持 100%重尾层数（$α\in [1.88, 2.20]$）。最后，我们综合了 v0.1-v1.0 的九个课程，通过教师扩展和零 VRAM 验证器优势门控知识蒸馏 (AdvKD) 解决了反向令牌密度蒸馏陷阱，恢复了 +13.61 MBPP 点 (33.07%)，同时在丰富、接地提取和工具规划方面达到 100% 的有效性。

papers.title: Grammar-as-a-Drafter: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in one forward pass. Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regular expressions, tool-call formats), the drafter works against a constraint it does not know, so its proposals for keys, delimiters, and indentation are often rejected or invalid, even though the grammar engine already knows the next tokens. We present Grammar-as-a-Drafter (GaaD), which makes the grammar a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens (out-degree 1 in the grammar automaton) into one draft row of width $K$ (which can exceed the drafter's proposal length $K_M$): matching tokens are promoted to GRAMMAR, the proposal is truncated where it disagrees, and grammar tokens fill the remaining slots. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter without adding kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, accepting canonical GRAMMAR drafts with probability 1 preserves grammar validity but can shift the output distribution relative to grammar-masked decoding. We implement GaaD in vllm-torchtpu and an independent Rust serving runtime, and evaluate it on TPU v7x with MTP, DFlash, and n-gram drafters on a JSON character-profile benchmark. GaaD raises average acceptance length from 2.06 to 5.43 for MTP (Qwen3.5-0.8B; 1.99 to 5.31 on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 1.57 to 4.13 for DFlash, and 1.30 to 3.64 for n-gram (Qwen3-4B), decoding 2.66-2.81x faster at batch size 1 and 1.14-1.70x faster at batch size 64. In the Rust runtime, MTP with GaaD is 2.23x faster on Qwen3.5-0.8B and 2.02x on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 (1.22-1.69x at high concurrency). Under mixed traffic, GaaD finishes workloads 1.03-1.23x sooner while modestly raising plain-text TPOT.

papers.title_zh: Grammar-as-a-Draft：语法受限的结构化输出上的每个推测解码步骤更多的令牌
papers.summary_zh: 在结构化输出（JSON 模式、正则表达式、工具调用）下，推测性起草者看不到语法约束，并重复提出无效的键、分隔符和缩进，而语法引擎已经知道接下来必须出现哪些标记。我们提出了语法草稿（GaaD），它将语法视为第二起草者。在每个验证步骤之前，调度程序将起草者的提案与语法强制标记合并到一个草稿行中：匹配标记保留为 GRAMMAR，提案在离开强制路径的地方被剪切，并且强制标记填充比起草者提案更宽的行的其余部分。验证步骤接受 GRAMMAR 草稿，无需计算其逻辑，与任何起草者进行组合，无需新内核或在关键路径上进行编译。由于语法修复的是文本而不是标记，因此提交规范的强制标记会更改相对于语法屏蔽的目标解码的输出分布。我们在 vllm-torchtpu 和独立的 Rust 服务运行时中实现 GaaD，在 JSON 字符配置文件基准上使用 MTP、DFlash 和 n-gram 起草器对 TPU v7x 进行评估。 GaaD 将平均接受长度从 2.06 提高到 5.43（MTP、Qwen3.5-0.8B）、1.99 提高到 5.31（MTP、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）、1.57 提高到 4.13（DFlash、Qwen3-4B）和 1.30 提高到 3.64（n-gram、Qwen3-4B）、解码批量大小为 1 时速度提高 2.66-2.81 倍，批量大小为 64 时速度提高 1.14-1.70 倍。在 Rust 中，MTP+GaaD 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上速度提高 2.23 倍，在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 上速度提高 2.02 倍，在 128 个并发请求时速度提高 1.22 倍。在混合流量（25-50% 结构化）下，GaaD 更快地完成工作负载 1.03-1.23 倍（结构化请求更快 2.2-3.2 倍），而纯文本 TPOT 则上升 7-42%。我们还展示了语法屏蔽的贪婪解码可以选择非规范标记化，因此 GaaD 可以产生 fp32 参考同样可能发现的不同有效输出。

papers.title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
papers.summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

papers.title_zh: 用于马尔可夫推理的专用大型语言模型：结构缓存压缩、转换预训练和双环变压器
papers.summary_zh: 标准自回归大型语言模型关注生成令牌的增长历史，使键值 (KV) 缓存成为长链推理和多分支采样中的中央内存和吞吐量瓶颈。然而，一类重要的推理问题自然是一阶马尔可夫的：下一步取决于当前状态的充分表示，而不是所有早期步骤的原始序列。我们为马尔可夫推理专用大语言模型开发了统一的设计范例。在缓存级别，马尔可夫状态接口将历史相关的 KV 存储转换为相对于推理步骤数恒定大小的状态传输。在学习层面，我们将长链预测重新表述为可独立训练的一步转换目标，具有明确的状态瓶颈、蒸馏、不变性和漂移一致性损失。在架构层面，我们引入了双循环 Transformer：外部循环推进推理状态，而内部循环深度循环通过共享权重和显式内存令牌或循环矩阵状态为每个转换分配自适应计算。我们将此架构连接到三区域缓存、步骤相对位置、截断反向传播、分支感知检查点和以转换为中心的评估协议。组织原则很简单：最优推理系统不需要记住所有事情；它必须准确地继承未来所需要的东西。这一原则开辟了一条通往专用推理引擎的道路，其内存占用与推理链长度分离。

papers.title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
papers.summary: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方案务实且有潜在影响。
pros: 直击潜反馈Transformer与投机解码不兼容这一关键瓶颈，问题定义清晰

cons: 证据主要限于135M/780M与Paloma，缺少更大模型、长上下文与端到端系统开销验证

papers.title_zh: 反馈捷径：潜在反馈变压器的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 将每个位置的顶层隐藏状态反馈到下一个位置的输入中可以提高 Transformer 的性能。然而，这种反馈破坏了推测性解码，因为验证起草的令牌需要来自其先前位置的顶层状态，这迫使草案依赖于近似的替代。训练模型以适应这种替代可以降低精确解码性能上限，而在推理时使用它会进一步引入近似误差。我们提出反馈捷径来解决这两个瓶颈。首先，状态对齐训练从多令牌预测头状态到替身的轻量级投影，使基础模型训练保持不变。其次，流水线校正使用其前身的新计算状态重新评估每个草稿，这是更接近真实反馈的代理。在后续草稿的验证过程中运行此更正可以提高准确性，并且零额外调用。在 135M 和 780M 规模上，Feedback Shortcut 与 Paloma 上的精确解码上限保持在每字节 $10^{-4}$ 位以内，并将解码速度提高了 2.4-2.8 倍，训练计算量比潜在反馈 Transformer 多出约 2%。在大批量下，跳过校正仍然保留了 Transformer 的速度和超过 80% 的潜在反馈增益。

papers.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.

papers.title_zh: MemOnce：适用于大型语言模型的可扩展内存架构
papers.summary_zh: 在长期和持续交互中部署大型语言模型 (LLM) 需要维护可重用的内存状态以供未来推理，这对现有架构提出了挑战。标准 Transformer 累积分层、令牌级 KV 缓存，随着上下文扩展，会导致 GPU 内存线性增长和二次计算复杂性。相比之下，线性时间架构将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，但很难保留细粒度的细节。我们引入 MemOnce，这是一种学习语言模型可扩展内存状态的基础架构。 MemOnce 基于两个核心设计：（a）内存编码器-解码器：它仅将最终层隐藏状态的一小部分缓存为紧凑的内存表示，并将它们动态解码回 KV 缓存以用于注意层； (b) 内存稀疏注意力：对于每个连续输入，MemOnce 自适应地检索相关的内存表示，稀疏索引仅跨层计算一次。将这两种设计结合起来可以实现高效的动态内存加载和 KV 缓存解码，从而大大减少 GPU 内存占用并实现线性时间复杂度。我们进行了大量的实验，证明 MemOnce 在不同的模型大小、上下文长度和训练范例（训练前和训练后适应）方面优于 Transformer 和其他架构。特别是，在 Qwen3.5-4B 上采用 MemOnce，在 1M 上下文中，内存状态缓存减少了 1313$\times$，预填充延迟减少了 6.9$\times$，吞吐量提高了 3.5$\times$，整体内存性能提高了 +5.77%。最后，MemOnce 将零样本推广到下游表示任务，实现了与专用模型竞争的结果。

papers.title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
papers.summary: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. Building on block-wise tail refinement and fixed-support transport topology (arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954), we introduce Topology Hub Optimal Transport (THOT): (1) bounded-support capacity gating via simplex sparsemax ($O(L\log L)$) or sorting-free token-local thresholded ReLU ($O(L)$), driving excess distractor mass to zero; (2) a three-sweep $1+2$ annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule that damps bipartite residuals; (3) an exact rank-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile adjoint in batched split-factor Triton kernels (BF16 Tensor Cores, FP32 potentials); and (4) a chunked exclusive-prefix causal variant with verified zero future leakage. On NVIDIA L4, sparsemax THOT trained at $L=128$ reaches 97.40% zero-shot recall of fixed bindings at $L=262{,}144$ under pure task loss ($α=0$) and 98.83% at $α=0.05$ (matched by $O(L)$ thresholded ReLU at $α=0.05$, vs. 80.60% at $α=0$), while softmax-gated hub OT drops to 3.52%. In bidirectional operator microbenchmarks, our kernel runs forward+VJP in 100.1 ms at $H=8, D=64, L=262\mathrm{K}$ (2.2x faster with 4.0x smaller compiler temporaries than latent softmax) and 1.34 ms vs. 4.37 ms for cuDNN FlashAttention at $L=4{,}096$; multi-layer LM runs use the unfused path. Zero-shot WikiText-103 multi-needle retrieval hits 100.00% (128/128 queries at $L=65\mathrm{K}$) vs. 0.78% for short-trained RoPE FlashAttention, and compact 4-layer WikiText-4K runs show modest causal and masked LM gains.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且速度亮眼，但证据链仍需补强。
pros: 将OT拓扑稀疏化与容量门控结合，针对长上下文稀释问题切中要害
给出较完整的工程实现与效率数据，L4上前后向性能提升显著
cons: 实验主要集中在检索型与微基准，跨任务泛化、规模化预训练对比与统计稳健性证据不足
与强基线的公平性与可复现细节（训练预算、超参、失败案例）在摘要层面不充分

papers.title_zh: 拓扑中心最佳传输：以闪存速度消除长上下文稀释
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文模型使用稀疏或结构化注意力来避免二次成本，但检索嵌入在数十万个干扰项中的一小部分相关事实会随着标准化质量随长度而分散而降低。中心辐射型最优传输 (OT) 将密集的 $L \times L$ 矩阵替换为本地窗口上的线性大小图和通过 Sinkhorn 缩放平衡的 $K$ 共享集线器。基于块式尾部细化和固定支持传输拓扑（arXiv：2605.08123，arXiv：2609.07954），我们引入了拓扑中心最佳传输（THOT）：（1）通过单纯形稀疏最大（$O（L \ log L）$）或无排序令牌局部阈值ReLU（$O（L）$）进行有界支持容量门控，将多余的干扰物质量驱动为零； (2) 三扫 $1+2$​​ 退火行封闭 Sinkhorn 时间表，抑制二分残差； (3) 批量分裂因子 Triton 内核（BF16 张量核心，FP32 势）中的精确等级-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile 伴随； (4) 一个分块的独占前缀因果变体，经过验证，未来泄漏为零。在 NVIDIA L4 上，在 $L=128$ 下训练的稀疏最大 THOT 在纯任务损失 ($α=0$) 下达到了 $L=262{,}144$ 处固定绑定的 97.40% 零样本召回率，在 $α=0.05$ 处达到了 98.83%（与 $α=0.05$ 处的 $O(L)$ 阈值 ReLU 匹配，而在 $α=0.05$ 处则为 80.60%） $α=0$)，而 softmax 门控集线器 OT 下降至 3.52%。在双向算子微基准测试中，我们的内核在 $H=8、D=64、L=262\mathrm{K}$ 处以 100.1 毫秒的速度运行正向+VJP（比潜在的 softmax 编译器临时文件小 4.0 倍，速度快 2.2 倍），在 $L=4{,}096$ 处，cuDNN FlashAttention 的运行时间为 1.34 毫秒 vs. 4.37 毫秒；多层 LM 运行使用未融合的路径。零样本 WikiText-103 多针检索达到 100.00%（128/128 个查询，$L=65\mathrm{K}$）短期训练的 RoPE FlashAttention 为 0.78%，紧凑的 4 层 WikiText-4K 运行显示出适度的因果和屏蔽 LM 增益。

papers.title: Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准、工程价值高，但方法增量偏中等。
pros: 抓住推理随机性可预先固定这一关键洞见，思路自然且实用
无需重训草稿模型且不改变目标分布，兼容性强、落地成本低
cons: 摘要对理论保证、鲁棒性边界与统计显著性证据交代不足，SOTA结论可信度待看全文实验细节

papers.title_zh: 推测性解码比你想象的更少推测性
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过在目标模型生成候选延续之前准备它们来加速语言模型推理。其效率取决于有限的绘图计算对目标实际遵循的路径的预测程度。预测这条路径涉及两个不确定性来源：目标模型的预测和采样的随机性。然而，前者需要目标模型前向传递，而后者可以在起草之前修复。在此观察的基础上，我们引入了 DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection），它可以在起草和验证过程中进行预采样和同步验证随机性。通过将这些已知抽签与现有绘图员的预测相结合，DICE 将计算分配给更有可能在当前采样运行中使用的延续。这一原则指导整个草稿树构建过程中的节点选择，并扩展到异步预取，其中 DICE 预测要准备哪些下一轮草稿。无需额外的绘图员培训或更改目标采样分布，DICE 即可在不同的设置下实现最先进的解码吞吐量，与强大的基线相比，速度提升高达 24.6pp。

papers.title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
papers.summary: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things. On one shared backbone we show that a Perceiver-style pathway and an AnchorFormer pathway collapse to a single summary, the latter despite its mass normalisation (pooling-map similarity 0.99), while other soft pathways, including Representative Attention, stay partly redundant (0.59-0.79). These results concern the routing modules inside our block, not the full published models. An exclusive partition of the patch grid cannot collapse by construction, and matched component by component it is 2.4-3.6 points more accurate than Representative Attention on CIFAR-100. We then propose focus anchors, which place most anchors at the peaks of a learned importance map while all anchors keep one exclusive Voronoi partition. Focus anchors beat a fixed partition on a cluttered canvas (+1.5 points, 95% CI [0.5, 2.6]) but not on full-HD traffic-sign recognition. There, both variants match dense attention with local windows at about a fifth of its FLOPs, and the fixed partition also trains 1.5x faster per step than dense attention with FlashAttention, though both use more memory; a ViT on a downsampled input loses half its mean average precision. Hard exclusive assignment is the only region assignment we tested that is both stable and most accurate: softmax and Sinkhorn relaxations diverge, and Gumbel-softmax trains but is less accurate. We also report the limits: a ResNet-18 is more accurate on every task we trained it on in this from-scratch regime, and anchors train faster than FlashAttention only from about 1536x1536 pixels and never use less memory.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实验诚实，但通用价值仍有限。
pros: 精准揭示锚点路由塌缩问题，并给出构造性不可塌缩方案
消融与负结果报告充分，含置信区间与训练速度/算力对比较完整
cons: 收益主要集中在特定分辨率与任务，内存劣势明显，且整体仍不及简单ResNet基线

papers.title_zh: 移动而不会塌陷的锚点：Vision Transformers 的专属区域锚点布线
papers.summary_zh: 锚标记让视觉转换器通过一些摘要来交换全局信息，但没有什么强制不同的锚总结不同的事物。在一个共享主干上，我们表明感知器式路径和 AnchorFormer 路径崩溃为单个摘要，后者尽管其质量归一化（池图相似度 0.99），而其他软路径，包括代表注意力，仍然部分冗余（0.59-0.79）。这些结果涉及我们块内的路由模块，而不是完整发布的模型。补丁网格的独占分区不会因构造而崩溃，并且逐个组件地匹配，它比 CIFAR-100 上的 Representative Attention 准确度高 2.4-3.6 个点。然后，我们提出焦点锚点，将大多数锚点放置在学习重要性图的峰值处，而所有锚点保留一个唯一的 Voronoi 分区。焦点锚点在杂乱的画布上击败了固定分区（+1.5 分，95% CI [0.5, 2.6]），但在全高清交通标志识别上则不然。在那里，两种变体都以大约五分之一的 FLOP 速度与本地窗口的密集注意力相匹配，并且固定分区的每步训练速度也比使用 FlashAttention 的密集注意力快 1.5 倍，尽管两者都使用更多的内存；下采样输入上的 ViT 会损失其平均精度的一半。硬独占分配是我们测试的唯一既稳定又最准确的区域分配：softmax 和 Sinkhorn 松弛发散，Gumbel-softmax 训练但不太准确。我们还报告了局限性：ResNet-18 在我们从头开始训练的每项任务上都更加准确，并且锚点的训练速度比 FlashAttention 仅从大约 1536x1536 像素开始训练，并且从不使用更少的内存。

papers.title: FOREST: Coordinating Tree-based HBF, RRAM, and HBM for Efficient Speculative LLM Inference
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by combining lightweight drafting with parallel target-model verification. However, its stages impose distinct resource demands: target verification requires high-throughput access to large weight sets, sequential drafting executes a compact model under tight latency constraints, and long-context attention processes growing key-value (KV) caches. Conventional GPU-centric SD systems serve these workloads through shared HBM-centric memory and general-purpose compute, creating mismatches in capacity, bandwidth, and computation. These mismatches constrain deployable model-context configurations and limit the efficiency of bandwidth-bound and latency-sensitive operations. We propose FOREST, a heterogeneous memory-centric architecture coordinating HBF, 3D-stacked RRAM, and HBM memory-compute trees for efficient SD. It features: (1) compute-aligned 3D RRAM, combining ultra-wide, low-frequency reads with clock-decoupled interfaces and overlapped SRAM-DCIM weight refills for latency-sensitive drafting; (2) cross-tree numerical co-design, moving block-scaled Q/K/V preprocessing to HBF and RRAM root plates and enabling block-floating-point (BFP) attention with pipelined softmax reduction in the HBM tree; and (3) HBF-aware SD design-space exploration, revealing how bandwidth-compute provisioning and model scale determine performance, energy, and cost trade-offs. Evaluated across six SD configurations spanning 32B-405B target models, FOREST achieves up to 5.5x end-to-end speedup, 11.46x higher decode throughput, and 16.5x higher decode energy efficiency over NVIDIA A800 GPU-based SD baselines. Under a modeled total cost of ownership, FOREST delivers up to 6.73x higher token-generation cost efficiency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 架构新颖且潜力大，但实证可信度仍待加强
pros: 面向SD三阶段瓶颈做异构存算协同，问题定义准确且系统性强
跨HBF/RRAM/HBM的数值与数据流共设计完整，并给出性能-能耗-TCO多维收益
cons: 结果主要基于建模与设计空间探索，缺少芯片级实现与端到端可复现实验，且与GPU基线公平性和工程开销仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: FOREST：协调基于树的 HBF、RRAM 和 HBM，以实现高效的推测性 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过将轻量级绘图与并行目标模型验证相结合，加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理。然而，它的各个阶段提出了不同的资源需求：目标验证需要对大型权重集进行高吞吐量访问，顺序起草在严格的延迟约束下执行紧凑的模型，长上下文注意力过程需要不断增长的键值（KV）缓存。传统的以 GPU 为中心的 SD 系统通过以 HBM 为中心的共享内存和通用计算来服务这些工作负载，从而导致容量、带宽和计算方面的不匹配。这些不匹配限制了可部署的模型上下文配置，并限制了带宽限制和延迟敏感操作的效率。我们提出了 FOREST，一种以内存为中心的异构架构，协调 HBF、3D 堆叠 RRAM 和 HBM 内存计算树，以实现高效 SD。它具有：(1) 计算对齐的 3D RRAM，将超宽、低频读取与时钟解耦接口和重叠的 SRAM-DCIM 权重填充相结合，用于延迟敏感的绘图； (2) 跨树数值协同设计，将块级 Q/K/V 预处理移至 HBF 和 RRAM 根板，并通过 HBM 树中的流水线 Softmax 缩减实现块浮点 (BFP) 关注； (3) HBF 感知的 SD 设计空间探索，揭示带宽计算配置和模型规模如何决定性能、能源和成本权衡。通过对涵盖 32B-405B 目标模型的六种 SD 配置进行评估，与基于 NVIDIA A800 GPU 的 SD 基准相比，FOREST 实现了高达 5.5 倍的端到端加速、11.46 倍的解码吞吐量和 16.5 倍的解码能效。根据建模的总拥有成本，FOREST 的代币生成成本效率提高了 6.73 倍。

papers.title: Vega-Fafnir: Is Greedy Decoding the Same Decoding? Where Rounding Noise in Speculative Verification Comes From and What Removing It Costs
papers.summary: Serving engines treat the ways of running a greedy language model as interchangeable: cached or not, padded or not, alone or batched, one token or several verified at once (speculative decoding). In finite precision they round differently. We measure how often the greedy text of Qwen3-0.6B (bfloat16, 128 new tokens, GSM8K and ARC prompts) differs from a reference that decodes one token per pass. Verifying 4 guessed tokens per pass changes 60% of 150 prompts and padding changes 68%; every first divergence has a top-1 minus top-2 logit gap of 0.375 or less. A split of the noise shows that cache entries written by multi-token passes are about as noisy as the multi-token pass itself. A margin gate (fall back to one token when the gap is below a bound calibrated on separate GSM8K prompts) whose fallback reads that cache does not help: 58 of 100 prompts differ, against 61 of 100 for plain verification. Rebuilding the cache with one-token passes leaves 0 of 100 different but costs 7.2 model passes per token, against 1.0 for the reference. Fixed-width decoding makes drafted and plain decoding identical (0 of 100 prompts differ) at 0.75 passes per token. On shifted MMLU and HellaSwag prompts the rebuild gate leaves 0 of 60 different, plain verification 48 of 60. On 138 further and shifted prompts the bound was exceeded at 0.6% of positions and missed 0 of 309 flips. One GPU, one drafter, small models.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但外推性与工程普适性有限。
pros: 聚焦推理服务中“等价贪心解码”失效这一关键但常被忽视的问题，结论有实务价值
实验拆解较细，区分多token验证与缓存写入噪声，并给出可复现的代价—一致性权衡
cons: 评测范围偏窄（单GPU、单drafter、小模型），缺少大模型与多硬件/多框架验证，影响结论外推
核心改进依赖高代价重建缓存（7.2 passes/token），实际部署可用性与性价比存疑

papers.title_zh: Vega-Fafnir：贪婪解码是相同的解码吗？推测性验证中的舍入噪声从何而来以及消除它的成本
papers.summary_zh: 服务引擎将运行贪婪语言模型的方式视为可互换的：缓存或不缓存、填充或不填充、单独或批量、一个令牌或一次验证多个令牌（推测解码）。在有限精度下，它们的舍入方式不同。我们测量了 Qwen3-0.6B 的贪婪文本（bfloat16、128 个新令牌、GSM8K 和 ARC 提示）与每次解码一个令牌的参考不同的频率。每次验证 4 个猜测的令牌会改变 150 个提示的 60%，填充会改变 68%；每个第一个背离的 top-1 减去 top-2 logit 差距为 0.375 或更小。噪声的划分表明，由多令牌传递写入的缓存条目与多令牌传递本身的噪声大致相同。边际门（当间隙低于在单独的 GSM8K 提示上校准的界限时回退到一个令牌）其回退读取缓存无济于事：100 个提示中的 58 个不同，而对于普通验证，100 个提示中有 61 个不同。使用单令牌传递重建缓存会留下 100 个不同的 0 个，但每个令牌花费 7.2 个模型传递，而参考为 1.0 个。固定宽度解码使草稿解码和普通解码相同（100 个提示中有 0 个不同），每个令牌的传递次数为 0.75。在移位 MMLU 和 HellaSwag 提示中，重建门留下 60 个不同的 0 个，简单验证 60 个中的 48 个。在 138 个进一步和移位提示中，超出了 0.6% 位置的界限，并错过了 309 个翻转中的 0 个。一台 GPU、一台绘图仪、小型模型。

papers.title: Cannot Wait to Verify: Parallel Drafting to Eliminate Verifier Idle Time in Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Autoregressive inference in large transformer models is limited by token-level sequential execution, resulting in high latency and low GPU utilization. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this bottleneck by introducing a draft-and-verifier model. However, the drafting stage remains sequential, leaving the verifier idle and underutilizing compute. To address this, we propose a plug-and-play drafting adaptive drafting method that parallelizes inference across transformer layers during draft generation. Starting from a shared hidden state, our approach evaluates multiple layers in parallel and verifies consistency by measuring divergence in hidden-state space. Layer-wise draft states are accepted when deviations are small; otherwise, a correction step is applied. By exploiting redundancy across transformer layers, our method accelerates draft generation and improves hardware utilization without modifying architectures or requiring retraining. Experimental results on NLP tasks show that our method speeds up the drafting stage by up to $1.65\times$ with minimal degradation in accuracy, while maintaining the same performance as SD.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路有实用价值，但证据强度与说服力不足。
pros: 准确抓住SD中verifier空转的系统瓶颈，问题定义清晰
强调即插即用且无需重训，工程落地门槛相对较低
cons: 核心方法与现有层冗余/早退思想边界不清，创新幅度有限
仅报告draft阶段最高1.65倍，端到端时延与吞吐收益不充分

papers.title_zh: 迫不及待地要验证：并行起草以消除推测解码中验证者的空闲时间
papers.summary_zh: 大型 Transformer 模型中的自回归推理受到令牌级顺序执行的限制，导致高延迟和低 GPU 利用率。推测性解码 (SD) 通过引入草稿和验证器模型来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，起草阶段仍然是连续的，导致验证者闲置且计算利用率不足。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种即插即用的绘图自适应绘图方法，该方法可以在草稿生成期间跨变压器层并行推理。从共享的隐藏状态开始，我们的方法并行评估多个层，并通过测量隐藏状态空间的散度来验证一致性。当偏差很小时，可以接受逐层拔模状态；否则，应用校正步骤。通过利用跨变压器层的冗余，我们的方法加速了草稿生成并提高了硬件利用率，而无需修改架构或需要重新训练。 NLP 任务的实验结果表明，我们的方法将起草阶段的速度提高了 1.65 美元\times$，同时精度下降最小，同时保持与 SD 相同的性能。

papers.title: Cruella: A Unified Microscaling and Floating-Point Dot-Product Unit for LLM Inference on FPGAs
papers.summary: The number formats that accelerators execute natively are fixed at fabrication, yet large language model (LLM) checkpoints are released with MXFP4 weights in the Microscaling (MX) formats standardized in 2023. FPGAs adopt new formats through bitstreams. However, to the best of our knowledge, no deployed FPGA LLM accelerator executes MXFP4 weights alongside BF16 products. We characterize the decoding of MXFP4 checkpoints, whose layers alternate between MXFP4$\times$BF16 products and BF16$\times$BF16 products of attention and BF16 layers. With a BF16 KV cache, BF16$\times$BF16 products take 56%-77% of the datapath time, during which a separate MXFP4 unit idles. We present Cruella, whose unified dot-product unit (UDPU) executes both product types on one DSP array and reduction pipeline. First, per-group pre-alignment keeps this pipeline at the BF16 width and changes perplexity by at most 0.7%. Second, pre-adder packing places two signed MXFP4$\times$BF16 products in one DSP48E2 multiplier with an exact correction. On an Alveo U55C, the UDPU needs 23% fewer DSP slices and 36% fewer LUTs than separate MXFP4 and BF16 units of equal throughput. On this board, MXFP4 weights speed up decoding by 1.15$\times$-1.87$\times$ over BF16 weights, and an NVIDIA A40 GPU decodes faster but spends 0.92$\times$-2.01$\times$ the board's energy per token.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程设计有新意，但通用性与证据仍偏有限。
pros: 针对MXFP4与BF16混合解码提出统一点积单元，问题切中实际部署痛点
给出明确硬件收益与端到端速度/能耗数据，工程可落地性较强
cons: 评测范围主要集中单板与少量对比，缺少跨模型规模、长序列和更广平台的充分验证

papers.title_zh: Cruella：用于 FPGA 上的 LLM 推理的统一微缩放和浮点点积单元
papers.summary_zh: 加速器本机执行的数字格式在制造时是固定的，但大型语言模型 (LLM) 检查点以 2023 年标准化的微缩放 (MX) 格式中的 MXFP4 权重发布。FPGA 通过比特流采用新格式。然而，据我们所知，没有部署的 FPGA LLM 加速器能够与 BF16 产品一起执行 MXFP4 权重。我们描述了 MXFP4 检查点的解码，其层在 MXFP4$\times$BF16 产品和 BF16$\times$BF16 注意力产品和 BF16 层之间交替。借助 BF16 KV 缓存，BF16$\times$BF16 产品占用 56%-77% 的数据路径时间，在此期间，单独的 MXFP4 单元处于空闲状态。我们介绍了 Cruella，其统一点积单元 (UDPU) 在一个 DSP 阵列和缩减管道上执行两种乘积类型。首先，每组预对齐使该管道保持 BF16 宽度，并将困惑度最多改变 0.7%。其次，预加法器打包将两个带符号的 MXFP4$\times$BF16 产品放入一个 DSP48E2 乘法器中，并进行精确校正。在 Alveo U55C 上，与具有相同吞吐量的单独 MXFP4 和 BF16 单元相比，UDPU 需要的 DSP 片数减少 23%，LUT 减少 36%。在此主板上，MXFP4 权重比 BF16 权重的解码速度提高了 1.15$\times$-1.87$\times$，NVIDIA A40 GPU 解码速度更快，但每个令牌花费 0.92$\times$-2.01$\times$ 电路板能量。

papers.title: Do Language Models Know Which Words Steer Their Reasoning?
papers.summary: While chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits intermediate reasoning steps from language models, it is unclear which words in the context actually steer the CoT. We identify Phantom Context Influence (PCI): language models are disproportionately steered by semantically irrelevant context words, even as the same models deny those words' relevance when asked. To localize PCI, we introduce Leave-One-Out Word JSD analysis, which removes one context word at a time from the otherwise intact context to isolate its marginal effect on the next-token distribution; words whose removal flips the prediction (pivot words) are passed to the same LLM to self-judge whether it recognizes this predictive dependence. Across four models and three benchmarks, language models largely do not know which words steer their reasoning, a mismatch we call the Generation-Judgment Contradiction. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Online KV Suppression: it scores every prompt word's influence over the whole chain of thought in a single pass, then zeroes the KV-cache entries of the highest-influence word the model itself judges inert and redecodes. This single-word intervention improves CoT accuracy across four models and five reasoning benchmarks, by up to 8.9 percentage points on math reasoning benchmark.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题新颖且实用导向强，但因果与泛化证据仍偏弱。
pros: 提出PCI与Generation-Judgment Contradiction，切中CoT可解释性与可靠性痛点
给出可落地干预（Online KV Suppression），并在多模型多基准报告可观增益
cons: 核心影响度量与“无关词”判定可能受提示模板和分词粒度影响，因果归因不够扎实
改进主要依赖二次解码与特定筛词策略，计算开销、稳定性与失败案例分析不足

papers.title_zh: 语言模型知道哪些单词引导它们的推理吗？
papers.summary_zh: 虽然思想链 (CoT) 提示会从语言模型中引出中间推理步骤，但尚不清楚上下文中的哪些单词实际上引导着 CoT。我们确定了幻影上下文影响（PCI）：语言模型不成比例地受到语义上不相关的上下文单词的引导，即使相同的模型在被问及时否认这些单词的相关性。为了本地化 PCI，我们引入了留一词 JSD 分析，该分析一次从完整的上下文中删除一个上下文单词，以隔离其对下一个令牌分布的边际影响；删除会翻转预测的单词（枢轴词）将被传递给同一个 LLM，以自我判断它是否识别这种预测依赖性。在四个模型和三个基准中，语言模型很大程度上不知道哪些词引导它们的推理，我们将这种不匹配称为“生成-判断矛盾”。受这一现象的启发，我们提出了在线KV抑制：它一次性对每个提示词对整个思维链的影响力进行评分，然后将模型本身判断为惰性的影响力最高的词的KV缓存条目归零并重新解码。这种单词干预提高了四个模型和五个推理基准的 CoT 准确性，在数学推理基准上提高了高达 8.9 个百分点。

papers.title: LongCat Recall Sparse Attention: Co-Designing Key Organization and Retrieval for Long-Context Inference
papers.summary: Retrieval-based sparse attention, exemplified by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), reduces attention computation by selecting a small subset of key-value entries. However, selecting these entries can still require searching the entire visible history. For long sequences, retrieval becomes a major bottleneck, limiting the efficiency gains from sparse attention. To address this problem, we propose LongCat Recall Sparse Attention (LRSA), which combines fine-grained representatives with paged retrieval in an incrementally maintained index. LRSA partitions the sequence into time buckets that can be indexed independently as new keys arrive, without regrouping existing history. Within each bucket, it organizes indexing keys into capacity-balanced directional groups and packs a fixed number of complete groups into each page, retaining a separate center for every group. These centers provide fine-grained representatives for page selection, after which refinement scores members of the selected pages together with sink, sliding-window, and visible unindexed candidates to select the final Top-$K$ logical positions. To execute this retrieval process efficiently, we store members in reordered pages, fuse construction stages according to group size, and share storage for overlapping fixed candidates across queries during chunked prefill. These choices support regular member access while reducing kernel launches during construction and repeated candidate transfers. Moreover, we integrate LRSA into SGLang to maintain the index during inference, overlapping asynchronous index construction for new buckets with subsequent computation and reusing compatible bucket indices and member pages after a prefix match in the original key-value pool. With a 1024K-token context, LRSA accelerates key selection by 4.70$\times$ over DSA and combined selection and attention by 35.60$\times$ over full attention.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程协同设计扎实，但证据边界仍需补强。
pros: 针对稀疏注意力检索瓶颈提出索引与分页协同设计，问题切中长上下文推理痛点
系统实现细节较完整（异步构建、前缀复用、核启动优化），具备较强落地价值
cons: 摘要中主要强调加速比，缺少精度保持、不同负载稳定性与消融公平性的关键信息，严谨性仍待实证支撑

papers.title_zh: LongCat Recall 稀疏注意力：共同设计长上下文推理的关键组织和检索
papers.summary_zh: 基于检索的稀疏注意力，以 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力 (DSA) 为例，通过选择键值条目的小子集来减少注意力计算。然而，选择这些条目仍然需要搜索整个可见历史记录。对于长序列，检索成为主要瓶颈，限制了稀疏注意力带来的效率提升。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 LongCat Recall Sparse Attention (LRSA)，它将细粒度代表与增量维护索引中的分页检索相结合。 LRSA 将序列划分为时间桶，当新密钥到达时，这些时间桶可以独立索引，而无需重新组合现有历史记录。在每个桶中，它将索引键组织成容量平衡的方向组，并将固定数量的完整组打包到每个页面中，为每个组保留一个单独的中心。这些中心为页面选择提供细粒度的代表，之后对所选页面的成员以及接收器、滑动窗口和可见的未索引候选者进行细化评分，以选择最终的 Top-$K$ 逻辑位置。为了有效地执行此检索过程，我们将成员存储在重新排序的页面中，根据组大小融合构造阶段，并在分块预填充期间跨查询共享固定候选的重叠存储。这些选择支持常规成员访问，同时减少构建期间的内核启动和重复的候选传输。此外，我们将LRSA集成到SGLang中以在推理过程中维护索引，将新存储桶的异步索引构建与后续计算重叠，并在原始键值池中进行前缀匹配后重用兼容的存储桶索引和成员页面。在 1024K 代币上下文中，LRSA 的密钥选择速度比 DSA 快 4.70$\times$，选择和注意力组合比完全注意力快 35.60$\times$。

papers.title: CoPyro: Feeding Copy Proposals to Parallel Drafters
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language generation by letting a target model verify several draft tokens in one forward pass. Earlier neural drafters such as EAGLE extend each candidate sequence one token at a time. Recent work has turned to parallel drafters such as DFlash, which predict a whole block at once. Another approach uses n-gram retrieval to find an earlier occurrence of the current context suffix and copy the tokens that followed it directly into the draft. We introduce CoPyro, which feeds these copied tokens into a parallel drafter in place of masks. The drafter learns from context which tokens to keep and which to revise as it predicts the block in its usual forward pass. Across eight benchmarks on Qwen3-4B, CoPyro improves overall acceptance length for all four parallel drafters tested, with gains of 2.19-5.08% when trained on 100K samples. With DFlash trained on 710K samples, overall gains range from 1.08% to 2.00% across the tested model sizes and temperatures. Code generation benefits most in both settings. On Qwen3-8B, processing the proposals adds an average of 0.24 ms per decoding round in Transformers.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 将n-gram复制提案与并行drafter结合，工程直觉强且实现代价低
在多基准与多drafter上均有一致增益，代码生成场景收益更明显
cons: 核心创新偏组合式改进，方法新颖性与理论深度有限
主要报告acceptance length，端到端吞吐/时延与成本收益证据仍不充分

papers.title_zh: CoPyro：向并行起草者提供副本提案
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过让目标模型在一次前向传递中验证多个草稿标记来加速语言生成。早期的神经起草者（例如 EAGLE）一次扩展每个候选序列一个标记。最近的工作转向了并行绘图器，例如 DFlash，它可以同时预测整个块。另一种方法使用 n-gram 检索来查找当前上下文后缀的较早出现位置，并将其后面的标记直接复制到草稿中。我们引入了 CoPyro，它将这些复制的令牌代替掩码输入到并行绘图器中。起草者在通常的前向传递中预测块时，从上下文中了解要保留哪些令牌以及要修改哪些令牌。在 Qwen3-4B 的八个基准测试中，CoPyro 提高了所有测试的四个并行牵伸机的总体接受长度，在 100K 样本上进行训练时，增益提高了 2.19-5.08%。通过对 710K 样本进行训练的 DFlash，在测试的模型大小和温度范围内，总体增益范围为 1.08% 至 2.00%。代码生成在这两种设置中受益最大。在 Qwen3-8B 上，处理提案在 Transformers 中每轮解码平均增加 0.24 毫秒。

papers.title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
papers.summary: Repeatedly accessing the full key--value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context language model decoding. We find that small query-specific subsets can accurately approximate full attention, yet their union covers nearly the entire cache, motivating query-adaptive access for the KV cache. A natural approach is to split the KV cache into clusters, using compact representatives for clusters that incur negligible error while expanding the rest to their original KV entries. We derive a selection criterion from an upper bound on attention-output error, which reveals two complementary factors governing the error: importance measures the impact of a cluster, while distortion measures how faithfully the cluster can be represented. Based on this criterion, we propose RefineKV, a decoding-time query-adaptive KV compression method. Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6x speedup in the attention phase and 1.66x faster decoding, establishing a new quality-latency Pareto frontier.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 将注意力误差上界转化为可执行的查询自适应KV细化准则，方法设计有理论支撑
同时报告注意力阶段与端到端解码加速，并强调质量-时延帕累托改进，应用价值明确
cons: 仅从摘要看实验覆盖有限（模型与基准数量偏少），跨架构与超长上下文泛化尚待验证
误差上界与实际质量相关性的紧致性、最坏情况退化与额外开销细节未充分体现

papers.title_zh: RefineKV：通过注意错误界限进行查询自适应 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 重复访问完整的键值（KV）缓存是长上下文语言模型解码的主要瓶颈。我们发现小的查询特定子集可以准确地近似完全注意力，但它们的并集几乎覆盖整个缓存，从而激发对 KV 缓存的查询自适应访问。一种自然的方法是将 KV 缓存分割成集群，使用紧凑的代表来产生可忽略的错误，同时将其余部分扩展为其原始 KV 条目。我们从注意力输出误差的上限导出了一个选择标准，它揭示了控制误差的两个互补因素：重要性衡量集群的影响，而失真衡量集群的表示程度。基于这个标准，我们提出了RefineKV，一种解码时查询自适应的KV压缩方法。对两个模型和三个基准的实验表明，RefineKV 保留了接近全注意力的质量，同时在注意力阶段实现了高达 7.6 倍的加速和 1.66 倍的解码速度，建立了新的质量延迟 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
papers.summary: LLM agents such as Hermes, OpenClaw, and Codex repeatedly resend growing execution histories, increasing shared GPU key-value (KV) cache demand in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We show that shared KV capacity limits agent-serving throughput. Existing context-reduction methods lack global cache-state visibility, while runtime KV managers lack tool-execution information. Tracing tokens to their originating tool operations reveals that later operations supersede earlier outputs and associated turns, identifying 64% of recorded final-history tokens as removal candidates. We present Contexture, a harness- and model-agnostic architecture for runtime context eviction. Contexture separates the harness's full conversation history from the model's execution context, reducing subsequent requests' KV demand without modifying harness logic or model execution. It combines tool-execution information with global visibility into shared KV pressure and prefix residency: supersession identifies removal candidates, while runtime state determines when removal justifies sacrificing cached computation. This coordination reduces memory demand and decode KV traffic while limiting re-prefill interference with concurrent decoding, without additional model calls or training. Across two models, two harnesses, and two benchmarks, Contexture improves throughput under SLO by 20-73% over the best of no eviction, harness compaction, AgentDiet, and Continuum, and by 7-63% over observation masking in five of eight configurations, and reduces GPU energy per completed session by up to 11%. It also raises throughput under SLO by 23% over LMCache alone on H100. Live-agent experiments show a mean accuracy improvement of 1.4 percentage points over unloaded no eviction, with a worst-case loss of 3.7 points, while observation masking loses 3-28 points.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法实用，接近顶会强录用。
pros: 抓住多Agent共享KV瓶颈，系统问题定义清晰且现实意义强
方案将工具语义与运行时全局缓存状态协同，吞吐与能效收益在多模型多基准下较全面
cons: 核心假设依赖“后续工具输出可替代早期上下文”，在长程依赖或复杂推理任务上的稳健性与泛化边界仍需更强证据

papers.title_zh: 上下文：高吞吐量代理服务的运行时上下文逐出
papers.summary_zh: Hermes、OpenClaw 和 Codex 等 LLM 代理会反复重新发送不断增长的执行历史记录，从而增加高带宽内存 (HBM) 中的共享 GPU 键值 (KV) 缓存需求。我们表明共享 KV 容量限制了代理服务吞吐量。现有的上下文缩减方法缺乏全局缓存状态可见性，而运行时 KV 管理器缺乏工具执行信息。追踪令牌到其原始工具操作表明，后来的操作取代了早期的输出和相关的回合，将记录的最终历史令牌中的 64% 识别为删除候选者。我们提出了 Contexture，一种用于运行时上下文驱逐的与工具和模型无关的架构。上下文将线束的完整对话历史记录与模型的执行上下文分开，从而减少后续请求的 KV 需求，而无需修改线束逻辑或模型执行。它将工具执行信息与共享 KV 压力和前缀驻留的全局可见性结合起来：取代识别删除候选者，而运行时状态确定删除何时需要牺牲缓存计算。这种协调减少了内存需求和解码 KV 流量，同时限制了并发解码的重新预填充干扰，无需额外的模型调用或训练。在两个模型、两个工具和两个基准测试中，Contexture 在 SLO 下的吞吐量比最好的无驱逐、工具压缩、AgentDiet 和 Continuum 提高了 20-73%，在八种配置中的五种中比观察屏蔽提高了 7-63%，并将每个已完成会话的 GPU 能耗降低了 11%。与 H100 上仅使用 LMCache 相比，它在 SLO 下的吞吐量还提高了 23%。实时代理实验表明，与卸载无驱逐相比，平均准确度提高了 1.4 个百分点，最坏情况下损失了 3.7 个百分点，而观察掩盖损失了 3-28 个百分点。

papers.title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
papers.summary: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据链仍偏薄。
pros: 抓住本地单用户解码带宽瓶颈，提出“近零开销”安全检查切入点有价值
方法工程可落地，声称在多数基准优于替代方案且延迟增幅很低
cons: 仅凭摘要看实验外推性不足：模型规模、硬件平台与更强基线覆盖可能不够全面
“共享权重与KV缓存”的实现细节、训练成本与稳定性报告不足，严谨性待验证

papers.title_zh: 运行一，得到二：本地法学硕士的近乎免费的流媒体安全检查
papers.summary_zh: 本地 LLM 助理一次为一名用户进行解码，因此解码受到内存带宽的限制，并使计算闲置。如今，流媒体安全检查以准确性和成本为代价。专用的保护模型很准确，但每个令牌的延迟几乎加倍，而隐藏状态探针虽然便宜，但不太准确。我们提出了 ToRA，一个适配器，它运行第二个模型作为生成器解码步骤中的额外行，共享其权重和 KV 缓存。双行内核读取两行的每个权重一次。在 Qwen3-0.6B 上，ToRA 匹配或击败了专用的流媒体防护，在 17 个基准测试中的 12 个上具有更高的 F1。在类似成本下，它比探测器多检测到 11.8 个点的不安全响应，每个令牌的延迟增加不到 4%。

papers.title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
papers.summary: Long-context decoding on edge devices is limited by DRAM, because every generated token reads the whole, growing KV cache. 4-bit block-scaled formats such as NVFP4 reduce this traffic but degrade accuracy: on Qwen3-4B, NVFP4 lowers 32K RULER (seven tasks) from 92.6 to 79.4, and a Hadamard rotation lowers it further to 57.7. We observe that most of the key energy is a positional carrier, one per-head vector that rotary position embedding (RoPE) rotates with position. In NVFP4, it sets the shared scale of most key blocks and lowers the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio of the content by about 5 dB, nearly one bit, yet it depends only on that vector and the position. We therefore introduce positional carrier decomposition, which removes the carrier before RoPE and stores only the content residual. We design a KV path that rotates and quantizes keys only after this removal and computes each attention score directly on the 4-bit code. We also design a positional phase engine that regenerates the carrier's score term for one key per cycle. At the same cache size as NVFP4, CarrierKV raises 32K RULER on Qwen3-4B from 79.4 to 91.1 and lowers the 32K PG19 perplexity increase of NVFP4 by 1.8 to 5.9 times on four models, outperforming SageAttention and P3-LLM on all four. Its loss also stays nearly flat as the cache grows, while that of NVFP4 rises. In a 22 nm FDSOI process at 600 MHz, CarrierKV's hardware increases the area of the NVFP4 accelerator by 2.9% and the energy of a 20K-token reasoning request on Qwen3-4B by 0.12% at the same decode latency. On Qwen3-4B at 32K, CarrierKV has a better RULER score than FP8 keys (91.1 against 89.3) and uses 13.7% less energy per token. The decomposition also lowers the 32K perplexity increase of 3-bit TurboQuant keys on Qwen3-4B from 69.7 to 0.76.

papers.title_zh: CarrierKV：一种边缘 LLM 加速器，具有低位 KV 缓存的位置载波分解功能
papers.summary_zh: 边缘设备上的长上下文解码受到 DRAM 的限制，因为每个生成的令牌都会读取整个不断增长的 KV 缓存。 NVFP4 等 4 位块缩放格式减少了此流量，但降低了准确性：在 Qwen3-4B 上，NVFP4 将 32K RULER（七个任务）从 92.6 降低到 79.4，而 Hadamard 旋转将其进一步降低到 57.7。我们观察到，大部分关键能量是位置载体，即旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）随位置旋转的每个头向量。在NVFP4中，它设置了大多数关键块的共享比例，并将内容的信噪比降低了约5 dB，接近一位，但它仅取决于该向量和位置。因此，我们引入了位置载体分解，它删除了 RoPE 之前的载体并仅存储残差内容。我们设计了一个 KV 路径，仅在删除后才旋转和量化密钥，并直接在 4 位代码上计算每个注意力分数。我们还设计了一种位置相位引擎，可以为每个周期一个键重新生成载体的得分项。在与 NVFP4 相同的缓存大小下，CarrierKV 将 Qwen3-4B 上的 32K RULER 从 79.4 提高到 91.1，并在四个模型上将 NVFP4 的 32K PG19 困惑度增加降低 1.8 到 5.9 倍，在所有四个模型上都优于 SageAttention 和 P3-LLM。随着缓存的增长，其损失也几乎保持不变，而 NVFP4 的损失则上升。在 600 MHz 的 22 nm FDSOI 工艺中，CarrierKV 的硬件在相同的解码延迟下将 NVFP4 加速器的面积增加了 2.9%，并将 Qwen3-4B 上的 20K 令牌推理请求的能量增加了 0.12%。在 32K 的 Qwen3-4B 上，CarrierKV 的 RULER 分数比 FP8 密钥更好（91.1 对 89.3），并且每个令牌使用的能量减少了 13.7%。该分解还将 Qwen3-4B 上 3 位 TurboQuant 密钥的 32K 困惑度增量从 69.7 降低到 0.76。

papers.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
papers.summary: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 系统设计扎实，价值高但证据仍需更全面
pros: 抓住混合层缓存异构痛点，提出透明页池与分层流式协同方案

papers.title_zh: TideCache：具有透明缓存管理和分层流传输的高效混合 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 混合架构已成为开放权重语言模型的主流。它们的全局注意力和有界状态层维护异构缓存，其需求随着上下文长度和并发性而变化。我们推出了 TideCache，这是一个基于 CPU-GPU 超级芯片的服务系统，具有三个组件，用于在缓存之间分配 GPU 内存并管理它们在 GPU 和主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址后面的缓存组件之间重新分配物理页，保留缓存布局和后端接口。 Cache Streamer 使用有界状态层提供的计算间隔将下一个全局注意层的前缀预取到全局注意层之间共享的 GPU 插槽中，从而减少 GPU 驻留，同时将分层传输与计算重叠。生成的 KV 仍然驻留。请求调度器根据请求大小和队列状态选择驻留或流式执行并触发容量调整。它们共同让通过流式发布的 HBM 容纳其他缓存组件和额外的请求。与采用 HiCache 的 SGLang 相比，TideCache 在 SGLang 中实施，并在 GB300 和 GH200 上跨七种模型/平台配置进行评估，完成的代理轮次最多为 2.04 倍，每个令牌的总体 P50 延迟降低了 20--59%，并将代理 P50 TTFT 提高了 1.40--3.05 倍。

papers.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
papers.summary: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向流式头像生成，工程价值高于方法突破。
pros: 准确击中低时延因果生成痛点，实测吞吐与实时性指标突出
给出两阶段蒸馏与开源权重/数据，具备较好的可复现与落地价值
cons: 关键结论主要基于与自家教师和少量基线对比，跨模型泛化与主观质量统计仍显不足

papers.title_zh: AURA：音频驱动的流媒体 Avatar
papers.summary_zh: 当前的音频驱动视频扩散模型可以合成真实的头部说话视频，但通常需要对多秒视频块进行数十个扩散去噪步骤，这使得它们不适合语音助手和虚拟化身等流媒体应用，这些应用需要低延迟和在线因果生成特性。 AURA 使用滚动 KV 缓存逐块生成视频块，只需要当前块的音频即可开始生成，而不是像双向模型那样进行多秒音频前瞻。它有两种尺寸：AURA 1.3B 在单个 GPU 上实时传输 576p 视频（16 Hz 播放速率为 20.7 fps），使其适合交互式头像应用，AURA 5B 以 9.7 fps 传输 720p 视频。我们的两阶段蒸馏管道首先将因果学生与教师对齐，通过训练它以较少的扩散步骤和块式滑动窗口因果注意掩模来匹配教师的轨迹，然后应用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）和后向模拟来缩小剩余的质量差距。在标准头部说话基准测试中，AURA 1.3B 的运行速度比其自己的双向教师快 23 倍，并在较低分辨率下达到与 TalkVerse 相当的质量，而 AURA 5B 在 720p 下与其 TalkVerse 教师相匹配，同时运行速度快 17 倍。为了支持流媒体头像生成的可重复性和进一步研究，我们发布了两个模型的权重以及 30K 合成视频及其预先计算的教师轨迹的数据集。

papers.title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
papers.summary: LLM agents run long, multi-turn programs whose contexts grow at every step, and serving them is limited by KV cache capacity. To alleviate this limitation, systems use context compression techniques, which typically wait until the KV cache crosses a large threshold and then summarize large spans of history at once, either in the background while the agent progresses or on the critical path. These summarizations can be done using the same model running on the same engine, or using the same or a different model running on extra hardware. When running on the same engine, summarization competes with the requests being served for both compute and memory capacity. To maximize the cost-effectiveness of summarization, this paper presents a new serving system called {\em Aggron}. Aggron summarizes agentic requests at every turn and selectively summarizes only certain parts of the KV cache. As a result, Aggron retains accuracy and keeps summarization requests lightweight. Moreover, Aggron launches summarization requests from a separate {\em Summarization Queue} while the corresponding agentic request whose KV cache we want to compress is stalled in the main request queue due to head-of-line stalls. The Summarization queue utilizes compute and memory capacity left over by the head-of-line stalls in the main queue. Further, to maximize efficiency, the server issues summarizations only when it predicts that they can complete before the corresponding agentic request will finally execute. In our evaluation, we compare Aggron to state-of-the-art asynchronous summarization. At high load, Aggron reduces P99 program latency by $27$--$31\%$, and raises throughput by $1.34$--$1.40\times$.

quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，思路新颖但证据仍需更扎实。

papers.title_zh: Aggron：在请求队列中的队头停顿期间对代理 KV 缓存进行积极压缩
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理运行长的、多轮的程序，其上下文在每一步都会增长，并且为它们提供服务受到 KV 缓存容量的限制。为了减轻这种限制，系统使用上下文压缩技术，这种技术通常会等到 KV 缓存跨越一个大阈值，然后立即汇总大范围的历史记录，无论是在代理进程的后台还是在关键路径上。这些总结可以使用在同一引擎上运行的相同模型来完成，或者使用在额外硬件上运行的相同或不同模型来完成。当在同一引擎上运行时，汇总会与正在服务的计算和内存容量的请求竞争。为了最大限度地提高摘要的成本效益，本文提出了一种名为 {\em Aggron} 的新服务系统。 Aggron 每次都会汇总代理请求，并选择性地仅汇总 KV 缓存的某些部分。因此，Aggron 保留了准确性并保持摘要请求的轻量级。此外，Aggron 从单独的汇总队列发起汇总请求，而我们想要压缩其 KV 缓存的相应代理请求由于队头停顿而停滞在主请求队列中。汇总队列利用主队列中队头停顿留下的计算和内存容量。此外，为了最大限度地提高效率，服务器仅在预测摘要可以在相应的代理请求最终执行之前完成时才发出摘要。在我们的评估中，我们将 Aggron 与最先进的异步摘要进行了比较。在高负载下，Aggron 将 P99 程序延迟降低了 $27$--$31\%$，并将吞吐量提高了 $1.34$--$1.40\times$。

papers.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
papers.summary: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 切入隐藏维稀疏而非token稀疏，方向有新意且与RoPE结构强相关
兼顾算法与系统落地，宣称可在训练与推理端提升速度并降低显存

papers.title_zh: HiSA：稀疏化法学硕士 RoPE 注意力的隐藏维度
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的注意力通过全点积对针对每个键的每个查询进行评分。我们研究是否必须完全计算该点积才能使注意力有效。我们提出隐藏稀疏注意力（HiSA），它保持查询和关键投影完整，但只计算部分点积，遵循令牌位置设置的静态、无参数规则：注意力在隐藏（特征）维度中变得稀疏，这是一个比令牌稀疏性更少探索的轴，而不是像几乎所有稀疏注意力方法那样在令牌上进行探索。基于旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的结构，我们将键和查询分解为在计算注意力时可以省略的部分。通过使用 HiSA 从头开始​​训练 LLM，我们发现与完整产品相比，这种部分点积不会损害反而提高了性能，同时仅计算大约三分之一的查询键乘积。在推理过程中，HiSA 提高了解码速度并缩小了内存占用。我们还将 HiSA 扩展到 FlashAttention-3 内核以进行训练和推理。最后，我们通过证明密集注意力学会抑制 HiSA 下降的注意力分数部分来激发我们的方法。代码可在 https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa 获取。

papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
papers.summary: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

papers.title_zh: 梁模型技术报告
papers.summary_zh: Beam 是一种稀疏专家混合 (MoE) 模型，具有 501.3B 总参数和 23.4B 活动参数，专为编码、推理和代理工作负载而构建和优化。 Beam 提供前沿水平的推理，同时所需的推理计算量比许多同类模型少 3-4 倍。 Beam 在 23.8T 多样化、精心策划的高质量令牌上进行了预训练，具有通过新颖的两阶段中间训练阶段实现的 1M 令牌上下文窗口，该窗口基于可验证的、正确性锚定的数据构建。训练后利用了跨 10.5K GB300 GPU 的大规模、完全异步强化学习 (RL) 活动，在 4 周的训练中生成了超过 1 亿次部署。我们相信这是迄今为止开放实验室进行的最大规模的强化学习运行之一。在我们的评估套件中，随着强化学习计算的增加，能力不断提高，没有出现停滞的迹象。在深度硬件模型协同设计、FP8/NVFP4 量化和 1.93B 参数推测解码起草器 (DFlash 2) 的支持下，Beam 通过高效、灵活的部署最大限度地提高了服务吞吐量。在对话轮次和伤害类别上进行平均，Beam 拒绝或转向 88.9% 的有害请求，同时遵守 81.5% 的无害请求，在帕累托边界上的开放权重模型中实现了最高的有害请求拒绝/转向率。

papers.title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

cons: 摘要仅报告相对QVG与部分指标，缺少更全面消融、开销与泛化边界证据

papers.title_zh: 视频扩散变压器中 2 位 KV 缓存量化的在线时间旋转
papers.summary_zh: 视频扩散转换器在去噪步骤中重复使用键值 (KV) 缓存，这很快就会成为长视频生成的瓶颈。我们发现，量化时间上遥远的缓存向量会导致大范围和高量化误差，但 KV 缓存中的附近视频标记在每个通道上共享持久模式。这些模式在不同视频中也有所不同，从而激发适合每个视频独特缓存的旋转。我们提出了时间旋转量化（TRQ），这是一种在量化之前旋转缓存中时间相邻的帧的方法。对于时间上相邻的高速缓存向量的每个块，TRQ 拟合正交变换，该正交变换将块的每通道均值映射到跨通道接近常数的向量。为了保持量化格式的轻量级，我们将此旋转参数化为 $2 \times 2$ 平面旋转的树，每个旋转仅存储两位，后面是所有块共享的固定哈达玛变换。旋转的拟合无需梯度或模型权重的变化，并且我们证明简单的贪婪拟合对于我们的“均值平坦化”目标是全局最优的。每个新视频的转换都会在线进行拟合，并且我们发布了融合的 Triton 内核，以使该过程的推理效率更高。在 2 位精度和匹配压缩下，TRQ 相对于最先进的方法 QVG，在 LongCat-Video-13B 上将 VBench 主题一致性从 90.38 提高到 92.02，在 HY-WorldPlay-8B 上从 86.33 提高到 87.61，并改进了其他指标。

papers.title: AscMLA: Unlocking FP4 Efficiency for Long-Context MLA Decoding through Asymmetric Scaling
papers.summary: Long-context decoding repeatedly reads a growing KV cache. FP4 reduces cache storage and traffic but needs block scaling to handle its limited dynamic range. Applying FP4 to multi-head latent attention (MLA) requires reconciling different K/V scaling requirements on a shared latent. Existing approaches address this mismatch through dequantization or separate encodings, adding execution or storage overhead. We present AscMLA, which combines asymmetric K/V scaling with pipelined scale delivery to process a single FP4 payload directly. AscMLA uses 38.2% less cache memory than FP8 and achieves geometric-mean speedups of 1.35x over TRT-LLM's FP8 and 1.26x over CAKE's NVFP4 MLA kernels.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值较强，但方法新颖性与证据深度一般。
pros: 抓住长上下文解码KV带宽瓶颈，问题重要且实用性高

papers.title_zh: AscMLA：通过非对称缩放解锁长上下文 MLA 解码的 FP4 效率
papers.summary_zh: Long-context decoding repeatedly reads a growing KV cache. FP4 减少了缓存存储和流量，但需要块扩展来处理其有限的动态范围。 Applying FP4 to multi-head latent attention (MLA) requires reconciling different K/V scaling requirements on a shared latent. Existing approaches address this mismatch through dequantization or separate encodings, adding execution or storage overhead.我们提出了 AscMLA，它将非对称 K/V 缩放与流水线缩放交付相结合，以直接处理单个 FP4 有效负载。 AscMLA 使用的高速缓存比 FP8 少 38.2%，几何平均加速比 TRT-LLM 的 FP8 快 1.35 倍，比 CAKE 的 NVFP4 MLA 内核快 1.26 倍。

papers.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
papers.summary: Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load. We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. While the forward pass runs uncut, FrontierReplay logs a short window of recurrent-layer inputs and invokes a cross-layer, state-only replay kernel to build the target state 6-37x cheaper per token than full recomputation without host synchronization. A frontier-aware retention policy prioritizes active anchors and proven branches while lending dead checkpoint slots to the attention KV cache. Across diverse hybrid architectures, model scales, and workloads, FrontierReplay delivers clear gains over existing exact caches, lowering median time to first token (TTFT) by 16-89% (up to 8.9x), raising 80% service-level objective (SLO) capacity by up to 1.73x, and improving goodput by up to 4.26x (3.67x at larger scales). Compared with approximate replay methods, FrontierReplay delivers up to 1.54x higher goodput while preserving exact task accuracy, avoiding the up to 17% accuracy drop suffered by approximation on long contexts.
papers.comment: 15 pages (12 pages main text + references), 12 figures, 4 tables

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法实用且潜在影响大。
pros: 提出“无切分预填充+边界精确回放”机制，直击混合模型前缀复用瓶颈。
覆盖多架构与多负载并报告TTFT/SLO/goodput与精度对比，工程与系统价值突出。
cons: 关键主张依赖“边界可预测”假设，若在线场景边界不稳定或分布漂移，收益与稳定性可能明显回落。

papers.title_zh: FrontierReplay：混合语言模型的无分割精确前缀缓存
papers.summary_zh: 混合语言模型将自注意力机制与循环层相结合，循环层的就地状态更新将前缀重用限制在精确保存的位置。在粗网格上保存状态会浪费可重用的前缀，而现有的细粒度精确缓存必须在每个中间提示检查点削减预填充前向传递，增加的调度程序步骤超过了负载下的重用增益。我们观察到，在多回合聊天、代理循环、文档问答和树搜索中，前缀重用几乎总是以可提前预测的结构边界结束，例如回合结束和已知分支点。我们推出了 FrontierReplay，这是一个前缀缓存系统，可以在这些边界处实现精确的检查点，而无需削减预填充。当前向传递未切割时，FrontierReplay 会记录循环层输入的短窗口，并调用跨层、仅状态重播内核来构建目标状态，每个令牌比没有主机同步的完全重新计算便宜 6-37 倍。前沿感知保留策略优先考虑活动锚点和经过验证的分支，同时将死检查点槽借给注意力 KV 缓存。在不同的混合架构、模型规模和工作负载中，FrontierReplay 与现有的精确缓存相比具有明显的优势，将首次令牌 (TTFT) 的中值时间降低了 16-89%（高达 8.9 倍），将 80% 的服务级别目标 (SLO) 容量提高高达 1.73 倍，并将吞吐量提高高达 4.26 倍（在更大规模时为 3.67 倍）。与近似重放方法相比，FrontierReplay 的吞吐量提高了 1.54 倍，同时保持了精确的任务精度，避免了长上下文中的近似导致的高达 17% 的精度下降。

papers.title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10 percentage points of full attention, with RULER evaluated up to 128K tokens. At 128K tokens, DTS reduces measured scoring-pipeline latency by 38% compared with XAttention. On four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it achieves a 3.3$\times$ prefill speedup over a PyTorch full-attention baseline using FlashAttention-2 at 512K tokens.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at DATE 2027. Emre Uğur and Jiawen Qi contributed equally

papers.title_zh: DTS：基于 Delta 的 Tile 评分，实现高效的长上下文稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越需要处理长文档和代码库，这使得长上下文注意力成为主要的预填充瓶颈。块稀疏注意力通过跳过注意力矩阵中不重要的块来减少计算，但准确地对块进行评分本身就很昂贵。我们提出了基于 Delta 的图块评分（DTS），这是一种用于稀疏块注意力的免训练、内容自适应图块评分方法。 DTS根据局部向量变化选择查询和关键锚点，在冗余区域中使用更少的代表，同时在异构区域中保留更多细节。为了加速锚点选择，并行增量打包将查询和键序列划分为平铺对齐的块，并同时对这些块执行有界本地扫描。然后使用原始查询、键和值向量计算所选图块。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，DTS 将平均 RULER 和 LongBench 分数保持在完全关注的 0.10 个百分点以内，RULER 评估多达 128K 代币。在 128K 令牌下，与 XAttention 相比，DTS 将测量的评分管道延迟减少了 38%。在 4 个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，与使用 FlashAttention-2 的 PyTorch 全注意力基准（512K 令牌）相比，它实现了 3.3$\times$ 的预填充加速。

papers.title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
papers.summary: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但学术新意与因果证据偏弱。
pros: 聚焦企业从闭源API迁移到自部署的现实痛点，问题重要且及时。
给出贯穿测试到生产的验证流程，并提供可复现实验数据与开源工具。
