papers.title_zh: 针对代理工作负载的 LLM 推理平台的验证驱动部署
papers.summary_zh: 企业正在将代理工作负载从封闭的 API 转移到自己的开放权重模型部署。因此，从小规模测试到规模调整和预生产再到生产的整个生命周期验证变得更加重要。通常，部署是使用临时工具进行评估的，但很少检查其准确性。我们提出了一个用于代理法学硕士服务的端到端评估流程，并根据经验确定了连接其各阶段的设计选择。我们的实验表明，重放捕获的跟踪会重现原始代理会话的每个会话负载：在第 95 个百分位数处，重放保持在记录输入令牌的 1.18 倍以内，而实时重新运行达到 4.98 倍，因此一小部分记录的会话会产生可重复的每会话令牌负载。 vLLM 的代码覆盖率分析进一步表明，在此配置中评估的实时、重放和合成工作负载是互补的：每个练习都练习在其他测量运行中未达到的 Python 服务路径。在一个在 llm-d 上推出四个大型专家混合 (MoE) 模型的案例研究中，实验表明，与公共跟踪相比，目标模型在捕获的工作负载上达到了大约一半的最佳并发性，相应地达到了大约 60% 的吞吐量。我们开源了相关工具并发布了跟踪数据集。

papers.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
papers.summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both large server-side setups (up to 3.1$\times$) and smaller models targeting memory-constrained on-device environments (up to 2.3$\times$ on H100 and up to 2.2$\times$ on a smartphone GPU). In addition, we present parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes for G-MTP that keep the drafter aligned with the backbone LLM under domain shift, requiring up to 1.83$\times$ fewer target forward passes than tuning only the backbone.

quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但方法新意与证据强度仍待验证。

papers.title_zh: 通过多标记预测实现高效、稳健的起草
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码已成为一种通过将生成过程解耦为起草阶段和并行验证阶段来加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的关键技术。因此，一个关键的挑战是设计一个既轻量又足够准确的绘图器，以近似目标模型的预测。我们提出了一种高度优化的多令牌预测（MTP）架构，该架构扩展了现有的骨干法学硕士，以有效地生成高质量的草稿。我们的方法围绕单个共享绘图头构建，具有三个核心架构优化：目标激活注入到锚定语义规划、零拷贝 KV 缓存交叉注意力以绕过预填充计算并减少内存开销，以及高效的集群词汇投影以降低全词汇解码的成本。使用 Gemma 4 模型系列测试这些改进，我们的 G-MTP 显示了大型服务器端设置（高达 3.1$\times$）和针对内存受限的设备上环境的小型模型（在 H100 上高达 2.3$\times$，在智能手机 GPU 上高达 2.2$\times$）的开箱即用加速。此外，我们还提出了 G-MTP 的参数高效微调方案，使起草者在域转移下与主干 LLM 保持一致，与仅调整主干相比，需要的目标前向传递次数最多减少 1.83$\times$。

papers.title: Ask in the Crowd: Differentially Private LLM Inference via Dummy-Augmented Shuffling
papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as LLM-as-a-Service (LLMaaS), where user queries are sent to remote LLMs for inference, raising severe privacy concerns about the exposure of sensitive user inputs. Differentially private inference mitigates these risks by injecting noise into input embeddings. However, existing methods struggle to balance privacy and utility, as stronger privacy protection often leads to substantial accuracy degradation in LLM inference. In this work, we propose DP-SPD, a differentially private LLM inference framework that protects user queries by hiding the real query among client-generated dummy queries. All queries are randomly shuffled before being sent to the server, preventing direct identification of the user's true intent. To improve inference efficiency, we exploit the shared-prefix structure among queries and reuse transformer key--value (KV) caches during decoding. We analyze the privacy guarantee of DP-SPD and evaluate its utility on classification and generation tasks, as well as its privacy protection under QIA, EIA, and GPT-based attacks. Experimental results show that our method achieves strong inference-time privacy protection and near-plaintext utility while improving inference efficiency through shared-prefix KV-cache reuse.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用但理论与评测完整性仍不足
pros: 将伪查询+打乱用于推理隐私，兼顾可部署性

papers.title_zh: 在人群中提问：通过虚拟增强洗牌进行差异化私人 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地部署为 LLM 即服务 (LLMaaS)，其中用户查询被发送到远程 LLM 进行推理，引发了对敏感用户输入暴露的严重隐私担忧。差分私有推理通过向输入嵌入注入噪声来减轻这些风险。然而，现有的方法很难平衡隐私和实用性，因为更强的隐私保护往往会导致 LLM 推理的准确性大幅下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了 DP-SPD，这是一种差异化私有 LLM 推理框架，它通过在客户端生成的虚拟查询中隐藏真实查询来保护用户查询。所有查询在发送到服务器之前都会被随机打乱，从而防止直接识别用户的真实意图。为了提高推理效率，我们利用查询之间的共享前缀结构，并在解码期间重用转换器键值（KV）缓存。我们分析了 DP-SPD 的隐私保证，并评估其在分类和生成任务上的效用，以及在 QIA、EIA 和基于 GPT 的攻击下的隐私保护。实验结果表明，我们的方法实现了强大的推理时隐私保护和接近明文的实用性，同时通过共享前缀 KV 缓存重用提高了推理效率。

papers.title: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
papers.summary: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.

评测依赖自建基准且缺少充分消融与统计显著性分析

papers.title_zh: MatVerse：材料科学的基础模型
papers.summary_zh: 材料科学涉及高度异构的科学信息，包括文本知识、分子和晶体结构、实验表征数据、显微镜图像和结构-性质关系。开发一个能够理解和推理这些不同材料表示的通用基础模型仍然具有挑战性。在本技术报告中，我们介绍了 MatVerse，这是一种基于 Intern-S2-Preview 构建的材料基础模型，并通过大规模材料领域后培训进一步专业化。我们构建了一个大规模的多模态训练语料库，涵盖材料知识、科学推理、定量问题解决、结构理解和多模态科学解释。为了提高领域适应性，我们开发了一个统一的数据构建管道，结合了教师指导的推理蒸馏、科学问题综合、基于一致性的过滤和基于检索的多模态数据构建。我们根据三个代表性材料科学基准评估 MatVerse：我们的人工校准 OmniMatBench、MatSciBench 和 MaCBench。结果表明，在所有三个基准上，经过特定于材料的后训练后，基础模型都得到了一致的改进，同时计算密集型问题的推理效率也得到了提高。这些结果表明，有针对性的特定领域后培训可以有效增强基础模型的科学推理、材料知识理解和多模态科学能力。 MatVerse 为材料科学提供了统一的语言和视觉界面，并作为未来人工智能辅助材料研究工作流程的基础。

papers.title: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
papers.summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法有新意，结果强但证据仍偏摘要级。
pros: 将“未来潜变量保真”引入W4A4KV4量化目标，切中WAM关键误差来源
给出读者度量与读次数加权并宣称闭式分配，兼顾精度、内存与速度且含真机结果
cons: 摘要未说明统计显著性、方差与消融充分性，严谨性证据不足
相对16位仍有性能差距，跨任务/跨硬件泛化与稳定性风险未充分量化

papers.title_zh: 不要失去未来：世界行动模型的潜在感知 4 位量化
papers.summary_zh: 世界动作模型 (WAM) 预测场景将如何演变，并根据预测的未来调整其动作。将它们部署在机器人的机载计算机上需要 4 位权重、激活和键值缓存 (W4A4KV4)。现有的 WAM 4 位量化器保留了生成的动作，并一次估计一个降噪步骤的灵敏度。然而，他们无法保持预测未来的保真度：一旦行动路径受到保护，剩余的行动错误主要是通过他们都没有刻意保护的退化未来进入。我们提出了 LAQ，一种潜在感知量化框架，可以保留写入、存储和读取的预测未来。具体来说，我们引入了一个读者指标，它通过对操作的影响来衡量未来的错误，以及一个读取计数，它通过读取它的去噪步骤数对每个舍入误差进行加权。它们共同给出了激活的精度分配并缓存了一个封闭形式的解决方案。我们进一步开发了注视引导的细化，这将动作所关注的标记提供给去噪循环和缓存中的第二个 4 位通道。所有权重都保持在 4 位，没有高精度分支，也没有每个任务的重新校准。在 LIBERO-Plus 基准测试中，LAQ 在 Fast-WAM 和 Cosmos-Policy 上的平均成功率达到 76.4% 和 83.3%，与 16 位模型相差 1.2 个百分点，并且均高于 16 位 KV 缓存的基线。它将模型压缩了3.8倍，整个策略的峰值GPU内存减少了2.3倍，运行速度比16位模型快1.66倍。在真正的 AgileX PiPER 手臂上，它在三项任务上的平均成功率为 47.0%，而 16 位模型为 52.0%，比 QuaRot 高出 30.0%。

papers.title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
papers.summary: Embodied agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for complex robotic tasks, leveraging Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) to generate actions through Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based iterative denoising. However, existing models often struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. We observe that retrieving successful experiences and using them to warm-start denoising enables agents to better adapt to unfamiliar situations while reducing computational overhead. This creates a new opportunity to improve task accuracy and inference efficiency simultaneously, in contrast to conventional acceleration techniques that trade accuracy for computation. However, realizing this opportunity requires scaling experience banks, introducing substantial storage and search overhead that challenges the capacity, bandwidth, and power constraints of edge systems. We propose FlashX, a CMOS Directly Bonded to Array (CBA)-based NAND flash architecture for scalable experience reuse in embodied agents. FlashX exploits CBA's high internal bandwidth for parallel pSLC key search, employing interleaved Compute-in-Flash (CIF) engines to sustain sensing throughput while retaining dense TLC latent storage. Proprioception-aware clustering further reduces search overhead and enables incremental experience acquisition without global reclustering. Evaluations across VLA and WAM workloads demonstrate up to 12.24\%p and 7.43\%p improvements in task success under dense and compute-efficient configurations, respectively. FlashX achieves 2.57$\times$ higher search throughput than the strongest prior NAND search architecture under pSLC sensing, with a further 9.7$\times$ search reduction through clustering. This delivers 1.29--3.95$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 1.12--2.34$\times$ energy efficiency improvement over SSD-based retrieval.

papers.title_zh: FlashX：使用基于 CBA 的 NAND 闪存扩展实体代理的机器人体验重用
papers.summary_zh: 实体代理正在成为复杂机器人任务的一种有前途的范例，利用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）通过基于扩散变压器（DiT）的迭代去噪来生成动作。然而，现有模型通常很难推广到分布外 (OOD) 环境。我们观察到，检索成功的经验并使用它们来热启动去噪可以使智能体更好地适应不熟悉的情况，同时减少计算开销。与以计算精度为代价的传统加速技术相比，这创造了同时提高任务准确性和推理效率的新机会。然而，实现这一机会需要扩展经验库，引入大量存储和搜索开销，从而挑战边缘系统的容量、带宽和功耗限制。我们提出了 FlashX，这是一种基于 CMOS 直接绑定到阵列 (CBA) 的 NAND 闪存架构，用于在实体代理中实现可扩展的经验重用。 FlashX 利用 CBA 的高内部带宽进行并行 pSLC 密钥搜索，采用交错式闪存计算 (CIF) 引擎来维持传感吞吐量，同时保留密集的 TLC 潜在存储。本体感知感知的聚类进一步减少了搜索开销，并且无需全局重新聚类即可实现增量经验获取。对 VLA 和 WAM 工作负载的评估表明，在密集和计算高效的配置下，任务成功率分别提高了 12.24\%p 和 7.43\%p。在 pSLC 传感下，FlashX 的搜索吞吐量比之前最强的 NAND 搜索架构高 2.57$\times$，并通过集群进一步减少 9.7$\times$ 搜索。与基于 SSD 的检索相比，这可实现 1.29--3.95$\times$ 端到端加速和 1.12--2.34$\times$ 能源效率改进。

papers.title: Raptor: Rejection-aware Adaptive Tree based on Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Tree-structured speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models (VLMs) by verifying multiple candidate continuations in parallel. However, long visual contexts increase the cost of speculative computation, making candidate coverage and redundant expansion important considerations beyond tree topology adaptation. We propose Raptor, a training-free framework that uses rejection feedback to jointly regulate candidate coverage and drafting effort. Our key insight is that acceptance length alone cannot distinguish insufficient candidate coverage from excessive deep expansion, and these conditions require different allocation decisions. Raptor therefore extracts complementary rejection-aware signals to characterize speculative progress, frontier coverage, and redundant expansion. These signals jointly guide bounded, momentum-smoothed updates of tree depth, branching width, and drafting budget, together with execution control that limits unnecessary drafting and progressively restores expansion when appropriate. Extensive experiments with two VLMs across seven multimodal benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Raptor, achieving up to 2.39x average speedup over autoregressive decoding.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法实用但证据仍需更扎实。

papers.title_zh: Raptor：基于推测解码的拒绝感知自适应树
papers.summary_zh: 树结构推测解码通过并行验证多个候选延续来加速视觉语言模型 (VLM)。然而，长视觉上下文增加了推测计算的成本，使得候选覆盖和冗余扩展成为树拓扑适应之外的重要考虑因素。我们提出了 Raptor，这是一个免培训的框架，它使用拒绝反馈来共同规范候选人的覆盖范围和起草工作。我们的主要见解是，仅接受长度无法区分候选覆盖范围不足和过度深度扩展，并且这些条件需要不同的分配决策。因此，Raptor 提取互补的拒绝感知信号来表征投机进展、前沿覆盖范围和冗余扩展。这些信号共同指导树深度、分支宽度和绘图预算的有界、动量平滑更新，以及限制不必要的绘图并在适当时逐步恢复扩展的执行控制。在七个多模态基准测试中使用两个 VLM 进行的广泛实验证明了 Raptor 的有效性，与自回归解码相比，平均加速高达 2.39 倍。

papers.title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
papers.summary: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.

papers.title_zh: RoCoKV：通过不确定性和冗余感知 KV 缓存压缩加速 LLM 推理服务
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存压缩对于大型推理模型至关重要，其中大部分成本来自于长时间生成的推理轨迹而不是输入提示。由于循环、自我验证和更正，这些跟踪通常包含冗余和低效用的令牌。然而，此类标记仍可能获得较高的关注分数，因此很难在不损害推理过程的情况下删除它们。我们提出了RoCoKV，一种专为大型推理模型设计的KV缓存压缩方法。 RoCoKV 引入了两个关键组件。首先，不确定性引导的自适应剪枝根据模型的置信度调整压缩强度，在不确定阶段分配更多内存，并在模型有置信度时应用更强的剪枝。其次，冗余感知的标记选择减少了与最近推理内容高度相似的标记的影响，鼓励模型保留更多信息和多样化的标记。除了算法之外，我们还与服务堆栈共同设计 RoCoKV：我们开发融合的三相 CUDA 解码内核，并将它们作为插入式插件集成到 vLLM 中，保留其分页 KV 布局和 CUDA 图形捕获，将算法节省转化为真正的端到端加速。三个推理基准和两个推理模型的大量实验表明，RoCoKV 在 KV 缓存预算受限的情况下持续提高推理精度，与最先进的 KV 缓存压缩方法相比，实现了更高的精度。对于 vLLM 中的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B，与 Full-KV 相比，RoCoKV 在最具挑战性的评估推理基准 AIME25 上实现了 1.27 倍的加速和 38% 的吞吐量提高，在长合成基准上实现了 1.43 倍的加速和 45% 的吞吐量提高。

papers.title: TripleKV: Predict, Prefetch, Protect - KV Cache Management for AI Agents
papers.summary: LLM agents alternate between inference and tool execution, repeatedly reusing their growing context across calls. Under high concurrency, their combined key-value (KV) cache working set can reach hundreds of GiB, far exceeding GPU memory capacity. As idle KV cache blocks are evicted to slower storage tiers, returning agents incur expensive retrievals that stall inference. To address this problem, we present TripleKV, a three-tier KV cache management system that hides the delays of these retrievals. In agentic workloads, the KV blocks needed by the next inference request are known in advance; only the time of their reuse is uncertain. TripleKV uses a tool-aware latency predictor to estimate when each tool call will complete and prefetches the required KV blocks from SSD into host DRAM ahead of time. Unlike GPU prefetching, this avoids reserving scarce GPU memory and interfering with concurrent inference requests. To further improve DRAM utilization, TripleKV eliminates duplication of GPU-resident blocks in DRAM, and introduces a victim-cache mechanism that refills blocks from SSD upon their eviction from GPU memory. Across data, web, and coding agents, TripleKV reduces the fraction of requests requiring critical-path SSD reads from 45-76% to under 10%. It also reduces P95 time to first token (TTFT) by up to 49% compared with vLLM extended with DRAM and SSD KV-cache tiers, and achieves 1.5-7$\times$ lower P95 TTFT than recent agent-aware systems.

papers.title_zh: TripleKV：预测、预取、保护——AI 代理的 KV 缓存管理
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理在推理和工具执行之间交替，在调用中反复重用不断增长的上下文。在高并发下，它们的组合键值（KV）缓存工作集可以达到数百GiB，远远超过GPU内存容量。由于空闲的 KV 缓存块被逐出到较慢的存储层，返回代理会产生昂贵的检索，从而导致推理停滞。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 \emph{TripleKV}，一个三层 KV 缓存管理系统，可以隐藏这些检索的延迟。 %利用工具执行来隐藏这些延迟。在代理工作负载中，下一个推理请求所需的 KV 块是预先知道的；只是它们的重用时间不确定。 TripleKV 使用工具感知延迟预测器来估计每个工具调用何时完成，并提前将所需的 KV 块从 SSD 预取到主机 DRAM 中。与 GPU 预取不同，这可以避免保留稀缺的 GPU 内存并干扰并发推理请求。为了进一步提高 DRAM 利用率，TripleKV 消除了 DRAM 中 GPU 驻留块的重复，并引入了受害者缓存机制，该机制可以在 SSD 中的块从 GPU 内存中逐出时重新填充这些块。在数据、Web 和编码代理中，TripleKV 将需要关键路径 SSD 读取的请求比例从 45--76\% 减少到 10\% 以下。与使用 DRAM 和 SSD KV 缓存层扩展的 vLLM 相比，它还将 P95 首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 缩短了 49%，并且比最新的代理感知系统降低了 1.5-7$\times$ 的 P95 TTFT。

papers.title: Berth: SLO-Preserving GPU Sharing Without New Preemption
papers.summary: Inference services keep GPUs reserved for their worst-case load, and most of that capacity sits idle. Filling it with best-effort work such as training is the obvious remedy, and latency is why it rarely happens: on a shared GPU, a request that must finish within milliseconds finds the best-effort job's kernels running or queued ahead of it. Spatial sharing cannot evict them, temporal sharing gives the request only its turn, and hardware partitioning protects it by idling what it does not use. Systems that keep both the SLO and the utilization have reached inside the stack (rewriting kernels, patching the driver, instrumenting the framework), which the operator of a closed GPU stack cannot do. This paper argues that reaching inside is unnecessary. The time-slicer built into commodity GPUs already preempts a running kernel within a fraction of a millisecond and switches the moment a context runs out of work; what it lacks is priority, and priority can be created from outside by controlling what the best-effort context has to run. Berth is a user-space system built on this observation: a preloaded shim feeds the best-effort job to the GPU only when no request needs it (feed control), a declared deadline reference extends the rule to continuous-batching LLM engines, and a shortened best-effort time slice, set without privileges, bounds what a long kernel can cost. Berth changes no application, framework, kernel or driver. Across 31 scenario points with MLPerf SLOs and 13 baselines, Berth meets SLOs within a few percentage points of running alone, above every baseline, with 2.7-3.5x the best-effort throughput of the strongest ones; beside LLM serving, it meets per-token targets for nearly every request while training keeps running. Sharing a closed GPU under SLOs needs no new preemption mechanism, only control over what the existing one sees.

cons: 核心假设依赖GPU时间切片行为与可控性，跨硬件/驱动版本的稳定性与可复现性风险仍待更充分验证

papers.title_zh: Berth：SLO - 保留 GPU 共享而无需新的抢占
papers.summary_zh: 推理服务将 GPU 保留用于最坏情况的负载，并且大部分容量处于闲置状态。用训练等尽力而为的工作来填充它是显而易见的补救措施，而延迟则是这种情况很少发生的原因：在共享 GPU 上，必须在几毫秒内完成的请求会发现尽力而为的作业的内核正在运行或在其前面排队。空间共享无法驱逐它们，时间共享只轮流请求，而硬件分区则通过闲置不使用的内容来保护请求。保持 SLO 和利用率的系统已经到达堆栈内部（重写内核、修补驱动程序、检测框架），这是封闭 GPU 堆栈的操作员无法做到的。本文认为，进入内部是不必要的。商用 GPU 中内置的时间切片器已经在不到一毫秒的时间内抢占正在运行的内核，并在上下文耗尽工作时进行切换；它缺少的是优先级，并且可以通过控制尽力而为上下文必须运行的内容来从外部创建优先级。 Berth 是一个基于此观察构建的用户空间系统：预加载的填充程序仅在没有请求需要时才将尽力而为的作业提供给 GPU（馈送控制），声明的截止日期参考将规则扩展到连续批处理 LLM 引擎，并且在没有特权的情况下设置缩短的尽力而为的时间片，限制了长内核的成本。 Berth 不会更改应用程序、框架、内核或驱动程序。在具有 MLPerf SLO 的 31 个场景点和 13 个基线中，Berth 在单独运行的几个百分点内满足 SLO，高于每个基线，尽力吞吐量是最强基线的 2.7-3.5 倍；除了 LLM 服务之外，它还可以在训练持续运行的同时满足几乎每个请求的每个代币目标。在 SLO 下共享封闭 GPU 不需要新的抢占机制，只需控制现有 GPU 所看到的内容即可。

papers.title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且工程价值高，但泛化待验证。
pros: 用布尔电路压缩可解释探针，精度与开销权衡出色
与vLLM深度集成并报告高并发吞吐与KV容量影响，实用性强
cons: 评测主要集中于Gemma-2-9B与24任务，跨模型与跨分布鲁棒性证据不足

papers.title_zh: GateWatch：使用布尔电路进行低开销 LLM 监控
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 和基于 LLM 的代理的部署越来越多，监控其行为对于检测不安全或意外操作变得非常重要。激活探针提供了一种有效的方法，但现有方法面临着准确性、可解释性和计算开销之间的权衡。原始激活的探针缺乏可解释的输入，而稀疏自动编码器 (SAE) 探针使用可解释的特征，但通常依赖于附加分类器和大型 SAE 编码器，限制了可解释性并增加了内存开销。我们引入了 GateWatch，这是一个紧凑的、可解释的分类器，它将其整个决策规则表达为针对少量二值化 SAE 特征的显式布尔逻辑。我们探索了三种在指定的门预算下构建这些电路的方法。为了实现高效部署，GateWatchServe 仅计算选定的 SAE 功能，在推理期间启用跨层流式传输其二进制值，并使用紧凑查找表并行评估多个 GateWatch 分类器。在 Gemma-2-9B 上的 24 项任务中，GateWatch 平均仅使用 3.8 个 SAE 功能和每个探头 3.5 个逻辑门，即可实现 80.49% 的平均测试精度，仅比完整的 16K 功能 SAE 探头低 1.17 个百分点，同时在 10 项任务上匹配或优于它们，并将探头内存减少 99.98%。在 vLLM 内部，1,000 个并发多层、多令牌 GateWatch 分类器保留 ​​97-98% 的基线吞吐量和 99.8% 的 KV 缓存容量。

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped Transformers achieve large effective depth with compact models by repeatedly applying a weight-shared block across R recurrent steps, each maintaining a loop-specific key-value (KV) cache. To accelerate sequential loop execution, recent wave-style self-speculative methods like WaveFront Decoding (WFD) and LoopSpec pipeline draft and target tokens across loops in a single step. However, they face two critical limitations. First, they draft only at fixed loops and ignore intermediate prediction changes, wasting computation on stale trajectories. Second, batching tokens from different loops loads up to Rx the KV cache per step, severely amplifying memory traffic in long-context scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose LoopCache, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers. Based on the correlation between prediction switches and output confidence, LoopCache introduces confidence-guided dynamic draft updating to refine drafts in flight across all intermediate loops. Furthermore, LoopCache employs a cyclic loop KV cache strategy that rotates through loop-specific KV caches, restricting per-step KV traffic to a single loop while batching tokens at the nearest matching cycle for lossless verification. By also selectively retaining independent KV caches for a few loop-sensitive shallow layers, LoopCache improves acceptance rates with negligible overhead. Experiments show that LoopCache achieves average 10.25x and 14.56x speedup over WFD and LoopSpec.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法成体系，但证据充分性待检验。
pros: 同时针对草稿陈旧与长上下文KV带宽瓶颈，动机明确且痛点真实
动态草稿更新与循环KV缓存结合紧密，兼顾吞吐提升与无损验证叙事
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融与边界条件（如不同R/上下文长度/硬件）的细节，14.56x增益的可泛化性与复现风险仍高

papers.title_zh: LoopCache：加速循环 Transformer 的长上下文自推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 循环 Transformer 通过在 R 个循环步骤中重复应用权重共享块，每个循环都维护一个特定于循环的键值 (KV) 缓存，从而通过紧凑模型实现较大的有效深度。为了加速顺序循环执行，最近的波式自推测方法（例如 WaveFront Decoding (WFD) 和 LoopSpec pipeline）可以在一个步骤中跨循环草拟和定位令牌。然而，它们面临两个关键的限制。首先，它们仅在固定循环处起草并忽略中间预测变化，将计算浪费在过时的轨迹上。其次，来自不同循环的批处理令牌每一步都会加载到 Rx KV 缓存，从而严重放大长上下文场景中的内存流量。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 LoopCache，一种用于长上下文 Looped Transformer 的高效自推测解码框架。基于预测开关和输出置信度之间的相关性，LoopCache 引入了置信度引导的动态草稿更新，以优化所有中间循环中的草稿。此外，LoopCache 采用循环循环 KV 缓存策略，通过循环特定的 KV 缓存进行轮换，将每步 KV 流量限制为单个循环，同时在最近的匹配周期对令牌进行批处理以进行无损验证。通过选择性地为一些循环敏感的浅层保留独立的 KV 缓存，LoopCache 以可忽略的开销提高了接受率。实验表明，LoopCache 比 WFD 和 LoopSpec 平均加速 10.25 倍和 14.56 倍。

papers.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
papers.summary: Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget allocation, and GPU frequency selection through a common normalized-throughput target. Specifically, request dispatching prioritizes requests by desired service level and progress; electricity budget allocation reserves electricity for current and expected future work; and frequency selection uses electricity savings to raise GPU frequencies for requests with higher desired service levels. Evaluations on H20 and H200 configurations, each with 32 replicas, show that eFAIR improves the tenth percentile of normalized throughput by 28.0%-31.0% over the best budget-feasible baseline, while keeping absolute deviations from the hourly electricity commitment below 0.26%. eFAIR also improves throughput balance among concurrent requests and aligns electricity allocation more closely with service demand over time. Together, these results demonstrate how eFAIR improves request-level fairness within an hourly commitment.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案完整，但证据深度仍不足
pros: 聚焦“小时级电力承诺+请求公平”这一现实且有价值的交叉问题
统一调度、预算分配与频率控制，并给出可量化的公平性提升与预算遵从结果
cons: 摘要未充分说明基线是否最优公平方法、在线预测误差与负载分布变化下的鲁棒性及统计显著性，严谨性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: eFAIR：根据每小时电力承诺提供公平的法学硕士服务
papers.summary_zh: 数据中心可以通过承诺个别时间的能源购买来在日前市场采购电力。对于在这些小时预算内运行的法学硕士服务，仅最大化总吞吐量可能仍然会使单个请求等待或接收比预期慢得多的服务。因此，公平服务需要改善对服务质量差的请求的服务，同时为后来到达的时间和需求未知的人保留电力。为了比较跨请求的服务，我们将标准化吞吐量定义为每个请求的实际输出率除以其独立吞吐量与其服务权利的乘积，即代表其所需服务水平的正权重。使用这种措施，我们在每小时电力约束下制定公平服务作为词素优化，优先考虑具有最低标准化吞吐量的请求。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 eFAIR，一种在线调度程序，它通过通用的归一化吞吐量目标来协调请求调度、电力预算分配和 GPU 频率选择。具体来说，请求分派根据所需的服务级别和进度对请求进行优先级排序；电力预算分配为当前和预期的未来工作预留电力；频率选择利用节电来提高 GPU 频率，以满足更高所需服务级别的请求。对 H20 和 H200 配置（每个配置有 32 个副本）的评估表明，eFAIR 将标准化吞吐量的第十个百分点比最佳预算可行基线提高了 28.0%-31.0%，同时将每小时电力承诺的绝对偏差保持在 0.26% 以下。eFAIR 还改善了并发请求之间的吞吐量平衡，并使电力分配更紧密地与服务需求保持一致。这些结果共同证明了 eFAIR 如何在每小时的承诺内提高请求级别的公平性。

papers.title: LEDGE: An Efficient Simulator for Distributed LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
papers.summary: Evaluating distributed large language model (LLM) serving on heterogeneous edge devices requires exploring diverse model partitions, device placements, and network conditions, making repeated physical experiments costly. An efficient simulator for edge LLM serving must support diverse, fine-grained placement configurations, capture runtime behavior, and accurately predict execution times while keeping simulation overhead low. We present LEDGE, a lightweight simulator for fast, fine-grained evaluation of distributed LLM serving on heterogeneous edge devices without executing tensor operations. LEDGE constructs event graphs supporting non-uniform tensor and pipeline parallelism, estimates execution costs using reusable performance models calibrated from end-to-end measurements, and simulates shared-link contention. We evaluate LEDGE on a heterogeneous testbed of 10 Jetson and Raspberry Pi devices, covering 17 model--precision combinations across 4 LLM families. On Qwen deployments, LEDGE achieves request-level mean absolute percentage errors below 3.6% and a 135.3 times aggregate speedup over physical inference. Performance model calibrated on one LLM family yield 7.44% zero-shot end-to-end latency MAPE across three other families. Further simulations show how shared-link contention affects placement decisions and network topology constrains scaling. Across four edge environments, LEDGE completes 26,773 simulation runs in 83.8 minutes, enabling efficient exploration of deployment strategies under diverse resource conditions and serving objectives. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/gdfwj/LEDGE.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但方法新颖性中等。
pros: 面向异构边缘LLM分布式服务，问题设定现实且有实用意义
实验覆盖设备、模型与配置较广，精度与加速比结果有说服力

papers.title_zh: LEDGE：服务于异构边缘设备的分布式 LLM 的高效模拟器
papers.summary_zh: 评估在异构边缘设备上服务的分布式大语言模型 (LLM) 需要探索不同的模型分区、设备布局和网络条件，这使得重复的物理实验成本高昂。用于边缘 LLM 服务的高效模拟器必须支持多样化、细粒度的布局配置、捕获运行时行为并准确预测执行时间，同时保持较低的模拟开销。我们推出了 LEDGE，这是一种轻量级模拟器，用于对异构边缘设备上服务的分布式 LLM 进行快速、细粒度的评估，而无需执行张量操作。 LEDGE 构建支持非均匀张量和管道并行性的事件图，使用根据端到端测量校准的可重用性能模型来估计执行成本，并模拟共享链路争用。我们在 10 个 Jetson 和 Raspberry Pi 设备的异构测试平台上评估 LEDGE，涵盖 4 个 LLM 系列的 17 个模型精度组合。在 Qwen 部署中，LEDGE 实现了低于 3.6% 的请求级平均绝对百分比错误，并且比物理推理的聚合加速提高了 135.3 倍。在一个 LLM 系列上校准的性能模型在其他三个系列中产生 7.44% 的零样本端到端延迟 MAPE。进一步的模拟显示共享链路争用如何影响布局决策以及网络拓扑如何限制扩展。在四个边缘环境中，LEDGE 在 83.8 分钟内完成了 26,773 次模拟运行，从而能够有效探索不同资源条件和服务目标下的部署策略。源代码可在 https://github.com/gdfwj/LEDGE 上公开获取。

papers.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
papers.summary: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且应用价值高，但证据完整性待检验。
pros: 将多模态感知引入step-level speculative judge，抓住现有方法关键盲点

papers.title_zh: Vanguard：知道何时信任投机性视觉语言代理的草案
papers.summary_zh: 浏览网站、操作电话和在家中行动的视觉语言代理在执行每个操作之前都会进行推理，因此每一步都需要等待一个大型模型，延迟和成本阻碍了部署。步骤级推测让小模型起草每个步骤，并仅在被拒绝的草稿上调用大模型，但其结果取决于法官，而仅读取步骤文本的法官无法判断该步骤是否适合其所作用的屏幕。我们发现，小模型的一些样本可以包含与大模型正确步骤一样多的正确步骤，但并不总是在相同的步骤上：根据屏幕检查，小草稿不仅更便宜，而且更好。我们提出了 Vanguard，一种无需训练的判断，保持草稿和目标模型不变：一个通用决策模型，可以看到屏幕截图，为每个候选步骤提供在一次前向传递中正确的概率；如果清除了阈值，则保留最佳候选者，否则大型模型将写入该步骤。在网络、移动和实体代理上，Vanguard 判断的 2B 草案至少与其 8B 目标一样准确，并且在 Mind2Web 和 EB-ALFRED 上准确得多，而目标只编写了一小部分步骤；它完成了更多的闭环情节，并且使用另一个系列的 27B 目标，它更快、更准确。 Vanguard 是我们对代理任务进行比较时最准确的判断；它依赖于网络和移动任务上的屏幕截图，其校准阈值传输到看不见的网站，并且在各个模型系列中，其相对于目标准确度的草稿 pass@4 的增益随着草稿的 pass@4 的增长而增长。Vanguard 采用代币级推测解码，并在数学上匹配经过训练的过程奖励模型，将推测从一种保存大型模型工作的方式转变为一种可以改进的方式。

papers.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.

quality.verdict: 实用价值较强，但方法新颖性中等且证据仍需扩展。

实验覆盖面仍偏窄，缺少更多模型规模、采样设置与长上下文验证

papers.title_zh: NarrowSpec：草稿隐藏宽度不需要与推测解码中的目标匹配
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码广泛用于加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 的生成速度，其中一个小型草稿模型提出目标模型的一次前向传递验证的标记。读取目标隐藏状态的草稿模型（例如 DFlash 和 EAGLE-3）通常会继承目标的隐藏宽度。我们表明，草案的整个剩余流可以以该宽度的一半或四分之一运行，同时在很大程度上保持接受度。对于借用目标词汇投影的 DFlash，经过训练的输出适配器会折叠到其中，从而提供一个较窄的投影，其中 logits 保持不变直至浮点舍入。我们在 B200 和 DGX Spark (GB10) 上的 SGLang 中，在 Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) 和 GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4) 两个目标上测试了两个绘图仪系列 DFlash 和 EAGLE-3。在批量大小为 1 且温度为 0 时，将草图宽度缩小到一半或四分之一可以将 B200 上的端到端解码速度提高 1.06-1.12 倍，在 GB10 上提高 1.13-1.44 倍。加速在较大的批量大小下保持不变。从批次 32 到每个 GPU 适合的最大批次，两个 GPU 上的缩小都达到了 1.21 倍，而且窄草稿的速度都不比全宽慢。

papers.title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
papers.summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向SVG推理加速有实质价值，但严谨性证据仍需补强。
pros: 抓住SVG投机解码“长段可全收”的结构性特征，提出长窗口+宽草稿树组合，思路有针对性。

papers.title_zh: Sightline：用于快速 SVG 生成的长窗口推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 可扩展矢量图形 (SVG) 生成模型将图形编写为代码，每个标记一次前向传递，因此绘图速度很慢。推测性解码可以无损地加速它们，并且区块起草者每次都会猜测许多令牌。在 SVG 上，他们的许多回合都接受整个草稿并仅在验证窗口结束。我们发现他们的失误很少见，而且是成群结队的，而且他们在区块中的准确度比自然语言要深得多。运行长度恒等式和三个命题表明，一旦候选人的范围很宽，达到起草者的视野，更长的窗口就会带来回报。我们提出了 Sightline，它将一个与绘图者的地平线一样长的窗口与一个足够宽以填充它的绘图树配对。实验涵盖文本到 SVG 和图像到 SVG，使用来自 MMSVG、MMSVG-2M 和 SArena 的六个基准的三个模型。在所有设置中，Sightline 都是同类无损解码器中速度最快的。在 SArena 上，当每个解码器共享一个循环控制时，它保持最快。它还在来自其他四个系列的六个模型的几乎所有设置中处于领先地位，这些模型编写 SVG 代码、压缩的 SVG 令牌或 Lottie JSON。分析将线索追溯到较短窗口切断的回合，无论是在无循环内容还是循环内容中。推测性解码还节省了通过渲染选择样本的时间，这优于通过似然选择。这些结果表明，就绘图者而言，矢量图形的推测解码应该得到验证。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline 获取。

papers.title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message
papers.summary: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system's verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate's 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.
papers.comment: 61 pages, 11 figures, 45 tables. v2: revised presentation (Algorithm 1; the two prospective tests and batched serving in the main results); appendix reordered by question and audit records moved to the code repository. Code: https://github.com/Piedpiperrr/safe-to-omit; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AgentsSci/ICLR2027-SafeToOmit

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法扎实但外推仍有限。
pros: 提出“安全可跳过+值得跳过”双判据，并给出有限样本可认证机制，评估框架完整

papers.title_zh: 可以安全省略，值得省略吗？当 LLM 代理跳过另一个消息时保留答案并减少延迟
papers.summary_zh: 在多代理系统中，接收代理通常会等待辅助代理的消息（文本或其潜在的 KV 缓存），这可以提高性能，但会增加延迟。我们研究接收代理何时可以安全地跳过消息（最终答案很少改变）并且有益（节省的时间超过决策成本）。我们的机制在没有消息的情况下读取接收方代理的置信度，并使用有限样本测试来验证一个阈值，在该阈值下，最多有 5% 的跳过答案发生变化；如果没有通过，系统将继续通信。我们在 OpenBookQA、ARC-Challenge 和 MMLU-Pro 上使用三个 Qwen 模型对、跨系列代理以及 SQuAD 和 GSM8K 对其进行了测试。出现了四种见解。首先，预言机净空是消息有帮助的微弱证据：在没有特定于答案的内容的情况下控制输入，与真实消息一样频繁地更改答案，再现了预言机增益的中位数 76%。其次，一条消息是否可以被跳过取决于它改变答案的频率和可预测性，而不是它的准确性；每个经过认证的 KV 缓存路径都不如单独的接收代理准确。第三，在短信有帮助的地方，跳过保留了大部分收益：在四种此类设置中未见过的问题上，策略跳过了 59％ 至 80％，并保留了估计的 76％ 至 95％ 的收益。在预先确定所有规则的两项前瞻性测试中，我们的机制在 39.9% 的密封问题上跳过了三代理系统的验证程序，保留了其 12.80 点增益中的 12.55 点，并在 68.4% 的保留问题上跳过了 32B 助手，保留了其全部增益。第四，安全性并不决定效率：在批量大小为 1 的情况下，跳过文本可以为每个查询节省数百毫秒，而跳过 KV 缓存则要少得多。认证延伸至 SQuAD，但不延伸至 GSM8K。在针对未见问题的 11 次测试中，我们可以测试的每项经过认证的策略在我们的答案解析器下都将其变化率 95% 的上限保持在 5% 以下。

papers.title: Towards Fair Resource Sharing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.summary: As LLM agents increasingly execute complex, multi-step tasks on shared inference infrastructure, resource contention across the end-to-end LLM serving stack causes severe and uneven slowdowns across agents. Existing agentic serving systems primarily optimize throughput and latency, with comparatively limited attention to fairness among concurrent agents. Although fairness has been studied in conventional LLM serving at the token and request levels, these approaches do not fully capture cumulative delays and stateful resource dependencies across successive LLM calls within an agent. Moreover, interference spans request routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware resources, making agent-level fairness challenging to define and optimize across an end-to-end serving stack. This paper presents a cross-layer framework to define agent-level fairness, attribute sources of unfairness, and optimize fairness while preserving throughput. To account for agents with widely varying execution demands, we build a theoretical foundation to define fairness using slowdown relative to standalone execution. Our empirical analysis reveals that routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware contention jointly determine fairness, with performance-oriented policies often leading to prolonged queuing delays. To optimize fairness, we introduce Duru, which monitors each agent's slowdown and uses this signal to guide admission and scheduling decisions across the router and runtime. Duru further alleviates starvation through admission exceptions and integrates slowdown-driven autoscaling to adhere to Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Our evaluation across various benchmarks and hardware platforms shows that Duru reduces 99th-percentile normalized slowdown by a geometric mean of 44.4% (up to 79.5%) while delivering 91.8-127.4% of the state-of-the-art system's throughput.

quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案完整，但证据深度仍待加强。
pros: 聚焦Agent级公平性，问题定义切中多租户推理痛点

papers.title_zh: 代理法学硕士服务中实现公平资源共享
papers.summary_zh: 随着 LLM 代理越来越多地在共享推理基础设施上执行复杂的多步骤任务，端到端 LLM 服务堆栈中的资源争用会导致代理之间严重且不均匀的速度下降。现有的代理服务系统主要优化吞吐量和延迟，而对并发代理之间的公平性的关注相对有限。尽管已经在令牌和请求级别的传统 LLM 服务中研究了公平性，但这些方法并没有完全捕获代理内连续 LLM 调用之间的累积延迟和状态资源依赖性。此外，干扰跨越请求路由、运行时调度和硬件资源，使得跨端到端服务堆栈定义和优化代理级公平性变得困难。本文提出了一个跨层框架来定义代理级公平性、归因不公平性来源以及在保持吞吐量的同时优化公平性。为了考虑具有广泛不同执行需求的代理，我们建立了一个理论基础，以使用相对于独立执行的减慢来定义公平性。我们的实证分析表明，路由、运行时调度和硬件争用共同决定公平性，而以性能为导向的策略往往会导致排队延迟延长。为了优化公平性，我们引入了 Duru，它监视每个代理的减速并使用此信号来指导整个路由器和运行时的准入和调度决策。 Duru 通过准入例外进一步缓解饥饿问题，并集成减速驱动的自动扩展以遵守服务级别目标 (SLO)。我们对各种基准测试和硬件平台的评估表明，Duru 将 99% 的标准化减速降低了几何平均值 44.4%（高达 79.5%），同时提供了最先进系统的 91.8-127.4% 的吞吐量。

papers.title: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. Backpropagating through predicted-feature rollouts with greater weight on early steps improves acceptance by 15-24% over uniformly weighted detached training, yet average rollout proxy cross-entropy does not reliably rank drafters by acceptance. Beyond prediction quality, the placement of draft candidates also matters: with a fixed 256-node budget and matched per-depth widths, replacing static allocation with confidence-guided allocation increases speedup over autoregressive decoding from $1.46\times$ to $2.02\times$ on HumanEval and from $1.31\times$ to $1.75\times$ on MT-Bench. This allocation benefit extends to an independently trained drafter, but stronger training does not consistently amplify it, showing that the two improvements do not necessarily reinforce each other. Even these speed gains depend on execution conditions: changing only host-thread settings can nearly eliminate speedup without changing acceptance. Together, these findings show why training and allocation must be evaluated jointly using both acceptance and end-to-end latency under controlled execution conditions.

quality.verdict: 实证扎实且有工程价值，但方法创新有限。
pros: 明确揭示acceptance与端到端时延不一致，问题定位准确
在固定预算下提出置信度分配并取得稳定加速，且控制执行条件有说服力

papers.title_zh: 事实：用于推测性解码的固定预算分配和跨步训练
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过在单个目标模型传递中验证多个草稿标记来加速语言模型的生成。然而，更好的草稿预测和更长的可接受的延续并不一定会产生更快的生成。为了研究这一差距，我们提出了 FACT（固定预算分配和跨步培训），这是一个实验框架，用于研究起草者培训、候选人分配和执行条件如何共同影响接受和延迟。使用轻量级特征预测绘图器和贪婪解码下的冻结 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 目标，我们首先检查训练如何转化为可接受的标记。通过对早期步骤赋予更大权重的预测功能推出进行反向传播，与统一加权的分离训练相比，接受度提高了 15-24%，但平均推出代理交叉熵并不能根据接受度可靠地对起草者进行排名。除了预测质量之外，候选草案的放置也很重要：在固定的 256 节点预算和匹配的每个深度宽度的情况下，用置信引导分配替换静态分配可将自回归解码的加速率从 HumanEval 上的 $1.46\times$ 提高到 $2.02\times$，在 MT-Bench 上从 $1.31\times$ 提高到 $1.75\times$。这种分配优势适用于经过独立培训的绘图员，但更强的培训并不能始终如一地放大这种优势，这表明这两种改进不一定会相互促进。即使这些速度增益也取决于执行条件：仅更改主机线程设置几乎可以消除加速而不改变接受度。总之，这些发现说明了为什么必须在受控执行条件下使用接受度和端到端延迟来联合评估训练和分配。

papers.title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
papers.summary: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.

papers.title_zh: 存储 Gemma 4 K=V 缓存一次：在具有不变的关注内核的分页服务引擎中精确地节省全局 KV 内存
papers.summary_zh: 在 Gemma 4 31B 的全局注意力层中，值是归一化的键投影，键是按固定权重缩放的值，在其四分之一的维度上进行旋转位置编码。 Gemma 4 报告指出，这种设计将全局 KV 缓存减少了 37.5%，但我们检查的开放服务引擎仍然存储完整的密钥和完整的值：每个 KV 头和令牌 1,024 个值。相反，我们存储一个 640 值行，这在实际算术中是精确的，并且未更改的分页注意力内核通过两个重叠的跨步视图读取它作为其键缓存和值缓存。在具有 16 位 31B 模型的 vLLM 原型中，输出与库存缓存上相同算术的仿真位相同，432 个最终答案中有 2 个与库存引擎不同（在其运行噪声范围内），并且每个请求的稳定解码 KV 内存在 32K 到 64K 令牌时下降了 1.34 到 1.40 倍。在具有 NIXL 传输和 CPU 卸载功能的两个 A100 GPU 的预填充/解码对上，具有完整 15 GiB 池的解码引擎对于 16K 令牌提示，每步运行的库存解码令牌为 1.38 倍（重复至 0.06%），对于 8K 令牌提示，运行为 1.24 倍； vLLM 块池模型预测这两个比率都在 1% 以内（引擎高出 0.7% 到 0.9%），并匹配它们之间的变化。急切解码吞吐量增加了 1.30 和 1.11 倍，并且在此路径上，紧凑引擎给出了与批次 1 中 8 个提示的模拟相同的输出令牌。运行时原型使急切步骤在相同批次下慢了 4% 到 9%，并且该方法尚未在默认规模下与 8 位 KV 缓存进行堆栈。

papers.title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
papers.summary: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to softmax under a unified distillation protocol, and model scala alone does not close these gaps. We show this gap is not intrinsic to kernelization: LARA++, a principled extension of LARA that approximates softmax via importance sampling with adaptive proposal distributions, recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy. We establish that the gap is closable; however, the computational overhead remains substantial, leaving the efficiency wall intact. Code is available at https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026

papers.title_zh: 内核现实检查：大规模有效注意力的基准测试和提炼
papers.summary_zh: 核化注意力方法旨在用 $O(N)$ 替代方案取代 $O(N^2)$ 复杂度的 softmax 注意力，是过去五年中研究的热点。尽管人们的兴趣日益浓厚，但仍然缺乏跨方法和规模的系统评估和公平比较。我们将内核注意力分为两部分进行分析，并强调每一部分的显着局限性。在效率方面，FlashAttention 在训练期间和在大多数序列长度的视觉变换器中实现了比 SOTA 内核化方法更低的内存消耗和更快的挂钟时间（因果语言模型中的推理时间内存是唯一明显的例外），这与用作 softmax 直接替代品的纯内核化注意力的核心假设相矛盾。我们还发现，所报告的效率提升往往无法根据现代基准重现。在质量上，当前的核化方法在统一蒸馏协议下相对于 softmax 存在 2-10 个点的差距，而模型 scala 本身并不能弥补这些差距。我们证明这种差距并不是内核化所固有的：LARA++ 是 LARA 的一个原则性扩展，它通过具有自适应提议分布的重要性采样来逼近 softmax，可以恢复高达 99% 的 softmax 准确率。我们确定差距是可以缩小的；然而，计算开销仍然很大，使得效率墙完好无损。代码可在 https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026 获取

papers.title: LaFlash: Capacity-Driven Acceleration for Coding Agent Workflows via QLC-HBF
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) evolve toward agentic AI, coding agents are emerging as memory-intensive workloads that repeatedly reuse persistent states, including contexts and KV caches. Emerging agentic workflows, including Loop/Graph Engineering, cause state amplification through frequent active/dormant transitions, increasing memory pressure. Evicted states incur costly recomputation upon reactivation, particularly under long-context, short-decode workloads. This motivates Capacity-Driven Acceleration (CDA), which explicitly accounts for state amplification to allocate memory capacity between active concurrency and dormant-state retention, replacing recomputation with memory access. In this work, we propose LaFlash, a High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) architecture that exploits the large capacity of Quad-Level Cell (QLC)-based flash to realize CDA. However, QLC's long read latency demands massive read parallelism under irregular state reactivation and varying context lengths, while limited write endurance constrains placement. LaFlash introduces Session Grouping to balance active request counts and aggregate context lengths across groups, sustaining read parallelism and block utilization through request-exclusive allocation. Furthermore, Fast-Page Allocation exploits QLC's read-latency heterogeneity to mitigate residual inter-group imbalance and sustain bandwidth utilization. On end-to-end coding agent workloads, LaFlash achieves 7.04$\times$ higher throughput and 10.96$\times$ higher energy efficiency over SLC-HBF with batch expansion, and 2.36$\times$ higher throughput over QLC-HBF with CDA. HBM buffering further reduces unnecessary NAND writes, improving QLC write endurance. These results demonstrate the benefits of jointly optimizing state retention and physical data placement for capacity-driven acceleration.

papers.title_zh: LaFlash：通过 QLC-HBF 实现编码代理工作流程的容量驱动加速
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 向代理 AI 发展，编码代理正在成为内存密集型工作负载，反复重用持久状态，包括上下文和 KV 缓存。新兴的代理工作流程（包括循环/图形工程）会通过频繁的活动/休眠转换导致状态放大，从而增加内存压力。被逐出的状态在重新激活时会产生代价高昂的重新计算，特别是在长上下文、短解码工作负载下。这激发了容量驱动加速（CDA），它明确地考虑状态放大，以在活动并发和休眠状态保留之间分配内存容量，用内存访问代替重新计算。在这项工作中，我们提出了 LaFlash，一种高带宽闪存 (HBF) 架构，它利用基于四级单元 (QLC) 的闪存的大容量来实现 CDA。然而，QLC 的长读取延迟需要在不规则状态重新激活和变化的上下文长度下实现大规模读取并行性，而有限的写入耐久性限制了布局。 LaFlash 引入会话分组来平衡活动请求计数并聚合跨组的上下文长度，通过请求独占分配维持读取并行性和块利用率。此外，快速页面分配利用 QLC 的读取延迟异质性来减轻残留的组间不平衡并维持带宽利用率。在端到端编码代理工作负载上，与批量扩展的 SLC-HBF 相比，LaFlash 的吞吐量提高了 7.04$\times$，能源效率提高了 10.96$\times$，与采用 CDA 的 QLC-HBF 相比，吞吐量提高了 2.36$\times$。 HBM 缓冲进一步减少了不必要的 NAND 写入，从而提高了 QLC 写入耐久性。这些结果证明了联合优化状态保留和物理数据放置以实现容量驱动加速的好处。

papers.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Parallel Looped Transformers (PLTs) use otherwise idle decoding compute by overlapping recurrent iterations. However, vanilla PLTs scale poorly with depth: they exhibit training-loss spikes, and their quality gains shrink as more loops are added. The benefit of additional loops depends on the information available to each iteration, so we examine whether the existing computational dependencies limit effective depth scaling. We find that only the preceding in-trajectory state is passed across loop boundaries, even though completed cross-trajectory representations are already available. Based on this finding, we propose InfuseLoop, a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism. It aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories through lightweight attention residuals. This design preserves token-parallel training and concurrent loop execution, and requires only $O(Rd)$ additional hidden-state storage. Experiments show that InfuseLoop eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops. At eight loops, InfuseLoop reduces perplexity by 3.4--17.1% relative to vanilla PLTs and by 10.5--37.3% relative to the non-looped baseline. It also improves average downstream accuracy by 0.84 and 1.99 percentage points over these two baselines. InfuseLoop incurs only 0.3% decoding time over vanilla PLTs and 23.3% over the non-looped baseline, while keeping the same logical KV-cache footprint as vanilla PLTs.

papers.title_zh: InfuseLoop：可扩展并行环形变压器的交叉轨迹潜在注入
papers.summary_zh: 并行循环变压器 (PLT) 通过重叠循环迭代来使用空闲解码计算。然而，普通 PLT 的深度扩展性很差：它们表现出训练损失峰值，并且随着添加更多循环，它们的质量增益会缩小。额外循环的好处取决于每次迭代可用的信息，因此我们检查现有的计算依赖性是否限制了有效的深度缩放。我们发现，尽管完整的跨轨迹表示已经可用，但只有前面的轨迹内状态穿过循环边界。基于这一发现，我们提出了 InfuseLoop，一种跨轨迹潜在注入机制。它通过轻量级注意力残差从后来的预测轨迹中聚合因果上可用的隐藏状态。此设计保留了令牌并行训练和并发循环执行，并且仅需要 $O(Rd)$ 额外的隐藏状态存储。实验表明，InfuseLoop 消除了训练损失峰值，并将验证损失扩展至八个循环。在八个循环中，InfuseLoop 相对于普通 PLT 降低了 3.4--17.1% 的困惑度，相对于非循环基线降低了 10.5--37.3%。与这两个基线相比，它还使平均下游准确度提高了 0.84 和 1.99 个百分点。 InfuseLoop 比普通 PLT 只需要 0.3% 的解码时间，比非循环基线只需要 23.3%，同时保持与普通 PLT 相同的逻辑 KV 缓存占用空间。

papers.title: BQ-LoRA: Binary-Quantized Low-Rank Adapters as Implicit Regularizers for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of quantized large language models is dominated by QLoRA, which combines 4-bit weight quantization with FP16 low-rank adapters. We ask whether the FP16 adapter precision is necessary. Replacing it with a single binary bit per adapter parameter, combined with a learned per-layer scale $s$ and a Scaled Straight-Through Estimator, reduces adapter storage by 13-16x. We introduce two variants -- NormScale, which binarizes under a norm-preserving scale with a clipped STE, and LearnThresh, which makes the binarization threshold learnable -- unified under a framework we call BQ-LoRA. Our main theoretical contribution is a tight characterization of the BQ-LoRA hypothesis class: it has bounded entrywise norm, a typical-set spectral norm bound that is $Θ(r)$ times sharper than the worst case, a full-rank, near-isotropic update, and consequently a Rademacher complexity that yields an explicit $\tilde{O}(s_{\max}α\sqrt{d_{out}/(rn)})$ generalization bound. FP16 LoRA has no comparable a priori norm or isotropy control. On Qwen2.5 (1.5B-72B), BQ-LoRA exceeds QLoRA's benchmark averages at every scale by 0.8-3.5 points; on LLaMA-2 (7B/70B) it remains competitive at the same storage reduction but does not uniformly lead the strongest FP16-adapter baselines (LoftQ at 7B, QLoRA at 70B). On Qwen2.5-7B the binary adapter preserves the 4-bit base WikiText-2 PPL within 0.06 (9.86 vs. 9.80) while QLoRA worsens it by 0.59. The reduction applies to inference-time adapter storage and serving; training memory matches QLoRA and step time rises by under 4%. We translate the storage saving into a deployment study, BQ-SGMV, by extending Punica's SGMV kernel with a binary inner-product primitive: the same A100-80GB holds 15.6x more adapters in HBM, and our research prototype eliminates cache misses under a skewed synthetic workload.

papers.title_zh: BQ-LoRA：二进制量化低阶适配器作为参数高效微调的隐式正则化器
papers.summary_zh: 量化大型语言模型的参数高效微调由 QLoRA 主导，它将 4 位权重量化与 FP16 低秩适配器相结合。请问FP16适配器精度是否有必要？将其替换为每个适配器参数的单个二进制位，并结合学习的每层缩放 $s$ 和缩放直通估计器，可将适配器存储减少 13-16 倍。我们引入了两个变体——NormScale，它在具有剪裁的 STE 的范数保留尺度下进行二值化；LearnThresh，它使二值化阈值可学习——统一在我们称为 BQ-LoRA 的框架下。我们的主要理论贡献是对 BQ-LoRA 假设类的严格表征：它具有有界的条目范数、典型的谱范数界，比最坏情况锐利 $θ(r)$ 倍、全秩、近各向同性更新，以及产生显式 $\tilde{O}(s_{\max}α\sqrt{d_{out}/(rn)})$ 泛化界的 Rademacher 复杂度。 FP16 LoRA 没有可比的先验范数或各向同性控制。在Qwen2.5（1.5B-72B）上，BQ-LoRA在每个尺度上都超过了QLoRA的基准平均值0.8-3.5个点；在 LLaMA-2 (7B/70B) 上，它在相同的存储减少量下仍然具有竞争力，但并不统一领先最强的 FP16 适配器基线（LoftQ 为 7B，QLoRA 为 70B）。在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，二进制适配器将 4 位基本 WikiText-2 PPL 保留在 0.06 以内（9.86 与 9.80），而 QLoRA 则将其恶化了 0.59。减少适用于推理时间适配器存储和服务；训练记忆与 QLoRA 匹配，步数时间增加不到 4%。我们通过使用二进制内积原语扩展 Punica 的 SGMV 内核，将存储节省转化为部署研究 BQ-SGMV：相同的 A100-80GB 在 HBM 中容纳的适配器数量增加了 15.6 倍，并且我们的研究原型消除了倾斜合成工作负载下的缓存未命中。

papers.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
papers.summary: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.

papers.title_zh: 先优化 Cob，然后优化内核：优化 Beam Search 以实现生成推荐推理
papers.summary_zh: 生成推荐 (GR) 推理与传统的 LLM 服务有很大不同，具有长输入序列、宽波束搜索和只有几个固定输出标记的特点。现有的 LLM 服务引擎（例如 vLLM）将波束处理为批量独立序列，从而导致通过共享提示符前缀进行冗余 KV 缓存访问。此外，vLLM 将每个波束搜索生成步骤作为单独的引擎调用来执行，从而在解码步骤和 PagedAttention 中的大量运行时 KV 块管理之间产生主机端波束处理开销。使用 Tree Attention，我们沿序列维度连接波束以消除冗余的 KV 访问，并通过预生成的部分注意掩码、静态 KV 缓存分配、循环展开生成调度、TorchAir 图编译、自动算子融合和词汇约束解码进一步优化执行。在不使用定制内核的情况下，我们的方法在 Ascend NPU 上比 vLLM 减少了高达 25 倍的端到端延迟，并且实现了与使用定制内核的 SOTA 解决方案相当的生成延迟，这表明在采用定制内核开发之前应该对生成管道进行整体优化。

papers.title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deployment-GPU calibration. The predictor is parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data, while adapting a frozen Qwen3-4B using LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer. Across NVIDIA RTX~5090, H100, L40 and AMD MI300X GPUs, SpecSearch with full calibration achieves an average of $2.01\times$ the throughput of AR and $1.36\times$ the throughput of SD, both served by vLLM. The proposed Jev-based predictor closely matches this search performance with $1.30\times$ throughput improvement over SD with vLLM, while eliminating the need for held-out GPU calibration. Additionally, it retains $97.36\%$ of the throughput achieved by SpecSearch that utilizes full calibration.

papers.title_zh: SpecSearch：迈向硬件感知的高效推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 可加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理，但其最佳配置共同取决于工作负载特征、GPU 硬件和可用内存。例如，在 RTX~5090 上，最先进的推测起草器 DFlash 在低并发时实现了 $3.50\times$ 的自回归 (AR) 解码吞吐量，但在高并发和短输出时仅达到 $0.76\times$。我们推出了 SpecSearch，这是一种硬件感知搜索引擎，可以跨工作负载 - GPU 对联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度。其分析成本模型捕获内存和计算约束，以识别可行的配置并缩小吞吐量优化的搜索空间。在此模型的指导下，从多个 GPU 收集校准测量结果。使用这些测量结果，基于 Jev 的预测器可以学习在保留的 GPU 上选择高吞吐量解码配置，而无需部署 GPU 校准。预测器根据校准数据进行参数高效训练，同时使用 LoRA 适配器和线性校正层调整冻结的 Qwen3-4B。在 NVIDIA RTX~5090、H100、L40 和 AMD MI300X GPU 上，经过全面校准的 SpecSearch 平均实现 AR 吞吐量 $2.01\times$ 和 SD 吞吐量 $1.36\times$，两者均由 vLLM 提供服务。所提出的基于 Jev 的预测器与此搜索性能非常匹配，与使用 vLLM 的 SD 相比，吞吐量提高了 1.30 倍，同时消除了保留 GPU 校准的需要。此外，它还保留了利用完全校准的 SpecSearch 实现的 97.36\%$ 吞吐量。

papers.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
papers.summary: Sparse attention has been increasingly adopted by production LLMs for long-context inference, yet serving systems must still retain the full KV history, making GPU HBM capacity a key limit on serving concurrency. Existing systems offload the KV cache to host memory, but suffer from the limited bandwidth of PCIe and the limited capacity of host memory. Emerging scale-up memory pools (e.g., X-Mem) relieve both limits and open new opportunities for sparse-attention offloading. In this paper, we first conduct an in-depth analysis and reveal that, even with scale-up memory pools, decode throughput remains bounded by HBM capacity, as hot KV buffers and the fully resident indexer key (K-index) cache occupy substantial HBM. Moreover, the two caches exhibit distinct access patterns. Based on these insights, we present XM-Sparse, the first sparse-attention offloading system over scale-up memory expansion. The core idea of XM-Sparse is to offload both caches aggressively while matching each with an I/O mechanism tailored to its access pattern. Specifically, for dynamically selected KV entries, XM-Sparse fuses TMA-based retrieval with attention in a tile-level pipeline to hide on-demand retrieval latency. For predictable K-index accesses, it prefetches pages via SM-efficient GPU-initiated DMA and coordinates prefetching with latency-critical operations to avoid interfering with decoding. We have implemented XM-Sparse atop SGLang, and our experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.3 with an emulated scale-up memory pool show that XM-Sparse delivers up to 4.98$\times$ and 4.52$\times$ higher decode throughput than PCIe-based ECHO and HiSparse, respectively, and up to 1.34$\times$ over a naive integration on the same platform, across 16K-1M contexts.

papers.title_zh: XM-Sparse：通过扩展内存池提供高吞吐量稀疏注意力 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 生产 LLM 越来越多地采用稀疏注意力来进行长上下文推理，但服务系统仍必须保留完整的 KV 历史记录，这使得 GPU HBM 容量成为服务并发性的关键限制。现有系统将 KV 缓存卸载到主机内存，但受到 PCIe 带宽有限和主机内存容量有限的困扰。新兴的扩展内存池（例如 X-Mem）缓解了这两个限制，并为稀疏注意力卸载开辟了新的机会。在本文中，我们首先进行了深入分析并揭示，即使使用扩展内存池，解码吞吐量仍然受到 HBM 容量的限制，因为热 KV 缓冲区和完全驻留索引器键（K-index）缓存占用了大量 HBM。此外，这两个缓存表现出不同的访问模式。基于这些见解，我们提出了 XM-Sparse，这是第一个通过纵向扩展内存扩展的稀疏注意力卸载系统。 XM-Sparse 的核心思想是主动卸载两个缓存，同时将每个缓存与适合其访问模式的 I/O 机制相匹配。具体来说，对于动态选择的 KV 条目，XM-Sparse 将基于 TMA 的检索与图块级管道中的注意力融合在一起，以隐藏按需检索延迟。对于可预测的 K 索引访问，它通过 SM 高效的 GPU 启动的 DMA 预取页面，并协调预取与延迟关键操作，以避免干扰解码。我们在 SGLang 之上实现了 XM-Sparse，并且我们在具有模拟扩展内存池的 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.3 上进行的实验表明，XM-Sparse 的解码吞吐量分别比基于 PCIe 的 ECHO 和 HiSparse 高出 4.98$\times$ 和 4.52$\times$，比同一平台上的简单集成高出 1.34$\times$。 16K-1M 上下文。

papers.title: From Token Changes to Task Failures: Bit Flips in a Shared KV-Cache Block
papers.summary: In LLM serving systems with prefix caching, each KV block of a shared system prompt is held in GPU memory as a single physical copy, which every request with that prompt reads. Our earlier work measured change and showed that one bit flip in such a block changes many later responses without making them visibly degenerate. This paper extends that work by measuring how often the changed responses are wrong. Using software fault injection into vLLM serving Qwen3-8B, we flip the most significant mantissa bit or the sign bit of a value in such a block. We score responses on four tasks: code generation, short-answer questions, multiple-choice reasoning, and refusal under a policy. The fraction of changes that turned a correct response wrong depended strongly on the task: 0.023 on MBPP+ and 0.59 on held-out TriviaQA at the mantissa bit, and 0.019 and 0.60 at the sign bit. Harm fell on requests whose sampled answers are sometimes wrong, so the damage of a flip depends on how common such requests are. Harmed responses looked like ordinary errors, so a flip should be detected by checking cached blocks rather than by monitoring outputs.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Extended version of arXiv:2604.17249 (SECRYPT 2026, 23rd International Conference on Security and Cryptography). Submitted to Springer Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结论实用，但创新与外推性有限。
pros: 聚焦共享KV缓存单点失效，贴合真实LLM serving风险面
从“输出变化”推进到“任务失败率”，并给出跨任务脆弱性差异
cons: 实验范围偏窄（单模型/单框架/特定注入位），对不同模型与硬件场景的可泛化性仍不足

papers.title_zh: 从令牌更改到任务失败：共享 KV 缓存块中的位翻转
papers.summary_zh: 在具有前缀缓存的 LLM 服务系统中，共享系统提示的每个 KV 块都作为单个物理副本保存在 GPU 内存中，每个带有该提示的请求都会读取该副本。我们早期的工作测量了变化，并表明这样一个块中的一位翻转会改变许多后来的响应，而不会使其明显退化。本文通过测量更改后的响应错误的频率来扩展这项工作。使用软件故障注入到服务 Qwen3-8B 的 vLLM 中，我们翻转此类块中值的最高有效尾数位或符号位。我们对四项任务的回答进行评分：代码生成、简答题、多项选择推理和策略下的拒绝。导致正确响应错误的变化比例在很大程度上取决于任务：尾数位处的 MBPP+ 为 0.023，保留的 TriviaQA 为 0.59，符号位为 0.019 和 0.60。损害会落在抽样答案有时是错误的请求上，因此翻转的损害取决于此类请求的常见程度。受损的响应看起来像普通错误，因此应该通过检查缓存的块而不是监视输出来检测翻转。

papers.title: TAILROLL: Tail-Aware Rollout Acceleration for RL-Based LLM Post-Training
papers.summary: RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by rollout: heavy-tailed responses leave engines idle as each step waits for the longest response. Asynchronous training masks, but does not eliminate, idle time. We distinguish imbalance waste (uneven placement and decode contention) from straggler waste (waiting for the longest response). Tail length, not average load, often sets the step bound. We propose TAILROLL, an online scheduler integrated into an open-source RL framework. It combines stateless in-flight migration and sufficiency-gated termination. Migration moves decoding requests between engines at chunk boundaries and resumes them with one re-prefill under a freeness-based, cost-aware tail-balancing policy. Termination stops a response when its GRPO group has enough completed samples for advantage estimation, masking its partial output from the training loss. Across ten configurations, TAILROLL reduces rollout bubble ratio by 21% to 74% and cross-engine KV-cache imbalance by 44% to 79%. In end-to-end RL training, it cuts rollout time by 24% to 34%, full step time by 21% to 22% on long-CoT RL, and p95 request latency by 28% to 37%, while raising generation throughput by up to 33% with comparable or higher final reward.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准、收益可观，但因果与泛化证据仍偏薄。
pros: 明确区分负载不均与尾部等待两类浪费，问题建模有洞察
方法兼顾系统可落地性与训练有效性，端到端指标提升幅度较大
cons: 摘要未充分说明终止策略对策略学习偏差与收敛稳定性的理论或消融验证，跨模型与多集群泛化风险仍在

papers.title_zh: TAILROLL：基于 RL 的 LLM 训练后的尾部感知推出加速
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的 RL 后训练因推出而遇到瓶颈：重尾响应使引擎处于空闲状态，因为每个步骤都等待最长的响应。异步训练掩盖了空闲时间，但并没有消除空闲时间。我们将不平衡浪费（不均匀的放置和解码争用）与落后者浪费（等待最长的响应）区分开来。尾部长度（而不是平均负载）通常决定步长范围。我们提出 TAILROLL，一个集成到开源 RL 框架中的在线调度程序。它结合了无状态动态迁移和充足性门控终止。迁移在块边界的引擎之间移动解码请求，并在基于自由度、成本感知的尾部平衡策略下通过一次重新预填充来恢复它们。当 GRPO 组有足够的完整样本用于优势估计时，终止会停止响应，从而掩盖其部分输出免受训练损失的影响。在十种配置中，TAILROLL 将推出气泡率降低了 21% 到 74%，将跨引擎 KV 缓存不平衡降低了 44% 到 79%。在端到端 RL 训练中，它将推出时间缩短了 24% 至 34%，长 CoT RL 的全步时间缩短了 21% 至 22%，p95 请求延迟缩短了 28% 至 37%，同时将生成吞吐量提高了 33%，并具有相当或更高的最终奖励。

papers.title: RISA: Recoverable Sparse Attention for Block-Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) refine multiple tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. Their long-context inference, however, remains bottlenecked by memory-bound attention: every denoising step repeatedly reads a growing historical key--value (KV) cache. Directly applying sparse attention does not fully solve this problem, because different queries can select different pages, inflating the block's collective read set, while repeated support construction adds overhead and permanent eviction can discard information needed later. We present RISA, a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-wise DLMs. RISA exploits the fact that historical KV remains fixed within a block while queries evolve across denoising steps. Newly generated history is organized into exact priority and recovery tiers; seed queries then build a protected, bounded read plan whose indices are reused across the block while attention is recomputed with fresh queries and current-block KV. This separates history preservation from repeated reading and amortizes sparse-support construction without changing the backbone or decoder. On DreamReasoner-8B, RISA retains comparable task performance. At 32K, the default configuration speeds up attention by $2.67\times$ and fixed-trajectory requests by $1.36\times$ over dense, and attention speedup reaches $5.53\times$ at 128K. Across eight settings on three models, RISA decodes faster than the tested MAGE, QUEST, and LoSA budgets at matched KL.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待加强
pros: 抓住块扩散长上下文中KV反复读取的关键瓶颈，问题定义精准

papers.title_zh: RISA：块扩散语言模型的可恢复稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 分块扩散语言模型 (DLM) 并行优化多个标记，提供了逐个标记自回归解码的替代方案。然而，它们的长上下文推理仍然受到内存限制注意力的瓶颈：每个去噪步骤都会重复读取不断增长的历史键值（KV）缓存。直接应用稀疏注意力并不能完全解决这个问题，因为不同的查询可以选择不同的页面，从而导致块的集体读取集膨胀，而重复的支持构建会增加开销，并且永久驱逐可能会丢弃以后需要的信息。我们提出了 RISA，一种可恢复的稀疏注意力方法，具有用于块级 DLM 的共享读取计划。 RISA 利用了这样一个事实：历史 KV 在块内保持固定，而查询在去噪步骤中不断演变。新生成的历史记录被组织成精确的优先级和恢复层；然后，种子查询构建一个受保护的、有界的读取计划，其索引在整个块中重复使用，同时使用新查询和当前块 KV 重新计算注意力。这将历史保存与重复读取分开，并在不改变主干或解码器的情况下摊销稀疏支持构造。在 DreamReasoner-8B 上，RISA 保留了相当的任务性能。在 32K 时，默认配置将注意力加速 $2.67\times$，固定轨迹请求在密集时加速 $1.36\times$，注意力加速在 128K 时达到 $5.53\times$。在三种型号的八种设置中，RISA 的解码速度比在匹配的 KL 下测试的 MAGE、QUEST 和 LoSA 预算更快。

papers.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
papers.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程规模突出，但学术证据与可复现性不足

给出285B与8192卡训练场景，具备较强工程参考价值

方法多为已知技术组合，原创算法贡献边界不清

papers.title_zh: TeleChat to Xing4：在国产芯片和框架上推进前沿代理模型
papers.summary_zh: 我们推出了 Xing 4，这是一系列大型语言模型，它通过 Ascend 上模型架构和培训基础设施的协调进步来扩展 TeleChat 谱系。本报告描述了该系列背后的设计原理和系统工程，涵盖架构选择、大规模预训练以及推理和代理后训练。我们研究稀疏激活、注意力设计、模型深度和宽度以及推测解码如何平衡模型容量与计算、内存访问和执行开销。我们的预训练基础设施建立在 MindSpore HyperParallel 的基础上，结合了拓扑感知混合分片、高效的分布式优化器执行以及长序列工作负载和激活内存的协调管理。 CPU亲和性和核心隔离进一步减少主机调度干扰。这些机制共同支持 8,192 个 Ascend 910C 卡上的 285B 参数模型的预训练，为架构和系统研究提供具体的设置。对于后期培训，我们引入了 TeleGym，这是一个统一的代理执行平台，它将执行、评估和轨迹构建与策略优化连接起来。分解异步执行、有界过采样和部分推出可适应异构任务持续时间，同时保持跨策略更新的轨迹连续性。这些进步共同为 Xing 4 跨模型规模以及日益苛刻的推理和代理工作负载的持续开发奠定了面向 Ascend 的培训基础。

papers.title: HyCoInfer: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models on Heterogeneous GPU-FPGA Architectures
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving relies predominantly on cloud GPUs, yet autoregressive decoding is memory-bound and often leaves their arithmetic units underutilized. Edge FPGAs offer attractive decoding efficiency, but are ill suited to sustaining a high-concurrency serving workload alone. This paper presents HyCoInfer, a heterogeneous cloud-edge serving system that assigns prefill to cloud GPUs and distributes decoding across cloud GPUs and edge FPGAs. The design addresses three barriers to practical offloading: capacity balancing across heterogeneous accelerators, the large KV cache crossing a constrained wide-area link, and the latency added by heterogeneous execution. HyCoInfer incorporates FPGA decode capacity into GPU prefill/decode role partitioning and places requests according to queue load, prompt length, and network state. It further combines layer-wise pipelined transfer, decoder-side precomputation, and bandwidth-adaptive KV cache compression based on residual vector quantization. We implement HyCoInfer using two NVIDIA V100 GPUs and an AMD Xilinx Alveo U280 and evaluate it over 100-1000 Mbps links. At 500 Mbps, HyCoInfer delivers up to 4.11 times the request goodput of cloud-only vLLM and reduces mean end-to-end latency by up to 61.1%. Across different network conditions and workloads, the system improves overall serving capacity, with the largest gains on communication-intensive tasks, and reduces per-request energy.

quality.label: 较高

pros: 抓住LLM解码内存瓶颈，提出云GPU与边缘FPGA协同的系统化方案
同时覆盖调度、KV传输压缩与异构流水优化，端到端指标提升幅度可观
